rows.title: Roaring Ranch
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Sally Eilers
rows.extract: Roaring Ranch is a 1930 American pre-Code Western film written and directed by B. Reeves Eason. The film stars Hoot Gibson, and it was released on April 27, 1930, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Rogue of the Rio Grande
rows.cast: José Bohr, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: Rogue of the Rio Grande is a 1930 American musical comedy Western film directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet and starring José Bohr, Myrna Loy and Walter Miller.

rows.title: The Rogue Song
rows.cast: Lawrence Tibbett, Clifford Grey
rows.extract: The Rogue Song is a 1930 American pre-Code romantic and musical film that tells the story of a Russian bandit who falls in love with a princess, but takes his revenge on her when her brother rapes and kills his sister. The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer production was directed by Lionel Barrymore and released

rows.title: Romance
rows.cast: Greta Garbo, Lewis Stone
rows.extract: Romance is a 1930 American Pre-Code Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer film directed by Clarence Brown, starring Greta Garbo, Lewis Stone, and Gavin Gordon.

rows.title: Romance of the West
rows.cast: Jack Perrin, Edna Marion, Tom London
rows.extract: Romance of the West is a 1930 American pre-Code western film directed by John Tansey and Robert Emmett Tansey and starring Jack Perrin, Edna Marion and Tom London.

rows.title: Rough Romance
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Helen Chandler
rows.extract: Rough Romance is a 1930 American lumberjack Western film directed by A. F. Erickson. The film stars George O'Brien, Helen Chandler, Antonio Moreno, Roy Stewart, and Harry Cording and a 23-year-old John Wayne had a minor uncredited role.

rows.title: Rough Waters
rows.cast: Rin Tin Tin, Jobyna Ralston
rows.extract: Rough Waters is a 1930 American pre-Code all-talking adventure drama film that directed by John Daumery and starring Rin Tin Tin. The film was adapted by James A. Starr from a story by Lillie Hayward, and was the last Rin Tin Tin film produced by Warner Bros.

rows.title: A Royal Romance
rows.cast: William Collier Jr., Pauline Starke, Clarence Muse
rows.extract: A Royal Romance is a 1930 American Pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Erle C. Kenton and starring William Collier, Pauline Starke and Clarence Muse. It was an unofficial remake of the 1925 silent film A Fool and His Money.

rows.title: The Runaway Bride
rows.cast: Mary Astor, Lloyd Hughes, Paul Hurst
rows.extract: The Runaway Bride is a 1930 American pre-Code crime film starring Mary Astor, Lloyd Hughes, and Paul Hurst. It was directed by Donald Crisp, from a screenplay by Jane Murfin, adapted from the play Cooking Her Goose by H. H. Van Loan and Lolita Ann Westman.

rows.title: Safety in Numbers
rows.cast: Carole Lombard, Charles Rogers, Kathryn Crawford
rows.extract: Safety in Numbers is a 1930 American pre-Code musical comedy film. Directed by Victor Schertzinger, it stars Charles "Buddy" Rogers, and features Kathryn Crawford, Josephine Dunn, and Carole Lombard.

rows.title: The Santa Fe Trail
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Rosita Moreno
rows.extract: The Santa Fe Trail is a 1930 American pre-Code Western film, directed by Otto Brower and Edwin H. Knopf, released by Paramount Pictures, and starring Richard Arlen, Rosita Moreno, and Eugene Pallette. The film was an adaptation of Hal George Evarts's 1925 novel, Spanish Acres.

rows.title: The Sap from Syracuse
rows.cast: Jack Oakie, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: The Sap from Syracuse is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy film directed by A. Edward Sutherland and written by John Griffith Wray, along with Jack O'Donnell, John Hayden and Gertrude Purcell. The film stars Jack Oakie, Ginger Rogers, Granville Bates, George Barbier, and Verree Teasdale. The film was

rows.title: Sarah and Son
rows.cast: Ruth Chatterton, Fredric March
rows.extract: Sarah and Son is a 1930 pre-Code American drama film directed by Dorothy Arzner. The screenplay by Zoë Akins was adapted from Timothy Shea's novel of the same name. It stars Ruth Chatterton, Fredric March, Gilbert Emery, and Doris Lloyd. It was filmed at Paramount Studios in Los Angeles and released

rows.title: Scarlet Pages
rows.cast: Elsie Ferguson, John Halliday, Grant Withers
rows.extract: Scarlet Pages is a 1930 pre-Code American crime drama film with songs starring Elsie Ferguson and directed by Ray Enright. It was produced and distributed by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Bros. The film stars Elsie Ferguson, John Halliday, Grant Withers and Marian Nixon. Scarlet Pa

rows.title: Scotland Yard
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Joan Bennett
rows.extract: Scotland Yard is a 1930 American pre-Code crime film directed by William K. Howard, written by Garrett Fort, and starring Edmund Lowe, Joan Bennett, Donald Crisp, Georges Renavent, Lumsden Hare and David Torrence. It was released on October 19, 1930, by Fox Film Corporation. It is based on the 1929

rows.title: The Sea Bat
rows.cast: Raquel Torres, Charles Bickford, Nils Asther
rows.extract: The Sea Bat is a 1930 American pre-Code melodrama thriller film directed by Lionel Barrymore and Wesley Ruggles, starring Raquel Torres, Charles Bickford and featuring Boris Karloff. Part of the film was filmed on location in Mazatlán, Mexico. The film was originally intended as a vehicle for Lon Ch

rows.title: The Sea God
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Fay Wray
rows.extract: The Sea God is a 1930 American pre-Code adventure film written and directed by George Abbott. The film stars Richard Arlen, Fay Wray, Eugene Pallette, Ivan Simpson, Maurice Black, and Bob Perry. The film was released on September 13, 1930, by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Sea Legs
rows.cast: Jack Oakie, Lillian Roth
rows.extract: Sea Legs is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Victor Heerman and written by George Marion Jr. and Marion Dix. rows.cast: Milton Sills, Raymond Hackett
rows.extract: The Sea Wolf is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by Alfred Santell and written by S. N. Behrman and Ralph Block. rows.title: Second Choice
rows.cast: Dolores Costello, Chester Morris
rows.extract: Second Choice is a 1930 American Pre-Code black-and-white film released by Warner Bros. and starring Dolores Costello and Chester Morris. rows.title: The Second Floor Mystery
rows.cast: Grant Withers, Loretta Young, H. B. Warner
rows.extract: The Second Floor Mystery is a 1930 American pre-Code film directed by Roy Del Ruth. It was based on the 1916 novel The Agony Column by Earl Derr Biggers. The film stars Grant Withers, Loretta Young, H. B. Warner and John Loder.

rows.title: Second Honeymoon
rows.cast: Josephine Dunn, Bernice Elliott, Edward Earle
rows.extract: Second Honeymoon is a 1930 American silent comedy-drama film, directed by Phil Rosen. It stars Josephine Dunn, Edward Earle, and Ernest Hilliard, and was released in September 1930.

rows.title: Second Wife
rows.cast: Conrad Nagel, Lila Lee
rows.extract: Second Wife is a 1930 American drama film produced and released by RKO Pictures. It was directed by Russell Mack, written by Hugh Herbert and Bert Glennon, based on the play All the King's Men by Fulton Oursler. The film stars Conrad Nagel and Lila Lee, two silent film veterans moving into talkies.

rows.title: See America Thirst
rows.cast: Harry Langdon, Bessie Love
rows.extract: See America Thirst is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy film produced and distributed by Universal Pictures and directed by William James Craft. Silent comics Harry Langdon and Slim Summerville star along with Bessie Love. Though released late in 1930, it nevertheless had a silent version.

rows.title: Seven Days Leave
rows.cast: Gary Cooper, Beryl Mercer
rows.extract: Seven Days Leave is a 1930 American Pre-Code drama film produced and directed by Richard Wallace and starring Gary Cooper, Beryl Mercer, and Daisy Belmore.

rows.title: Shadow of the Law
rows.cast: William Powell, Marion Shilling
rows.extract: Shadow of the Law is a 1930 American pre-Code film directed by Louis J. Gasnier and starring William Powell, Richard Tucker, and Regis Toomey.

rows.title: Shadow Ranch
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Marguerite De La Motte
rows.extract: Shadow Ranch is a 1930 American pre-Code Western film directed by Louis King.

rows.title: She Couldn't Say No
rows.cast: Winnie Lightner, Chester Morris
rows.extract: She Couldn't Say No is a 1930 American Pre-Code drama which stars Winnie Lightner, fresh from her success in Gold Diggers of Broadway (1929). It was adapted from a play by Benjamin M. Kaye. An aspiring singer ends up in a love triangle with a gangster and a socialite.

rows.title: She Got What She Wanted
rows.cast: Betty Compson, Lee Tracy
rows.extract: She Got What She Wanted is an American pre-Code early talking film comedy-drama directed by James Cruze and starring his actress wife Betty Compson. The film was made for Tiffany Pictures with Cruze and Compson having recently completed The Great Gabbo (1929).

rows.title: She's My Weakness
rows.cast: Sue Carol, Arthur Lake
rows.extract: She's My Weakness is a 1930 American Pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Melville W. Brown and starring Sue Carol and Arthur Lake. The screenplay was written by J. Walter Ruben, based on the Broadway play Tommy by Howard Lindsay and Bertrand Robinson.

rows.title: The Ship from Shanghai
rows.cast: Conrad Nagel, Kay Johnson
rows.extract: The Ship from Shanghai is a 1930 Pre-Code American action film directed by Charles Brabin and written by John Howard Lawson. The film stars Conrad Nagel, Kay Johnson, Carmel Myers, Holmes Herbert and Zeffie Tilbury. The film was released on January 31, 1930, by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. The September 14,

rows.title: Shooting Straight
rows.cast: Richard Dix, James Neill
rows.extract: Shooting Straight is a 1930 American pre-Code crime drama film, directed by George Archainbaud and starring the early RKO staple Richard Dix and Mary Lawlor. rows.title: Showgirl in Hollywood
rows.cast: Alice White, Jack Mulhall, Blanche Sweet
rows.extract: Showgirl in Hollywood is a 1930 American pre-Code all-talking musical film with Technicolor sequences, produced and distributed by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Bros. rows.title: The Silver Horde
rows.cast: Evelyn Brent, Joel McCrea, Jean Arthur
rows.extract: The Silver Horde is a 1930 American pre-Code romantic drama film starring Joel McCrea as a fisherman torn between two women, played by top-billed Evelyn Brent and Jean Arthur.

rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Basil Rathbone

rows.title: The Sins of the Children
rows.cast: Louis Mann, Robert Montgomery

rows.title: Sisters
rows.cast: Sally O'Neil, Molly O'Day
rows.extract: Sisters is a 1930 American crime film directed by James Flood and starring Sally O'Neil, Molly O'Day and Russell Gleason.

rows.title: Slightly Scarlet
rows.cast: Evelyn Brent, Clive Brook
rows.extract: Slightly Scarlet is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy drama film directed by Louis J. Gasnier and Edwin H. Knopf and starring Evelyn Brent and Clive Brook. rows.title: So This Is London
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Irene Rich
rows.extract: So This Is London is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy film directed by John G. Blystone and starring Will Rogers, Irene Rich, Frank Albertson and Lumsden Hare.

rows.title: The Social Lion
rows.cast: Jack Oakie, Mary Brian, Richard 'Skeets' Gallagher

rows.title: Song o' My Heart
rows.cast: John McCormack, Maureen O'Sullivan
rows.extract: Song o' My Heart is a 1930 Pre-Code American film directed by Frank Borzage and starring John McCormack, Alice Joyce, Maureen O'Sullivan, Effie Ellsler and John Garrick. It was O'Sullivan's second film role.

rows.title: Song of the Caballero
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Doris Hill
rows.extract: Song of the Caballero is a 1930 pre-Code American Western film directed by Harry Joe Brown and written by Bennett Cohen and Leslie Mason. The film stars Ken Maynard. The film was released on June 29, 1930, by Universal Pictures.

rows.cast: Alexander Gray, Bernice Claire, Noah Beery

rows.cast: Ted Healy, Shemp Howard, Frances McCoy
rows.extract: Soup to Nuts is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy film written by cartoonist, sculptor, author, and inventor Rube Goldberg and directed by Benjamin Stoloff. rows.title: The Storm
rows.cast: Lupe Vélez, Paul Cavanagh, William Boyd
rows.extract: The Storm is a 1930 American pre-Code adventure film directed by William Wyler, written by John Huston, Charles Logue, Tom Reed and Wells Root, and starring Lupe Vélez, Paul Cavanagh, William "Stage" Boyd, Alphonse Ethier and Ernie Adams. It was released on August 22, 1930, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Street of Chance
rows.cast: William Powell, Jean Arthur, Kay Francis
rows.extract: Street of Chance is a 1930 American pre-Code film directed by John Cromwell and starring William Powell, Jean Arthur, Kay Francis and Regis Toomey. Howard Estabrook was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Writing, Achievement.

rows.title: Strictly Modern
rows.cast: Dorothy Mackaill, Sidney Blackmer
rows.extract: Strictly Modern is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy film directed by William A. Seiter and starring Dorothy Mackaill and Sidney Blackmer. It was produced and released by First National Pictures and was based on the play, entitled Cousin Kate, written by Hubert Henry Davies.

rows.title: Strictly Unconventional
rows.cast: Catherine Dale Owen, Paul Cavanagh
rows.extract: Strictly Unconventional is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by David Burton, written by Sylvia Thalberg and Frank Butler, and starring Catherine Dale Owen, Paul Cavanagh, Tyrell Davis, Lewis Stone and Ernest Torrence. rows.cast: Catherine Dale Owen, Hedda Hopper, Bela Lugosi

rows.title: Sunny Skies
rows.cast: Benny Rubin, Marceline Day, Rex Lease
rows.extract: Sunny Skies is a 1930 American Pre-Code musical comedy film directed by Norman Taurog, starring Benny Rubin and Marceline Day and produced by Tiffany Pictures. It is notable for a same-sex romantic subplot, involving a young man's tragically unrequited love for his football hero roommate.

rows.title: Sweet Kitty Bellairs
rows.cast: Claudia Dell, Walter Pidgeon, Ernest Torrence
rows.extract: Sweet Kitty Bellairs is a 1930 American historical musical comedy film directed by Alfred E. Green. rows.cast: Alice White, David Manners

rows.title: Sweethearts and Wives
rows.cast: Billie Dove, Clive Brook, Sidney Blackmer
rows.extract: Sweethearts and Wives is a 1930 American pre-Code mystery film with comedic elements produced and released by First National Pictures and directed by Clarence G. Badger. rows.title: The Swellhead
rows.cast: James Gleason, Marion Shilling
rows.extract: The Swellhead is a 1930 American pre-Code sports film directed by James Flood and starring James Gleason, Johnnie Walker, and Marion Shilling. It is also known by the alternative title of Counted Out.

rows.title: Swing High
rows.cast: Helen Twelvetrees, Dorothy Burgess, John Sheehan
rows.extract: Swing High is a 1930 American pre-Code musical film directed by Joseph Santley and starring Helen Twelvetrees, Fred Scott and Dorothy Burgess.

rows.title: Take the Heir
rows.cast: Edward Everett Horton, Dorothy Devore, Edythe Chapman
rows.extract: Take the Heir is a 1930 American comedy film directed by Lloyd Ingraham and starring Edward Everett Horton, Dorothy Devore and Edythe Chapman. rows.title: Temple Tower
rows.cast: Kenneth MacKenna, Marceline Day
rows.extract: Temple Tower is a 1930 American pre-Code crime film directed by Donald Gallaher and starring Kenneth MacKenna, Marceline Day. and Peter Gawthorne.

rows.title: The Texan
rows.cast: Gary Cooper, Fay Wray, Emma Dunn
rows.extract: The Texan is a 1930 American Western film directed by John Cromwell and starring Gary Cooper and Fay Wray. Based on the short story "The Double-Dyed Deceiver" by O. rows.title: They Learned About Women
rows.cast: Van and Schenck, Bessie Love
rows.extract: They Learned About Women is a 1930 American Pre-Code sports drama musical film directed by Jack Conway and Sam Wood, and starring Van and Schenck in their final film appearance together.

rows.title: The Third Alarm
rows.cast: Anita Louise, Jean Hersholt
rows.extract: The Third Alarm is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by Emory Johnson. The film is based on the original story by Emilie Johnson and is set in San Francisco, California. rows.title: This Mad World
rows.cast: Kay Johnson, Basil Rathbone
rows.extract: This Mad World is a 1930 American pre-Code film directed by William C. deMille and starring Basil Rathbone, Kay Johnson and Louise Dresser. A drama, it sees a French spy return home to German-occupied France during World War I to find a German general living in his house.

rows.title: Those Three French Girls
rows.cast: Fifi D'Orsay, Reginald Denny
rows.extract: Those Three French Girls  is a 1930 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Harry Beaumont and starring Fifi D'Orsay, Reginald Denny, and Cliff Edwards. The dialogue was written by P. G. Wodehouse.

rows.title: Those Who Dance
rows.cast: Monte Blue, Lila Lee, Betty Compson

rows.title: Three Faces East

rows.extract: Three Faces East is a 1930 American Pre-Code film directed by Roy Del Ruth and starring Constance Bennett and Erich von Stroheim. rows.title: The Three Sisters
rows.cast: Louise Dresser, Joyce Compton
rows.extract: The Three Sisters is a 1930 American pre-Code film directed by Paul Sloane and starring Louise Dresser, Tom Patricola and Kenneth MacKenna. It was distributed by Fox Film Corporation five years before they would become Twentieth Century Fox. It is unknown whether a print of the film still exists.

rows.title: Thus is Life
rows.cast: José Bohr, Delia Magana
rows.extract: Thus is Life is a 1930 American Spanish language romantic comedy film directed by George Crone and starring José Bohr, Delia Magana and Lolita Vendrell. It was produced as the Spanish version of the English language film What a Man!, also directed by Crone. In the early years of sound such multi-lan

rows.title: Today
rows.cast: Conrad Nagel, Catherine Dale Owen
rows.extract: Today is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by William Nigh and starring Conrad Nagel, Catherine Dale Owen and Sarah Padden. It was co written by Seton I. Miller and was based on a play by George Howells Broadhurst, which had previously been made into a silent film of the same title. The f

rows.title: Tol'able David
rows.cast: Richard Cromwell, Noah Beery
rows.extract: Tol'able David is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by John G. Blystone and produced and released by Columbia Pictures. It is a remake of the 1921 silent film Tol'able David, which starred Richard Barthelmess and Ernest Torrence.

rows.title: Tom Sawyer
rows.cast: Jackie Coogan, Junior Durkin, Mitzi Green
rows.extract: Tom Sawyer is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by John Cromwell and starring Jackie Coogan. The screenplay by Grover Jones, William Slavens McNutt, and Sam Mintz is based on the 1876 novel The Adventures of Tom Sawyer by Mark Twain.

rows.title: Top Speed
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Laura Lee, Frank McHugh
rows.extract: Top Speed is a 1930 American Pre-Code musical comedy film released by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Brothers. It was based on a 1929 stage musical of the same name by Harry Ruby, Guy Bolton and Bert Kalmar. The film stars Joe E. Brown, Bernice Claire, Jack Whiting, Laura Lee, and F

rows.title: Trailing Trouble
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, William McCall
rows.extract: Trailing Trouble is a 1930 American Western film directed by Arthur Rosson, written by Harold Tarshis, and starring Hoot Gibson. It was released on March 23, 1930, by Universal Pictures. The title was also seen as Trailin' Trouble.

rows.title: Trigger Tricks
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Sally Eilers
rows.extract: Trigger Tricks is a 1930 American pre-Code Western film written and directed by B. Reeves Eason, and starring Hoot Gibson, Sally Eilers, Robert Homans, Jack Richardson, Monte Montague and Neal Hart. It was released on June 8, 1930, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Troopers Three
rows.cast: Rex Lease, Dorothy Gulliver
rows.extract: Troopers Three is a 1930 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Norman Taurog and B. Reeves Eason and produced and distributed by Tiffany Studios.

rows.title: True to the Navy
rows.cast: Fredric March, Clara Bow, Harry Green
rows.extract: True to the Navy is a 1930 romantic comedy film directed by Frank Tuttle for Paramount Pictures. The film stars Clara Bow as a counter girl at a San Diego drugstore with a predilection for sailors. Eventually she sets her sights on Bull's Eye McCoy, a stiff-necked gunner's mate.

rows.title: The Truth About Youth
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Myrna Loy, David Manners
rows.extract: The Truth About Youth is a 1930 American pre-Code drama with songs produced and distributed by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Bros. Directed by William A. Seiter, the film stars Loretta Young, Conway Tearle, David Manners and Myrna Loy. It was based on the 1900 play When We Were Twe

rows.title: Under a Texas Moon
rows.cast: Myrna Loy, Noah Beery, Raquel Torres
rows.extract: Under A Texas Moon is a 1930 American pre-Code musical Western film photographed entirely in Technicolor. It was based on the novel Two-Gun Man which was written by Stewart Edward White. It was the second all-color, all-talking feature to be filmed entirely outdoors, as well as being the second West

rows.title: Under Montana Skies
rows.cast: Kenneth Harlan, Slim Summerville, Dorothy Gulliver
rows.extract: Under Montana Skies is a 1930 American western film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Kenneth Harlan, Slim Summerville and Dorothy Gulliver. It was produced and distributed by Tiffany Pictures, one of the leading independent studios in Hollywood.

rows.title: Undertow
rows.cast: Mary Nolan, Johnny Mack Brown
rows.extract: Undertow is a 1930 American drama film directed by Harry A. Pollard, written by Edward T. Lowe, Jr. and Winnifred Reeve, and starring Mary Nolan, Johnny Mack Brown, Robert Ellis, Churchill Ross and Audrey Ferris. It was released in March 1930, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: The Unholy Three
rows.cast: Lon Chaney, Lila Lee, Harry Earles
rows.extract: The Unholy Three is a 1930 American Pre-Code melodrama directed by Jack Conway and starring Lon Chaney. Its plot involves a crime spree. The film is a sound remake of the silent 1925 film of the same name, with both films based on the novel The Unholy Three, by Tod Robbins.

rows.title: Up the River
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Humphrey Bogart, Claire Luce
rows.extract: Up the River is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy film directed by John Ford, and starring Claire Luce, Spencer Tracy and Humphrey Bogart. The plot concerns escaped convicts, as well as a female convict. It was the feature film debut role of both Tracy and Bogart. Despite Bogart being billed fourth, T

rows.title: The Utah Kid
rows.cast: Rex Lease, Dorothy Sebastian, Tom Santschi
rows.extract: The Utah Kid is a 1930 American pre-Code Western film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Rex Lease and Boris Karloff.

rows.title: The Vagabond King
rows.cast: Jeanette MacDonald, O.P. Heggie, Lillian Roth
rows.extract: The Vagabond King is a 1930 American Pre-Code musical operetta film photographed entirely in two-color Technicolor. The plot of the film was based on the 1925 operetta of the same name, which was based on the 1901 play If I Were King by Justin Huntly McCarthy. The play told the story of the real-lif

rows.title: Viennese Nights
rows.cast: Vivienne Segal, Walter Pidgeon
rows.extract: Viennese Nights is a 1930 American all-talking pre-Code musical operetta film directed by Alan Crosland and starring Alexander Gray, Vivienne Segal, Walter Pidgeon, Jean Hersholt, Bela Lugosi and Louise Fazenda. It was photographed entirely in Technicolor and released by Warner Brothers. Viennese Ni

rows.title: The Virtuous Sin
rows.cast: Walter Huston, Kay Francis
rows.extract: The Virtuous Sin is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by George Cukor and Louis J. Gasnier and starring Walter Huston, Kay Francis, and Kenneth MacKenna. The screenplay by Martin Brown and Louise Long is based on the 1928 play The General by Lajos Zilahy. A separate 1931 German-lan

rows.title: War Nurse
rows.cast: Robert Montgomery, Anita Page, June Walker
rows.extract: War Nurse is a 1930 American pre-Code war film directed by Edgar Selwyn and starring Robert Montgomery, Anita Page, June Walker and Robert Ames.

rows.title: Way for a Sailor
rows.cast: John Gilbert, Wallace Beery
rows.extract: Way for a Sailor is a 1930 American Pre-Code film starring John Gilbert. The supporting cast includes Wallace Beery, Jim Tully, Leila Hyams, and Polly Moran. The film was directed by Sam Wood, who insisted on no screen credit. The film is reputed to be so bad that the studio might have used it to sa

rows.title: The Way of All Men
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Dorothy Revier
rows.extract: The Way of All Men is a 1930 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Frank Lloyd and starring Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Dorothy Revier and Noah Beery. It was produced and released by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Bros. The film was based on the story entitled "The Sin Flood", by Henn

rows.title: Way Out West
rows.cast: William Haines, Polly Moran, Leila Hyams
rows.extract: Way Out West is a 1930 American pre-Code parody film, directed by Fred Niblo, starring William Haines, Leila Hyams, Polly Moran, and Ralph Bushman. It tells the story of Windy, a con man who cheats a group of cowboys out of their money. When they discover his cheating and learn that he has been robb

rows.title: Westward Bound
rows.cast: Jay Wilsey, Allene Ray, Buddy Roosevelt
rows.extract: Westward Bound is a 1930 American pre-Code western film directed by Harry S. Webb and starring Jay Wilsey, Allene Ray and Buddy Roosevelt.

rows.title: What a Man!
rows.cast: Reginald Denny, Miriam Seegar
rows.extract: What a Man is a 1930 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by George Crone and starring Reginald Denny, Miriam Seegar and Harvey Clark. It was an adaptation of the play They All Want Something by Courtenay Savage, which was itself based on a novel by E.J. Rath. A separate Spanish language

rows.title: What a Widow!
rows.cast: Gloria Swanson, Owen Moore
rows.extract: What a Widow! was a 1930 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Allan Dwan and produced by and starring Gloria Swanson. It was distributed through United Artists.

rows.title: What Men Want
rows.cast: Pauline Starke, Ben Lyon
rows.extract: What Men Want is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by Ernst Laemmle and starring Pauline Starke, Ben Lyon, Hallam Cooley, Barbara Kent, Robert Ellis and Carmelita Geraghty. Written by John B. Clymer and Dorothy Yost, the film was released on July 13, 1930, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Whoopee!
rows.cast: Eddie Cantor, Eleanor Hunt, Ethel Shutta
rows.extract: Whoopee! is a 1930 American pre-Code comedy musical western film directed by Thornton Freeland and starring Eddie Cantor, Ethel Shutta, and Eleanor Hunt. It was photographed in two-color Technicolor. Its plot closely follows the 1928 stage show produced by Florenz Ziegfeld.

rows.title: Wide Open
rows.cast: Edward Everett Horton, Patsy Ruth Miller
rows.extract: Wide Open is a 1930 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Archie Mayo, starring Edward Everett Horton and Patsy Ruth Miller, and featuring Louise Fazenda, T. Roy Barnes and Edna Murphy. Released by Warner Bros., it is based on the 1924 novel The Narrow Street by Edward Bateman Morris.

rows.title: The Widow From Chicago
rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Alice White, Frank McHugh
rows.extract: The Widow from Chicago is a 1930 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Edward F. Cline and starring Alice White, Edward G. Robinson, Neil Hamilton, and Frank McHugh. It was released by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Bros. Planned as a full-scale musical, the songs were cut

rows.title: Wild Company
rows.cast: Joyce Compton, H. B. Warner, Bela Lugosi
rows.extract: Wild Company is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by Leo McCarey and written by Bradley King. The film stars Frank Albertson, Joyce Compton, Sharon Lynn, H. B. Warner, Richard Keene and Frances McCoy. The film was released on July 5, 1930, by Fox Film Corporation. Although Bela Lugosi had

rows.title: Wings of Adventure
rows.cast: Rex Lease, Armida, Clyde Cook
rows.extract: Wings of Adventure is a 1930 American action adventure film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Rex Lease, Armida and Clyde Cook. It was produced and distributed by Tiffany Pictures.

rows.title: The Woman Racket
rows.cast: Tom Moore, Blanche Sweet, Tenen Holtz
rows.extract: The Woman Racket is an extant 1930 Pre-Code talking film produced and distributed by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer starring Tom Moore and Blanche Sweet. rows.title: Women Everywhere
rows.cast: J. Harold Murray, Fifi D'Orsay
rows.extract: Women Everywhere is a 1930 American Pre-Code musical adventure film directed by Alexander Korda and starring J. Harold Murray, Fifi D'Orsay, and George Grossmith, Jr. It is set amongst the French Foreign Legion in North Africa.

rows.title: Worldly Goods
rows.cast: James Kirkwood Sr., Merna Kennedy
rows.extract: Worldly Goods is a 1930 American pre-Code melodrama film directed by Phil Rosen based on a story by Andrew Soutar, starring James Kirkwood Sr. and Merna Kennedy. Distributed by Continental Talking Pictures, the film was released on August 1, 1930.

rows.title: Young Desire
rows.cast: Mary Nolan, William Janney
rows.extract: Young Desire is a 1930 American pre-Code drama film directed by Lewis D. Collins and written by Winnifred Reeve, C. Gardner Sullivan and Matt Taylor. The film stars Mary Nolan, William Janney, Ralf Harolde, Mae Busch, George Irving and Claire McDowell. The film was released on June 8, 1930, by Unive

rows.title: Young Eagles
rows.cast: Jean Arthur, Charles Rogers, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: Young Eagles is a 1930 American pre-Code romantic drama film directed by William A. Wellman for Paramount Pictures. It stars Charles "Buddy" Rogers, Jean Arthur, and Paul Lukas. The story is based on the stories "The One Who Was Clever" and "Sky-High", written by American aviator and war hero Elliot

rows.title: Young Man of Manhattan
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Ginger Rogers, Charles Ruggles
rows.extract: Young Man of Manhattan is a 1930 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by Monta Bell and starring Claudette Colbert, Norman Foster, Ginger Rogers, and Charles Ruggles. Made by Paramount Pictures, it was set and filmed in New York City.

rows.title: The Age for Love
rows.cast: Billie Dove, Edward Everett Horton, Lois Wilson
rows.extract: The Age for Love is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Frank Lloyd based on the 1930 novel of the same name by Ernest Pascal. rows.title: Air Eagles
rows.cast: Lloyd Hughes, Norman Kerry, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Air Eagles is a 1931 American pre-Code action film starring Lloyd Hughes, Norman Kerry, and Shirley Grey.

rows.title: Air Police
rows.cast: Kenneth Harlan, Josephine Dunn, Richard Cramer
rows.extract: Air Police is a 1931 aviation sound film about air police produced by George W. Weeks Productions. It was distributed by Sono Art-World Wide Pictures and William Steiner Productions. Air Police was directed by Stuart Paton and stars Kenneth Harlan, Josephine Dunn, Richard Cramer and Charles Delaney.

rows.title: Alexander Hamilton
rows.cast: George Arliss, Doris Kenyon, Montagu Love
rows.extract: Alexander Hamilton is a 1931 American pre-Code biographical film about Alexander Hamilton, produced and distributed by Warner Bros. and based on the 1917 play Hamilton by George Arliss and Mary Hamlin. It was directed by John G. Adolfi and stars Arliss in the title role. It follows the attempts of H

rows.title: Alias the Bad Man
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Virginia Brown Faire
rows.extract: Alias – the Bad Man, also known as Alias Bad Man, is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film, directed by Phil Rosen and starring Ken Maynard, Virginia Brown Faire, and Frank Mayo. It was released on July 15, 1931.

rows.title: Alice in Wonderland
rows.cast: Ruth Gilbert, Leslie King
rows.extract: Alice in Wonderland (1931) is an independently made black-and-white Pre-Code American film based on Lewis Carroll's 1865 novel Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, directed by Bud Pollard, produced by Hugo Maienthau, and filmed at Metropolitan Studios in Fort Lee, New Jersey.

rows.title: Aloha
rows.cast: Ben Lyon, Raquel Torres, Thelma Todd
rows.extract: Aloha is a 1931 American drama film directed by Albert S. Rogell and starring Ben Lyon, Raquel Torres and Thelma Todd. It was produced and distributed by the independent studio Tiffany Pictures, one of the largest companies outside of the major studios. It was released in Britain by Gaumont British

rows.title: Always Goodbye
rows.cast: Elissa Landi, Paul Cavanagh
rows.extract: Always Goodbye is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Kenneth MacKenna and William Cameron Menzies and starring Elissa Landi, Lewis Stone and Paul Cavanagh. It was produced and distributed by Fox Film.

rows.title: Ambassador Bill
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Marguerite Churchill, Greta Nissen
rows.extract: Ambassador Bill is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Sam Taylor and starring Will Rogers and Marguerite Churchill. The film also features Greta Nissen and Ray Milland.

rows.title: An American Tragedy
rows.cast: Sylvia Sidney, Phillips Holmes, Frances Dee
rows.extract: An American Tragedy (1931) is a pre-Code drama film directed by Josef von Sternberg. It was produced and distributed by Paramount Pictures. The film is based on Theodore Dreiser's 1925 novel An American Tragedy and the 1926 play adaptation. These were based on the historic 1906 murder of Grace Brown

rows.title: Annabelle's Affairs
rows.cast: Victor McLaglen, Jeanette MacDonald, Roland Young
rows.extract: Annabelle's Affairs is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Alfred L. Werker and starring Victor McLaglen, Jeanette MacDonald and Roland Young. The film is based on the 1916-17 play Good Gracious Annabelle by Clare Kummer. It is the only one of MacDonald's films to be considered

rows.title: Anybody's Blonde
rows.cast: Dorothy Revier, Reed Howes, Edna Murphy
rows.extract: Anybody's Blonde is a 1931 American Pre-Code mystery film directed by Frank R. Strayer from an original screenplay by Betty Burbridge. The film stars Dorothy Revier, Reed Howes, and Edna Murphy, and was released by Action Pictures on November 17, 1931.

rows.title: Are These Our Children?
rows.cast: Eric Linden, Rochelle Hudson, Ben Alexander
rows.extract: Are These Our Children? is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Wesley Ruggles and written by Howard Estabrook. The film stars Eric Linden, Ben Alexander, Beryl Mercer, Mary Kornman, Arline Judge, and Rochelle Hudson. The film was released on November 14, 1931 by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Are You There?
rows.cast: Beatrice Lillie, John Garrick
rows.extract: Are You There? is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and written by Harlan Thompson. The film stars Beatrice Lillie, John Garrick, Olga Baclanova, George Grossmith Jr., Roger Davis and Jillian Sand. The film was released on May 3, 1931, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Arizona
rows.cast: Laura La Plante, John Wayne, June Clyde
rows.extract: Arizona is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Laura La Plante, John Wayne and June Clyde. rows.title: Arizona Terror
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Lina Basquette
rows.extract: Arizona Terror is a 1931 American Pre-Code Western film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Ken Maynard, Lina Basquette and Hooper Atchley.

rows.title: Around the World in 80 Minutes with Douglas Fairbanks
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks
rows.extract: Around the World in 80 Minutes with Douglas Fairbanks is a 1931 American Pre-Code documentary film directed by Douglas Fairbanks and Victor Fleming and written by Robert E. Sherwood. The film was released on December 12, 1931, by United Artists.

rows.title: Arrowsmith
rows.cast: Ronald Colman, Helen Hayes, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: Arrowsmith is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by John Ford and starring Ronald Colman, Helen Hayes, Richard Bennett, and Myrna Loy. rows.title: The Avenger
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Dorothy Revier
rows.extract: The Avenger is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film directed by Roy William Neill and starring Buck Jones and Dorothy Revier. rows.cast: Irene Dunne, Lowell Sherman, Mae Murray
rows.extract: Bachelor Apartment is a 1931 American pre-Code romance film directed by and starring Lowell Sherman as a bachelor/playboy, Wayne Carter, who falls in love with Irene Dunne's honest working girl, Helene Andrews. rows.title: The Bachelor Father

rows.extract: The Bachelor Father  is a 1931 American pre-Code MGM comedy drama film directed by Robert Z. Leonard and starring Marion Davies and featuring Ralph Forbes, C. rows.title: Bad Company
rows.cast: Helen Twelvetrees, Ricardo Cortez, John Garrick
rows.extract: Bad Company is a 1931 American pre-Code gangster film directed and co-written by Tay Garnett with Tom Buckingham based on Jack Lait's 1930 novel Put on the Spot. rows.title: Bad Girl
rows.cast: Sally Eilers, James Dunn, Minna Gombell
rows.extract: Bad Girl is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Frank Borzage and starring Sally Eilers, James Dunn, and Minna Gombell. The screenplay was adapted by Edwin J. rows.title: Bad Sister
rows.cast: Conrad Nagel, Bette Davis, Humphrey Bogart
rows.extract: Bad Sister is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Hobart Henley. The screenplay by Edwin H. Knopf, Tom Reed, and Raymond L. Schrock is based on the 1913 novel The Flirt by Booth Tarkington, which had been filmed in 1916 and 1922.

rows.title: The Bargain
rows.cast: Evalyn Knapp, Lewis Stone, Doris Kenyon
rows.extract: The Bargain (1931) is an all-talking American pre-Code comedy drama film produced and released by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Bros., and directed by Robert Milton. rows.title: Behind Office Doors
rows.cast: Mary Astor, Ricardo Cortez, Catherine Dale Owen
rows.extract: Behind Office Doors is a 1931 pre-Code American drama film directed by Melville W. Brown, from a screenplay by Carey Wilson and J. rows.title: The Beloved Bachelor
rows.cast: Paul Lukas, Dorothy Jordan, Vivienne Osborne
rows.extract: The Beloved Bachelor is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Lloyd Corrigan, and written by Sidney Buchman, Raymond Griffith, Agnes Brand Leahy and Edward Peple. The film stars Paul Lukas, Dorothy Jordan, Vivienne Osborne, Charlie Ruggles, Marjorie Gateson, Harold Minjir and John Breeden.

rows.title: Beyond Victory
rows.cast: Bill Boyd, James Gleason, Marion Shilling
rows.extract: Beyond Victory is a 1931 American pre-Code war film starring Bill Boyd, James Gleason, Lew Cody, and ZaSu Pitts. While John Robertson received directing credit, Edward H. rows.title: Big Business Girl
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Frank Albertson, Ricardo Cortez
rows.extract: Big Business Girl is a 1931 pre-Code First National sound comedy film directed by William A. Seiter and starring Loretta Young, then eighteen years old. It was released theatrically through First National's parent company Warner Bros.

rows.title: The Big Gamble
rows.cast: William Boyd, James Gleason, June MacCloy
rows.extract: The Big Gamble is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Fred Niblo and written by Walter DeLeon and F. McGrew Willis. The film stars William Boyd, Dorothy Sebastian, Warner Oland and James Gleason. The film was released on September 4, 1931 by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: The Big Shot
rows.cast: Eddie Quillan, Maureen O'Sullivan, Mary Nolan
rows.extract: The Big Shot is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Ralph Murphy and Edward Sedgwick and written by Earl Baldwin, Hal Conklin, George Dromgold and Joseph Fields. rows.cast: Warner Oland, Sally Eilers, Bela Lugosi
rows.extract: The Black Camel is a 1931 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and starring Warner Oland, Sally Eilers, Bela Lugosi, and Dorothy Revier. rows.title: Blonde Crazy
rows.cast: James Cagney, Joan Blondell, Ray Milland
rows.extract: Blonde Crazy is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic comedy-drama film directed by Roy Del Ruth and starring James Cagney, Joan Blondell, Noel Francis, Louis Calhern, Ray Milland, and Guy Kibbee. rows.title: Body and Soul
rows.cast: Charles Farrell, Elissa Landi, Humphrey Bogart
rows.extract: Body and Soul (1931) is an American Pre-Code action drama film directed by Alfred Santell and starring Charles Farrell, Elissa Landi, Humphrey Bogart, and Myrna Loy. The story, adapted from the stage play Squadrons by Elliott White Springs and A.E. Thomas, depicts Royal Air Force pilots in World War

rows.title: Border Law
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Jim Mason, Lupita Tovar
rows.extract: Border Law is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film directed by Louis King and starring Buck Jones. The film was remade as Whistlin' Dan (1932) and again with Buck Jones as The Fighting Ranger (1934).

rows.title: Born to Love
rows.cast: Joel McCrea, Constance Bennett, Paul Cavanagh
rows.extract: Born to Love is a 1931 American pre-Code melodrama film, directed by Paul L. Stein from an original screenplay by Ernest Pascal. rows.title: Bought
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Ben Lyon, Ray Milland
rows.extract: Bought is a 1931 American Pre-Code drama film produced and released by Warner Bros. and directed by Archie Mayo. The movie stars Constance Bennett and features Ben Lyon, Richard Bennett and Dorothy Peterson. It is based on the 1930 novel Jackdaw's Strut by Harriet Henry.

rows.title: Branded
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Wallace MacDonald
rows.extract: Branded is a 1931 American Pre-Code Western film directed by D. Ross Lederman.

rows.title: Branded Men
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, June Clyde, Irving Bacon
rows.extract: Branded Men is a 1931 American pre-Code Western comedy film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Ken Maynard. It was produced and distributed by Tiffany Pictures.

rows.cast: Sally O'Neil, Alan Dinehart
rows.extract: The Brat is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by John Ford, starring Sally O'Neil, and featuring Virginia Cherrill. The film is based on the 1917 play by Maude Fulton. rows.title: Broadminded
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Marjorie White, Bela Lugosi
rows.extract: Broadminded is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Mervyn LeRoy and starring Joe E. Brown.

rows.title: Captain Applejack
rows.cast: Mary Brian, Kay Strozzi, John Halliday
rows.extract: Captain Applejack is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy film, produced and distributed by Warner Brothers. rows.title: Caught
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Louise Dresser
rows.extract: Caught is a 1931 American Pre-Code Western film directed by Edward Sloman and written by Agnes Brand Leahy and Keene Thompson. The film stars Richard Arlen, Louise Dresser, Frances Dee, Tom Kennedy, and Syd Saylor. The film was released on August 8, 1931, by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Caught Cheating
rows.cast: Charles Murray, Dorothy Christy
rows.extract: Caught Cheating is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Frank R. Strayer from a screenplay by W. Scott Darling. The film stars Charles Murray, George Sidney, and Nita Martan, and it was released by Tiffany Productions on January 31, 1931.

rows.title: Caught Plastered
rows.cast: Bert Wheeler, Robert Woolsey, Dorothy Lee
rows.extract: Caught Plastered is a 1931 American Pre-Code musical comedy film, released by RKO Radio Pictures and starring the comedy team Wheeler & Woolsey.

rows.title: Cavalier of the West
rows.cast: Harry Carey, Carmen Laroux, Kane Richmond
rows.extract: Cavalier of the West is a 1931 American Western film written and directed by John P. McCarthy. rows.title: The Champ
rows.cast: Wallace Beery, Jackie Cooper, Irene Rich
rows.extract: The Champ is a 1931 American pre-Code film starring Wallace Beery and Jackie Cooper and directed by King Vidor from a screenplay by Frances Marion, Leonard Praskins and Wanda Tuchock. rows.title: Chances
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Rose Hobart, Anthony Bushell
rows.extract: Chances is a 1931 American pre-Code war drama film directed by Allan Dwan and starring Douglas Fairbanks, Jr. It is based on the 1930 novel by A. Hamilton Gibbs.

rows.cast: Warner Oland, John Garrick
rows.extract: Charlie Chan Carries On is a 1931 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and starring Warner Oland, John Garrick and Marguerite Churchill. rows.title: The Cheat
rows.cast: Tallulah Bankhead, Harvey Stephens
rows.extract: The Cheat is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Abbott and starring Tallulah Bankhead and Harvey Stephens. The film is a remake of the 1915 silent film of the same title, directed by Cecil B. DeMille.

rows.title: The Cheyenne Cyclone
rows.cast: Lane Chandler, Marie Quillan, Frankie Darro
rows.extract: The Cheyenne Cyclone is a 1931 American Western film directed by Armand Schaefer and starring Lane Chandler, Marie Quillan and Frankie Darro. It is a remake of the 1928 silent film Phantom of the Range.

rows.title: Children of Dreams
rows.cast: Tom Patricola, Marion Byron
rows.extract: Children of Dreams is a 1931 American pre-Code musical operetta drama film photographed entirely in Part Technicolor and produced and distributed by Warner Bros.

rows.title: Chinatown After Dark
rows.cast: Carmel Myers, Rex Lease, Barbara Kent
rows.extract: Chinatown After Dark is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Stuart Paton and starring Carmel Myers, Rex Lease and Barbara Kent.

rows.title: Cimarron
rows.cast: Irene Dunne, Richard Dix, Estelle Taylor
rows.extract: Cimarron is a 1931 pre-Code epic Western film directed by Wesley Ruggles, starring Richard Dix and Irene Dunne, and featuring Estelle Taylor and Roscoe Ates. rows.title: The Cisco Kid
rows.cast: Warner Baxter, Edmund Lowe
rows.extract: The Cisco Kid is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film directed by Irving Cummings and starring Warner Baxter. rows.title: City Lights
rows.cast: Charles Chaplin, Virginia Cherrill
rows.extract: City Lights is a 1931 American silent romantic comedy-drama film written, produced, directed by, and starring Charlie Chaplin. The story follows the misadventures of Chaplin's Tramp as he falls in love with a blind girl and develops a turbulent friendship with an alcoholic millionaire.

rows.title: City Streets
rows.cast: Gary Cooper, Sylvia Sidney, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: City Streets is a 1931 American Pre-Code film noir that is directed by Rouben Mamoulian from a story by Dashiell Hammett and stars Gary Cooper, Sylvia Sidney and Paul Lukas.

rows.title: Clearing the Range
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Sally Eilers, Hooper Atchley
rows.extract: Clearing the Range is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film starring Hoot Gibson and his then wife Sally Eilers. Directed by Otto Brower, it was the first film released by the Poverty Row studio Allied Pictures. Gibson remade the film in 1933 as The Dude Bandit.

rows.title: Command Performance
rows.cast: Neil Hamilton, Una Merkel, Helen Ware
rows.extract: Command Performance is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Walter Lang.

rows.title: The Common Law
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Joel McCrea, Hedda Hopper
rows.extract: The Common Law is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic drama film, directed by Paul L. Stein and produced by Charles R. Rogers. Based on Robert W. rows.title: Compromised
rows.cast: Rose Hobart, Ben Lyon
rows.extract: Compromised (1931) is an all-talking pre-code drama film produced and released by First National Pictures, a subsidiary of Warner Bros., and directed by John G. Adolfi. The film stars Rose Hobart, Ben Lyon, Claude Gillingwater and Florence Britton. It was based on a play by Edith Fitzgerald. this fi

rows.title: Confessions of a Co-Ed
rows.cast: Phillips Holmes, Sylvia Sidney, Claudia Dell
rows.extract: Confessions of a Co-Ed is a 1931 American drama film starring Phillips Holmes, Sylvia Sidney and Norman Foster, and featuring a rare onscreen appearance by the musical Rhythm Boys. rows.title: A Connecticut Yankee
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Maureen O'Sullivan, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: A Connecticut Yankee is a 1931 American Pre-Code film adaptation of Mark Twain's 1889 novel, A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court. rows.title: The Conquering Horde
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Fay Wray
rows.extract: The Conquering Horde is a 1931 American pre-Code Western directed by Edward Sloman and written by Emerson Hough, Grover Jones and William Slavens McNutt. rows.title: Consolation Marriage
rows.cast: Irene Dunne, Pat O'Brien, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: Consolation Marriage is a 1931 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Paul Sloane and written by Humphrey Pearson. The film stars Irene Dunne, Pat O'Brien, John Halliday, Myrna Loy, and Matt Moore. The film was released on November 21, 1931, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Convicted
rows.cast: Aileen Pringle, Jameson Thomas
rows.extract: Convicted is a 1931 American pre-Code film directed by Christy Cabanne and starring Aileen Pringle and Jameson Thomas.

rows.title: Corsair
rows.cast: Chester Morris, Thelma Todd, Fred Kohler
rows.extract: Corsair is a 1931 American pre-Code crime drama written, produced and directed by Roland West. The film is based on the 1931 novel Corsair, a Pirate in White Flannels by Walton Green and takes place in and was shot during the era of Prohibition in the United States. The film stars Chester Morris and

rows.title: Cracked Nuts
rows.cast: Bert Wheeler, Dorothy Lee
rows.extract: Cracked Nuts is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Edward F. Cline, from an original screenplay written by Al Boasberg and Ralph Spence. rows.extract: The Criminal Code is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic crime drama film directed by Howard Hawks and starring Walter Huston and Phillips Holmes. rows.cast: Lupe Vélez, Lawrence Tibbett, Jimmy Durante

rows.title: Daddy Long Legs
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Warner Baxter, Una Merkel
rows.extract: Daddy Long Legs (1931) is an American pre-Code film directed by Alfred Santell and starring Janet Gaynor and Warner Baxter. The story involves an orphan who is taken under the wing of a wealthy benefactor.

rows.cast: June Collyer, Charles Starrett, Betty Garde

rows.cast: Joan Crawford, Lester Vail, Clark Gable
rows.extract: Dance, Fools, Dance is a 1931 pre-Code Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer drama film starring Joan Crawford, Clark Gable, and Lester Vail in a story about a reporter investigating the murder of a colleague. Story and dialogue were created by Aurania Rouverol, and the film was directed by Harry Beaumont. Dance, Foo

rows.title: Dancing Dynamite
rows.cast: Richard Talmadge, Blanche Mehaffey, Robert Ellis
rows.extract: Dancing Dynamite is a 1931 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Noel M. Smith. It premiered in New York on 18 August 1931, and was distributed by State Rights and Mercury Pictures. Dancing Dynamite was filmed on location at Santa Catalina Island.

rows.cast: Jack Holt, Ralph Graves, Sally Blane
rows.extract:
A Dangerous Affair is a 1931 American pre-Code 
mystery film directed by Edward Sedgwick and starring Jack Holt, Ralph Graves and Sally Blane.

rows.extract: Daughter of the Dragon is a 1931 American pre-Code crime mystery film directed by Lloyd Corrigan, released by Paramount Pictures, and starring Anna May Wong as Princess Ling Moy, Sessue Hayakawa as Ah Kee, and Warner Oland as Dr. Fu Manchu. The film was made to capitalize on Sax Rohmer's then curren

rows.title: Daybreak
rows.cast: Ramon Novarro, Helen Chandler, Jean Hersholt
rows.extract: Daybreak is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Jacques Feyder and written by Cyril Hume and Ruth Cummings. The film stars Ramon Novarro, Helen Chandler, Jean Hersholt, C. Aubrey Smith, William Bakewell and Karen Morley. The film was released on May 2, 1931, by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

rows.title: The Deadline
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Robert Ellis
rows.extract: The Deadline is a 1931 American pre-Code western film directed by Lambert Hillyer and starring Buck Jones and Robert Ellis. It was produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures.

rows.cast: Lloyd Hughes, Dorothy Sebastian
rows.extract: The Deceiver is a 1931 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Louis King. It was written by Jack Cunningham, based on a short story called "It Might Have Happened" by Bella Muni and Abem Finkel. The film stars Lloyd Hughes, Ian Keith and Dorothy Sebastian. John Wayne makes a minor appearance as

rows.title: Defenders of the Law
rows.cast: Catherine Dale Owen, Edmund Breese, Mae Busch
rows.extract: Defenders of the Law is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film directed by Joseph Levering and starring Catherine Dale Owen, John Holland and Robert Gleckler.

rows.title: Delicious
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Charles Farrell, Virginia Cherrill
rows.extract: Delicious (1931) is an American pre-Code Gershwin musical romantic comedy film starring Janet Gaynor and Charles Farrell, directed by David Butler, with color sequences in Multicolor.

rows.title: Demon of the Sea
rows.cast: William Dieterle, Lissy Arna
rows.extract: Demon of the Sea is a lost 1931 film directed by Michael Curtiz and William Dieterle.

rows.title: Desert Vengeance
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Barbara Bedford
rows.extract: Desert Vengeance is a 1931 American western film directed by Louis King and starring Buck Jones, Barbara Bedford and Douglas Gilmore. It was produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures.

rows.extract: The Devil Plays is a 1931 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Jameson Thomas, Florence Britton and Thomas E. Jackson. It was given a British release under the alternative title of The Murdock Affair.

rows.cast: Ann Harding, Leslie Howard
rows.extract: Devotion (1931) is an American pre-Code romantic drama film starring Ann Harding and Leslie Howard based on the 1930 Pamela Wynne novel A Little Flat in the Temple. Its plot involves a woman who disguises herself and gains employment in the home of the man she loves.

rows.cast: Jack Holt, Fay Wray, Ralph Graves
rows.extract: Dirigible is a 1931 American pre-Code adventure film directed by Frank Capra for Columbia Pictures and starring Jack Holt, Ralph Graves and Fay Wray. The picture focuses on the competition between naval fixed-wing and airship pilots to reach the South Pole by air.

rows.title: Dishonored
rows.cast: Marlene Dietrich, Victor McLaglen, Warner Oland
rows.extract: Dishonored is a 1931 pre-Code romantic spy film about a female spy for Austria-Hungary during World War I. rows.cast: Warner Baxter, Joan Bennett, Victor Varconi

rows.title: Don't Bet on Women
rows.cast: Jeanette MacDonald, Edmund Lowe, Roland Young
rows.extract: Don't Bet on Women is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by William K. Howard and starring Edmund Lowe, Jeanette MacDonald and Roland Young.

rows.cast: Fredric March, Miriam Hopkins, Rose Hobart

rows.cast: Bela Lugosi, Helen Chandler, David Manners
rows.extract: Dracula is a 1931 American pre-Code supernatural horror film directed and co-produced by Tod Browning from a screenplay written by Garrett Fort and starring Bela Lugosi in the titular role. rows.title: Dragnet Patrol
rows.cast: Glenn Tryon, Vera Reynolds, Marjorie Beebe
rows.extract: Dragnet Patrol is a 1931 American Pre-Code melodrama film directed by Frank R. Strayer from a script by W. Scott Darling. The film stars Glenn Tryon, Vera Reynolds, and Marjorie Beebe, and was released by Action Pictures on December 15, 1931.

rows.title: The Drums of Jeopardy
rows.cast: Warner Oland, June Collyer, Hale Hamilton
rows.extract: The Drums of Jeopardy is a 1931 American pre-Code horror film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Warner Oland, June Collyer and Lloyd Hughes. It is the second film adaptation of Harold McGrath's novel of the same name, and stars Oland as Dr. Boris Karlov.

rows.cast: Rose Hobart, Charles Bickford, Lupita Tovar

rows.cast: Robert Armstrong, Jean Arthur
rows.extract: Ex-Bad Boy is a 1931 American comedy film directed by Vin Moore and written by Fred Niblo, Jr. and Dale Van Every. rows.extract: Expensive Women is a 1931 American pre-Code film drama. It was produced by First National Pictures and distributed through their parent company Warner Bros. rows.cast: Edna May Oliver, Helen Chandler, Rochelle Hudson
rows.extract: Fanny Foley Herself is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy-drama film shot entirely in Technicolor. rows.cast: Leon Janney, Irene Rich, Lewis Stone
rows.extract: Father's Son is a 1931 American pre-Code melodrama film which was produced by Warner Bros. in 1930 and released early in 1931. The movie is based on the original film scenario Old Fathers and Young Sons by Booth Tarkington. The film is also known by the name "Boy of Mine."

rows.cast: Jack Holt, Richard Cromwell
rows.extract: Fifty Fathoms Deep is a 1931 American pre-Code adventure film directed by Roy William Neill starring Jack Holt, Mary Doran and Richard Cromwell. It was produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures.

rows.cast: Ole Olsen, Chic Johnson, William Gaxton
rows.extract: Fifty Million Frenchmen is a 1931 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by Lloyd Bacon. It was photographed entirely in Technicolor. The film was produced and released by Warner Brothers, and was based on Cole Porter's 1929 Broadway musical Fifty Million Frenchmen.

rows.title: Finn and Hattie
rows.cast: Leon Errol, ZaSu Pitts
rows.extract: Finn and Hattie is a 1931 American comedic pre-Code film directed by Norman Taurog, starring Leon Errol, Mitzi Green and ZaSu Pitts.

rows.title: First Aid
rows.cast: Grant Withers, Marjorie Beebe
rows.extract: First Aid is a 1931 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Stuart Paton. Produced by Ralph M. rows.cast: Marion Davies, Leslie Howard, Irene Rich
rows.extract: Five and Ten is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic drama film directed by an uncredited Robert Z. Leonard and starring Marion Davies, Leslie Howard and Irene Rich. rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, H. B. Warner, Marian Marsh

Robinson, Aline MacMahon and Boris Karloff. The screenplay was by Robert Lord and Byron Morgan based on the 1930 play of the same name by Louis Weitzenkorn.

rows.title: The Flood
rows.cast: Eleanor Boardman, Monte Blue
rows.extract: The Flood is a 1931 pre-Code American melodrama film directed by James Tinling from a story by John Thomas Neville. Sam Nelson was assistant director. Produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures, the film was released in the US on 28 February 1931.

rows.extract: Forbidden Adventure, also known as Newly Rich, is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Norman Taurog and starring Mitzi Green, Edna May Oliver, Louise Fazenda and Jackie Searl. rows.title: Forgotten Women
rows.cast: Marion Shilling, Beryl Mercer, Edna Murphy
rows.extract: Forgotten Women is a 1931 American drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Marion Shilling, Beryl Mercer and Rex Bell. It was distributed by Monogram Pictures, one of the leading studios outside the majors.

rows.title: A Free Soul
rows.cast: Norma Shearer, Lionel Barrymore, Clark Gable
rows.extract: A Free Soul is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film that tells the story of an alcoholic San Francisco defense attorney who must defend his daughter's ex-boyfriend on a charge of murdering the mobster she had started a relationship with, who he had previously gotten an acquittal for on a murder charg

rows.title: Freighters of Destiny
rows.cast: Tom Keene, Barbara Kent
rows.extract: Freighters of Destiny is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film produced and directed by film editor Fred Allen, from a screenplay by Adele Buffington. rows.title: Friends and Lovers
rows.cast: Lili Damita, Adolphe Menjou, Laurence Olivier
rows.extract: Friends and Lovers is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film released by RKO Radio Pictures, directed by Victor Schertzinger, and starring Adolphe Menjou, Lili Damita, Laurence Olivier, Erich von Stroheim, and Hugh Herbert.

rows.extract: The Gay Diplomat is a 1931 American film. Directed by Richard Boleslawski for RKO Radio Pictures, it starred Ivan Lebedeff, Genevieve Tobin and Betty Compson.

rows.extract: Gentleman's Fate is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Mervyn LeRoy and written by Leonard Praskins. rows.title: The Girl Habit
