rows.title: Goldie
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Jean Harlow
rows.extract: Goldie is a 1931 American pre-Code black-and-white romantic comedy film starring Warren Hymer, Spencer Tracy and Jean Harlow. The script was written by Paul Perez and Gene Towne, and directed by Benjamin Stoloff. It was made before the Hays Code was rigidly enforced. It is a remake of Howard Hawks'

rows.title: The Good Bad Girl
rows.cast: Mae Clarke, James Hall, Marie Prevost
rows.extract: The Good Bad Girl is a 1931 American romance film based on a novel by Winifred Van Duzer.

rows.title: Good Sport
rows.cast: Linda Watkins, John Boles, Greta Nissen
rows.extract: Good Sport is a 1931 American comedy film directed by Kenneth MacKenna and written by William Hurlbut. The film stars Linda Watkins, John Boles, Greta Nissen, Minna Gombell, Hedda Hopper and Alan Dinehart. The film was released on December 13, 1931, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Graft
rows.cast: Regis Toomey, Boris Karloff, Dorothy Revier
rows.extract: Graft is a 1931 American pre-Code thriller film, directed by Christy Cabanne, starring Regis Toomey and future talent agent Sue Carol, and featuring Boris Karloff, who appeared in Frankenstein during the same year.

rows.title: The Great Lover
rows.cast: Adolphe Menjou, Irene Dunne, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: The Great Lover is a 1931 American pre-Code film starring Adolphe Menjou and Irene Dunne, and directed by Harry Beaumont. The supporting cast includes Ernest Torrence and Baclanova.

rows.title: The Great Meadow
rows.cast: Johnny Mack Brown, Eleanor Boardman, Anita Louise
rows.extract: The Great Meadow is a 1931 American Pre-Code adventure film, produced and distributed by MGM with direction by Charles Brabin. The film starred Eleanor Boardman and Johnny Mack Brown. It is based on the novel The Great Meadow by Elizabeth Madox Roberts, which is similar in theme to Drums Along the M

rows.title: Grief Street
rows.cast: Barbara Kent, John Holland, Dorothy Christy
rows.extract: Grief Street is a 1931 American pre-Code mystery crime film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Barbara Kent and John Holland. It was produced and distributed by the Chesterfield Motion Pictures Corporation.

rows.title: The Guardsman
rows.cast: Alfred Lunt, Lynn Fontanne, Roland Young
rows.extract: The Guardsman is a 1931 American pre-Code film based on the play Testőr by Ferenc Molnár. It stars Alfred Lunt, Lynn Fontanne, Roland Young and ZaSu Pitts. It opens with a stage re-enactment of the final scene of Maxwell Anderson's Elizabeth the Queen, with Fontanne as Elizabeth and Lunt as the Earl

rows.title: The Guilty Generation
rows.cast: Leo Carillo, Constance Cummings, Robert Young
rows.extract: The Guilty Generation is a 1931 American pre-code crime film directed by Rowland V. Lee and starring Leo Carrillo, Constance Cummings and Robert Young.

rows.title: Guilty Hands
rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, Kay Francis, Polly Moran
rows.extract: Guilty Hands is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film starring Lionel Barrymore, Kay Francis and Madge Evans and directed by W. S. Van Dyke, with uncredited assistance from Barrymore. The story concerns an attorney who murders a man who wants to marry his daughter.

rows.title: Gun Smoke
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Mary Brian, William Boyd
rows.extract: Gun Smoke is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film directed by Edward Sloman and written by Grover Jones and William Slavens McNutt. The film stars Richard Arlen, Mary Brian, Eugene Pallette, and William "Stage" Boyd. The film was released on April 11, 1931, by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Hard Hombre
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Lina Basquette
rows.extract: The Hard Hombre is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film directed by Otto Brower and starring rodeo champion Hoot Gibson. The film follows a simpleton rancher who is mistaken for a notorious outlaw known as The Hard Hombre.

rows.title: The Hawk
rows.cast: Norman Kerry, Nina Quartero, Frank Mayo
rows.extract: The Hawk is a 1931 American independent Western film directed by Jacques Jaccard and starring Norman Kerry, Nina Quartero and Frank Mayo. Given a limited initial release, it was re-edited and re-released under the alternative title The Phantom of Santa Fe in 1936.

rows.title: Heartbreak
rows.cast: Charles Farrell, Madge Evans, Paul Cavanagh
rows.extract: Heartbreak is a 1931 American Pre-Code war drama film directed by Alfred L. Werker and starring Charles Farrell, Madge Evans and Paul Cavanagh. The film was set primarily in Italy as an exotic locale but was actually filmed in California with the San Gabriel Mountains east of the Los Angeles Basin,

rows.title: Heaven on Earth
rows.cast: Lew Ayres, Anita Louise
rows.extract: Heaven on Earth is a 1931 American dramatic film directed by Russell Mack, based on the 1929 novel, Mississippi, by author Ben Lucien Burman. The film stars Lew Ayres as the estranged son of a Mississippi steamboat captain.

rows.title: Hell-Bent for Frisco
rows.cast: Charles Delaney, Vera Reynolds, Carroll Nye
rows.extract: Hell-Bent for Frisco is a 1931 American pre-Code action film directed by Stuart Paton and starring Charles Delaney, Vera Reynolds and Carroll Nye.

rows.title: Hell Bound
rows.cast: Leo Carrillo, Lloyd Hughes, Lola Lane
rows.extract: Hell Bound is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Walter Lang.

rows.title: Hell Divers
rows.cast: Wallace Beery, Clark Gable, Conrad Nagel
rows.extract: Hell Divers is a 1932 American pre-Code black-and-white film from Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer starring Wallace Beery and Clark Gable as a pair of competing chief petty officers in early naval aviation. The film, made with the cooperation of the United States Navy, features considerable footage of flight ope

rows.title: Her Majesty, Love
rows.cast: Marilyn Miller, Ben Lyon
rows.extract: Her Majesty, Love is a 1931 American pre-Code musical comedy drama film directed by William Dieterle for First National Pictures, starring Broadway stars Marilyn Miller and Ben Lyon, and in his talking feature debut, W. C. Fields.

rows.title: High Stakes
rows.cast: Mae Murray, Karen Morley
rows.extract: High Stakes is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy drama produced and released by RKO Pictures. The picture was directed by Lowell Sherman who also stars and marks the last starring screen appearance of silent screen diva Mae Murray. It is based on a 1924 Broadway play that starred Sherman playing the s

rows.title: His Woman
rows.cast: Gary Cooper, Claudette Colbert
rows.extract: His Woman is a 1931 American pre-Code romance drama film directed by Edward Sloman and starring Gary Cooper and Claudette Colbert. Based on the novel His Woman by Dale Collins, the story is about a tough sea captain who discovers a baby aboard his freighter and hires a tramp, masquerading as a missi

rows.title: A Holy Terror
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Sally Eilers, Humphrey Bogart
rows.extract: A Holy Terror is a 1931 American pre-Code Western movie starring George O'Brien, Sally Eilers, Rita La Roy, and Humphrey Bogart. The film is an adaptation by Ralph Block, Alfred A. Cohn, and Myron C. Fagan of the novel Trailin'! by Max Brand. It was directed by Irving Cummings.

rows.title: The Homicide Squad
rows.cast: Leo Carrillo, Mary Brian, Noah Beery
rows.extract: The Homicide Squad is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film directed by George Melford and Edward L. Cahn and written by John Thomas Neville, Charles Logue and Tom Reed. It is based on a 1928 Henry La Cossitt short story that originally ran in Adventure magazine. The film stars Leo Carrillo, Noah Beer

rows.title: Honeymoon Lane
rows.cast: June Collyer, Raymond Hatton
rows.extract: Honeymoon Lane is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by William James Craft and starring Eddie Dowling, June Collyer, Raymond Hatton. The film was released on July 25, 1931, by Paramount Pictures. It is based on the 1926 Broadway musical of the same title by Dowling and James F. Hanley.

rows.title: Honor Among Lovers
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Fredric March, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: Honor Among Lovers is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film made by Paramount Pictures, directed by Dorothy Arzner. The film stars Claudette Colbert, Fredric March, Monroe Owsley, Charles Ruggles and Ginger Rogers.

rows.title: Honor of the Family
rows.cast: Bebe Daniels, Warren William, Alan Mowbray
rows.extract: Honor of the Family is a 1931 American Pre-Code drama film released by First National Pictures, starring Bebe Daniels and Warren William. It was based on the play by Emil Fabre, from the Honoré de Balzac novel, La Rabouilleuse.

rows.title: The Hot Heiress
rows.cast: Ben Lyon, Ona Munson, Walter Pidgeon
rows.extract: The Hot Heiress is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Clarence G. Badger and written by Herbert Fields, with three songs by Richard Rodgers and Lorenz Hart. The film stars Ben Lyon, Ona Munson, Walter Pidgeon, Tom Dugan, Holmes Herbert and Inez Courtney. The film was released by Warner

rows.title: A House Divided
rows.cast: Walter Huston, Helen Chandler
rows.extract: A House Divided is a 1931 American Pre-Code drama film directed by William Wyler and starring Walter Huston, Douglass Montgomery and Helen Chandler. It was produced and released by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Huckleberry Finn
rows.cast: Jackie Coogan, Junior Durkin
rows.extract: Huckleberry Finn is a 1931 American pre-Code adventure comedy film directed by Norman Taurog, and written by Grover Jones and William Slavens McNutt, based on Mark Twain's 1884 novel The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn. It stars Jackie Coogan as Tom Sawyer, Mitzi Green as Becky Thatcher, Junior Durki

rows.title: Husband's Holiday
rows.cast: Clive Brook, Vivienne Osborne, Charles Ruggles
rows.extract: Husband's Holiday is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Robert Milton and written by Ernest Pascal and Viola Brothers Shore. The film stars Clive Brook, Vivienne Osborne, Charlie Ruggles, Juliette Compton, Harry Bannister, Dorothy Tree and Adrienne Ames. The film was released on Decembe

rows.title: Hush Money
rows.cast: Joan Bennett, Myrna Loy, George Raft
rows.extract: Hush Money is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy-drama film featuring Joan Bennett, Hardie Albright, Owen Moore, Myrna Loy, and George Raft. The movie was directed by Sidney Lanfield.

rows.title: I Like Your Nerve
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Loretta Young, Claud Allister
rows.extract: I Like Your Nerve is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by William C. McGann, starring Douglas Fairbanks, Jr. and Loretta Young. Boris Karloff has a small role.

rows.title: I Take This Woman
rows.cast: Gary Cooper, Carole Lombard, Helen Ware
rows.extract: I Take This Woman is a 1931 American pre-Code romance film directed by Marion Gering and starring Gary Cooper and Carole Lombard.

rows.title: Illicit
rows.cast: Barbara Stanwyck, James Rennie, Ricardo Cortez
rows.extract: Illicit is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Archie Mayo and starring Barbara Stanwyck, James Rennie, Ricardo Cortez, and Natalie Moorhead. Based on a play by Edith Fitzgerald and Robert Riskin, the film is about a young couple living together out of wedlock because the woman does not

rows.title: In Line of Duty
rows.cast: Sue Carol, Noah Beery
rows.extract: In Line of Duty is a 1931 American Western film directed by Bert Glennon and starring Sue Carol, Noah Beery and Francis McDonald. It was one of the earliest releases of Trem Carr's Monogram Pictures. It is now considered a lost film.

rows.title: In Old Cheyenne
rows.cast: Rex Lease, Dorothy Gulliver
rows.extract: In Old Cheyenne is a 1931 Western film directed by Stuart Paton. It is a re-make of the 1930 film Phantom of the Desert.

rows.title: Indiscreet
rows.cast: Gloria Swanson, Ben Lyon, Monroe Owsley
rows.extract: Indiscreet is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Leo McCarey and starring Gloria Swanson and Ben Lyon. The screenplay by Buddy G. DeSylva, Lew Brown, and Ray Henderson, based on their story Obey That Impulse, originally was written as a full-fledged musical, but only two songs – "If Yo

rows.title: Inspiration
rows.cast: Greta Garbo, Robert Montgomery, Lewis Stone
rows.extract: Inspiration is a 1931 American pre-Code Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer romantic melodrama film adapted by Gene Markey from the Alphonse Daudet short novel Sappho (1884). The film stars Greta Garbo, Robert Montgomery, Lewis Stone and Marjorie Rambeau. It was directed by Clarence Brown and produced by Irving Tha

rows.title: Iron Man
rows.cast: Lew Ayres, Robert Armstrong, Jean Harlow
rows.extract: Iron Man is a 1931 American pre-Code sports drama film directed by Tod Browning and starring Lew Ayres and Jean Harlow. In 1951, Universal remade the film with Jeff Chandler, Evelyn Keyes and Rock Hudson, directed by Joseph Pevney.

rows.title: Is There Justice?
rows.cast: Rex Lease, Henry B. Walthall, Blanche Mehaffey
rows.extract: Is There Justice? is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film directed by Stuart Paton and starring Rex Lease, Henry B. Walthall and Blanche Mehaffey. It is now considered a lost film.

rows.title: It Pays to Advertise
rows.cast: Norman Foster, Carole Lombard
rows.extract: It Pays to Advertise is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film, based on the play of the same name by Roi Cooper Megrue and Walter C. Hackett, starring Norman Foster and Carole Lombard, and directed by Frank Tuttle.

rows.title: It's a Wise Child
rows.cast: Marion Davies, Sidney Blackmer, James Gleason
rows.extract: It's a Wise Child is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Robert Z. Leonard and written by Laurence E. Johnson. The film stars Marion Davies, Sidney Blackmer, James Gleason, Polly Moran and Lester Vail. The film was released on April 11, 1931, by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

rows.title: June Moon
rows.cast: Frances Dee, June MacCloy, Wynne Gibson
rows.extract: June Moon is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy film based upon the play of the same name by George S. Kaufman and Ring Lardner. It was adapted by Vincent Lawrence, Joseph L. Mankiewicz and Keene Thompson and directed by A. Edward Sutherland. It stars Jack Oakie, Frances Dee, Wynne Gibson, Harry Akst a

rows.title: Just a Gigolo
rows.cast: William Haines, Irene Purcell, Ray Milland
rows.extract: Just a Gigolo is a 1931 American Pre-Code romantic comedy film released by MGM. It was directed by Jack Conway, produced by Irving Thalberg and starred William Haines, Irene Purcell, C. Aubrey Smith, and Ray Milland. It was adapted from the 1930 play of the same name, which also starred Irene Purcel

rows.title: Kept Husbands
rows.cast: Dorothy Mackaill, Joel McCrea, Clara Kimball Young
rows.extract: Kept Husbands is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Lloyd Bacon, starring Dorothy Mackaill and Joel McCrea, with major supporting roles filled by Robert McWade, Florence Roberts and Mary Carr. The original story was written by the film's associate producer, Louis Sarecky, and adapted fo

rows.title: Kick In
rows.cast: Clara Bow, Regis Toomey, Wynne Gibson
rows.extract: Kick In is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film produced by Famous Players-Lasky and distributed by Paramount Pictures. The film, based on the 1914 Broadway play by Willard Mack which had starred John Barrymore, was directed by Richard Wallace and starred the legendary Clara Bow in her last film for

rows.title: Kiki
rows.cast: Mary Pickford, Reginald Denny
rows.extract: Kiki is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic comedy, starring Mary Pickford and Reginald Denny, which was directed by Sam Taylor. It was based upon the David Belasco play of the same name. The film is a remake of the 1926 version starring Norma Talmadge.

rows.title: Kiss Me Again
rows.cast: Edward Everett Horton, June Collyer, Walter Pidgeon
rows.extract: Kiss Me Again  is a 1931 American Pre-Code musical operetta film filmed entirely in Technicolor. It was originally released in the United States as Toast of the Legion late in 1930, but was quickly withdrawn when Warner Bros. realized that the public had grown weary of musicals. The Warner Bros. bel

rows.title: L'aviateur
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Jeanne Helbling

rows.title: La ley del harem
rows.cast: José Mojica, Carmen Larrabeiti

rows.title: Ladies' Man
rows.cast: William Powell, Carole Lombard, Kay Francis
rows.extract: Ladies' Man is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Lothar Mendes, starring William Powell, Kay Francis and Carole Lombard. It was released on May 9, 1931 by Paramount.

rows.title: Ladies of the Big House
rows.cast: Sylvia Sidney, Gene Raymond, Wynne Gibson
rows.extract: Ladies of the Big House is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Marion Gering and written by Ernest Booth, William Slavens McNutt and Grover Jones. The film stars Sylvia Sidney, Gene Raymond, Wynne Gibson, Earle Foxe, Rockliffe Fellowes, Purnell Pratt and Frank Sheridan. The film was rele

rows.title: The Lady from Nowhere
rows.cast: Alice Day, John Holland
rows.extract: The Lady from Nowhere is a 1931 American crime film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Alice Day, John Holland and Phillips Smalley.

rows.title: The Lady Refuses
rows.cast: Betty Compson, John Darrow, Margaret Livingston
rows.extract: The Lady Refuses is a 1931 American pre-Code melodrama film, directed by George Archainbaud, from a screenplay by Wallace Smith, based on an original story by Guy Bolton and Robert Milton. It stars Betty Compson as a destitute young woman on the verge of becoming a prostitute, who is hired by a weal

rows.title: The Lady Who Dared
rows.cast: Billie Dove, Sidney Blackmer
rows.extract: The Lady Who Dared is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by William Beaudine and starring Billie Dove, Sidney Blackmer and Conway Tearle.

rows.title: Land of Wanted Men
rows.cast: Bill Cody, Sheila Bromley
rows.extract: Land of Wanted Men is a 1931 American Western film directed by Harry L. Fraser and starring Bill Cody, Sheila Bromley and Gibson Gowland.

rows.title: Lasca of the Rio Grande
rows.cast: Leo Carrillo, Dorothy Burgess
rows.extract: Lasca of the Rio Grande is a 1931 American pre-Code film based on the poem "Lasca" by Frank Desprez.

rows.title: The Last Flight
rows.cast: Richard Barthelmess, David Manners, Helen Chandler
rows.extract: The Last Flight is a 1931 American pre-Code ensemble cast film, starring Richard Barthelmess, David Manners, John Mack Brown and Helen Chandler. It was directed by German filmmaker William Dieterle in his debut as an English-language film director.

rows.title: The Last Parade
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Tom Moore, Constance Cummings
rows.extract: The Last Parade is a 1931 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Erle C. Kenton and starring Jack Holt, Tom Moore and Constance Cummings.

rows.title: The Last Ride
rows.cast: Dorothy Revier, Virginia Brown Faire
rows.extract: The Last Ride is a 1931 American crime film directed by Duke Worne and starring Dorothy Revier, Virginia Brown Faire and Charles Morton.

rows.title: Laugh and Get Rich
rows.cast: Hugh Herbert, Edna May Oliver, Dorothy Lee
rows.extract: Laugh and Get Rich is a 1931 pre-Code American comedy film, directed by Gregory La Cava, from a screenplay he also wrote with contributions from Douglas MacLean, who also was the associate producer, and Ralph Spence. The film stars Dorothy Lee, Edna May Oliver, Hugh Herbert, and Russell Gleason, and

rows.title: Laughing Sinners
rows.cast: Joan Crawford, Neil Hamilton, Clark Gable
rows.extract: Laughing Sinners is a 1931 American pre-Code Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer feature film starring Joan Crawford and Clark Gable in a story about a cafe entertainer who experiences spiritual redemption. The dialogue by Martin Flavin was based upon the play Torch Song by Kenyon Nicholson. The film was directed b

rows.title: The Law of the Sea
rows.cast: William Farnum, Sally Blane
rows.extract: The Law of the Sea is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Otto Brower, and starring William Farnum, Sally Blane and Rex Bell, as well as Priscilla Dean in one of her last films. Produced by Chadwick Pictures and originally distributed through Monogram Pictures, the film has had several v

rows.title: The Law of the Tong
rows.cast: Phyllis Barrington, John Harron
rows.extract: The Law of the Tong is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film directed by Lewis D. Collins and starring Phyllis Barrington, John Harron and Jason Robards Sr.

rows.title: The Lawless Woman
rows.cast: Vera Reynolds, Carroll Nye
rows.extract: The Lawless Woman is a 1931 American crime film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Vera Reynolds, Carroll Nye and Thomas E. Jackson.

rows.title: The Lawyer's Secret
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Jean Arthur, Clive Brook
rows.extract: The Lawyer's Secret is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film directed by Louis J. Gasnier and Max Marcin and written by Lloyd Corrigan, James Hilary Finn, and Max Marcin. The film stars Clive Brook, Charles "Buddy" Rogers, Richard Arlen, Fay Wray, Jean Arthur, Francis McDonald, and Harold Goodwin. The

rows.title: Left Over Ladies
rows.cast: Claudia Dell, Marjorie Rambeau, Dorothy Revier
rows.extract: Left Over Ladies is a 1931 American drama film starring Claudia Dell, Marjorie Rambeau and Walter Byron. Produced by Tiffany Pictures, it was originally going to be directed by Lloyd Bacon before Erle C. Kenton took over.

rows.title: The Lightning Flyer
rows.cast: James Hall, Dorothy Sebastian
rows.extract: The Lightning Flyer is a 1931 American pre-Code action film directed by William Nigh and starring James Hall, Dorothy Sebastian and Robert Homans.

rows.title: The Lion and the Lamb
rows.cast: Walter Byron, Carmel Myers, Montagu Love
rows.extract: The Lion and the Lamb is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy thriller film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Walter Byron, Carmel Myers and Raymond Hatton. It is an adaptation of the 1930 novel of the same title by E. Phillips Oppenheim.

rows.title: Little Caesar
rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Glenda Farrell
rows.extract: Little Caesar is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film distributed by Warner Brothers, directed by Mervyn LeRoy, and starring Edward G. Robinson, Glenda Farrell, and Douglas Fairbanks Jr. The film tells the story of a hoodlum who ascends the ranks of organized crime until he reaches its upper echelons

rows.title: Local Boy Makes Good
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Dorothy Lee
rows.extract: Local Boy Makes Good is a 1931 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Mervyn LeRoy and written by Robert Lord, Raymond Griffith and Ray Enright. The film stars Joe E. Brown, Dorothy Lee, Ruth Hall, Edward Woods, Edward Nugent and Wade Boteler. The film was released by Warner Bros. on November 27,

rows.title: Lonely Wives
rows.cast: Edward Everett Horton, Laura La Plante, Esther Ralston
rows.extract: Lonely Wives is a 1931 American comedy film directed by Russell Mack and produced by E.B. Derr for Pathé Exchange, and was distributed by RKO Pictures after the merger of the two studios; it starred Edward Everett Horton, Esther Ralston, Laura La Plante, and Patsy Ruth Miller. The screenplay was wri

rows.title: Lover Come Back
rows.cast: Constance Cummings, Jack Mulhall, Jameson Thomas
rows.extract: Lover Come Back is a 1931 Columbia Pictures pre-Code drama directed by Erle C. Kenton from a script by Dorothy Howell. The story was based on a McCall's magazine feature by Helen Topping Miller.

rows.title: The Mad Genius
rows.cast: John Barrymore, Marian Marsh, Boris Karloff
rows.extract: The Mad Genius (1931) is an American pre-Code drama film produced and distributed by Warner Bros. and directed by Michael Curtiz. The film stars John Barrymore, Marian Marsh, Donald Cook, Charles Butterworth, and in small roles, Boris Karloff and Frankie Darro. The film is based on the play The Idol

rows.title: The Mad Parade
rows.cast: Evelyn Brent, Irene Rich, Louise Fazenda
rows.extract: The Mad Parade is a 1931 Pre-Code American feature film about women canteen workers toiling in a château near the front lines in France during World War I. It was directed by William Beaudine and starred Evelyn Brent. According to the American Film Institute catalog, this film was widely publicized

rows.title: The Magnificent Lie
rows.cast: Ruth Chatterton, Ralph Bellamy, Stuart Erwin
rows.extract: The Magnificent Lie is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Berthold Viertel and written by Vincent Lawrence, Leonard Merrick and Samson Raphaelson. The film stars Ruth Chatterton, Ralph Bellamy, Stuart Erwin, Françoise Rosay, Sam Hardy, Charles Boyer and Tyler Brooke. The film was releas

rows.title: Maid to Order
rows.cast: Julian Eltinge, Betty Boyd, George E. Stone
rows.extract: Maid to Order is a 1931 American comedy crime film directed by Elmer Clifton from a story by Doris Dembow and A. J. L. Parsons. The film featured songs from Jack Stone, Fred Thompson and George Beauchamp. Julian Eltinge, who plays the lead role, was a well-known female impersonator.

rows.title: Maker of Men
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Joan Marsh, John Wayne
rows.extract: Maker of Men is a 1931 American pre-Code sports melodrama film directed by Edward Sedgwick and written by Howard J. Green and Edward Sedgwick. Produced by Columbia Pictures Corporation, the film stars Jack Holt, Richard Cromwell, and Joan Marsh. It also features John Wayne in a supporting role.

rows.title: The Maltese Falcon
rows.cast: Ricardo Cortez, Bebe Daniels, Una Merkel
rows.extract: The Maltese Falcon is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film based on the 1930 novel The Maltese Falcon by Dashiell Hammett and directed by Roy Del Ruth. The film stars Ricardo Cortez as private detective Sam Spade and Bebe Daniels as femme fatale Ruth Wonderly. The supporting cast features Dudley Digg

rows.title: The Man from Death Valley
rows.cast: Tom Tyler, Betty Mack, Gino Corrado
rows.extract: The Man from Death Valley is a 1931 American Western film directed by Lloyd Nosler and written by Lloyd Nosler and George Arthur Durlam. The film stars Tom Tyler. The film was released on September 9, 1931, by Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: The Man in Possession
rows.cast: Robert Montgomery, Charlotte Greenwood, Irene Purcell
rows.extract: The Man in Possession is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic comedy film starring Robert Montgomery, Charlotte Greenwood, Irene Purcell, and C. Aubrey Smith, based on the play of the same name by H. M. Harwood. The black sheep of a family finds himself falling in love with the wealthy woman his brothe

rows.title: Man of the World
rows.cast: William Powell, Carole Lombard, Wynne Gibson
rows.extract: Man of the World is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic drama directed by Richard Wallace and starring William Powell, Carole Lombard, and Wynne Gibson.

rows.title: The Man Who Came Back
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Charles Farrell
rows.extract: The Man Who Came Back is a 1931 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Raoul Walsh, starring Janet Gaynor and Charles Farrell. The movie was adapted to screen by Edwin J. Burke from the play by Jules Eckert Goodman.

rows.title: Manhattan Parade
rows.cast: Charles Butterworth, Winnie Lightner
rows.extract: Manhattan Parade  is a 1931 American pre-Code musical comedy film photographed entirely in Technicolor. It was originally intended to be released, in the United States, early in 1931, but was shelved due to public apathy towards musicals. Despite waiting a number of months, the public proved obstina

rows.title: Many a Slip
rows.cast: Joan Bennett, Lew Ayres
rows.extract: Many a Slip is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Vin Moore and written by Edith Fitzgerald, Robert Riskin and Gladys Buchanan Unger. The film stars Joan Bennett, Lew Ayres, Slim Summerville, Ben Alexander, Virginia Sale and Roscoe Karns. The film was released in August 1931 by Univers

rows.title: Mata Hari
rows.cast: Greta Garbo, Ramón Novarro, Lionel Barrymore
rows.extract: Mata Hari is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Fitzmaurice loosely based on the life of Mata Hari, an exotic dancer and courtesan executed for espionage during World War I. The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer film stars Greta Garbo in the title role. It was Garbo's most commercially success

rows.title: Meet the Wife
rows.cast: Laura La Plante, Lew Cody, Joan Marsh
rows.extract: Meet the Wife is a 1931 American comedy film directed by Leslie Pearce and starring Laura La Plante, Lew Cody and Joan Marsh. It is based on the 1923 Broadway play of the same title by Lynn Starling. The film's sets were designed by the art director Charles A. Cadwallader.

rows.title: Men Call It Love
rows.cast: Adolphe Menjou, Leila Hyams, Norman Foster
rows.extract: Men Call It Love is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic melodrama film directed by Edgar Selwyn and written by Doris Anderson. The film stars Adolphe Menjou, Leila Hyams, Norman Foster, Mary Duncan and Hedda Hopper. The film was released on March 14, 1931, by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

rows.title: Men in Her Life
rows.cast: Lois Moran, Charles Bickford, Victor Varconi
rows.extract: Men in Her Life is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by William Beaudine and starring Lois Moran, Charles Bickford and Victor Varconi. It was based on a 1930 novel by Warner Fabian. It was made during a brief spell Beaudine had working at Columbia Pictures. Critics considered the film one

rows.title: Men of Chance
rows.cast: Ricardo Cortez, Mary Astor, Ralph Ince
rows.extract: Men of Chance is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Archainbaud, starring Ricardo Cortez, Mary Astor, and John Halliday.

rows.title: Men of the Sky
rows.cast: Irene Delroy, Bramwell Fletcher
rows.extract: Men of the Sky is a 1931 all-talking American pre-Code musical drama film, directed by Albert E. Green which was produced by Warner Bros. in 1930 and released in 1931. Men of the Sky stars Irene Delroy and Jack Whiting. Although aircraft were seen in the film, Men of the Sky was more of a spy drama.

rows.title: Men on Call
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Mae Clarke
rows.extract: Men on Call is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by John G. Blystone and written by James Kevin McGuinness and Basil Woon. The picture stars Edmund Lowe, Mae Clarke, William Harrigan, Sharon Lynn, Warren Hymer and Ruth Warren. The film was released on January 18, 1931, by Fox Film Corpora

rows.title: Merely Mary Ann

rows.title: Ships of Hate

rows.extract: Ships of Hate is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by John P. McCarthy and starring Lloyd Hughes, Dorothy Sebastian and Charles Middleton.

rows.title: Shotgun Pass
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Virginia Lee Corbin
rows.extract: Shotgun Pass is a 1931 American Western film directed by J.P. McGowan and starring Tim McCoy, Virginia Lee Corbin and Monte Vandergrift.

rows.cast: Winnie Lightner, Charles Butterworth
rows.extract: Side Show  is a 1931 American pre-Code musical comedy drama film directed by Roy Del Ruth and starring Winnie Lightner, Charles Butterworth, Evalyn Knapp and Donald Cook. rows.cast: Buster Keaton, Anita Page, Cliff Edwards
rows.extract: Sidewalks of New York is a 1931 American comedy film directed by Zion Myers and Jules White and starring Buster Keaton. The film was commercially successful.

rows.title: Silence
rows.cast: Clive Brook, Peggy Shannon
rows.extract: Silence is a 1931 American pre-Code crime film directed by Louis J. Gasnier and Max Marcin and written by Max Marcin, adapted from his play. rows.cast: Helen Hayes, Lewis Stone, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: The Sin of Madelon Claudet is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Edgar Selwyn and starring Helen Hayes. rows.title: The Sin Ship
rows.cast: Mary Astor, Louis Wolheim, Ian Keith
rows.extract: The Sin Ship is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film produced and distributed by RKO Radio Pictures and directed by the actor Louis Wolheim in his only directorial effort. rows.title: The Single Sin
rows.cast: Kay Johnson, Bert Lytell, Holmes Herbert
rows.extract: The Single Sin is a 1931 American Pre-code drama film directed by William Nigh and starring Kay Johnson, Bert Lytell and Paul Hurst. It was produced and released by the independent company Tiffany Pictures.

rows.title: Sit Tight
rows.cast: Winnie Lightner, Joe E. Brown, Claudia Dell
rows.extract: Sit Tight is a 1931 American Pre-Code musical comedy film, directed by Lloyd Bacon, written by Rex Taylor, edited by James Gibbon, and produced and distributed by Warner Bros. rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Edward Everett Horton
rows.extract: Six Cylinder Love is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Thornton Freeland and starring Spencer Tracy, Sidney Fox and Edward Everett Horton. rows.title: Skippy
rows.cast: Jackie Cooper, Mitzi Green, Jackie Searl
rows.extract: Skippy is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film about the scrappy boy portrayed in the popular comic strip and novel Skippy by Percy Crosby. The screenplay was by Joseph L. Mankiewicz, Don Marquis, Norman Z. McLeod, and Sam Mintz.

rows.title: Skyline
rows.cast: Thomas Meighan, Maureen O'Sullivan, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: Skyline is a 1931 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Sam Taylor and starring silent film veteran Thomas Meighan. It is based on a novel—East Side, West Side—by Felix Riesenberg. It was produced and released by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Sky Raiders
rows.cast: Lloyd Hughes, Marceline Day
rows.extract: Sky Raiders is a 1931 film directed by Christy Cabanne and starring Lloyd Hughes and Marceline Day. Produced by Columbia Pictures, it was filmed at Grand Central Air Terminal, now Grand Central Airport, in Glendale, California.

rows.title: The Sky Spider
rows.cast: Glenn Tryon, Beryl Mercer, Blanche Mehaffey
rows.extract: The Sky Spider is a 1931 American "youth-oriented" adventure film. Directed by Richard Thorpe, the film starred Glenn Tryon, Beryl Mercer, Blanche Mehaffey, Pat O'Malley and newcomer John Trent.

rows.title: Smart Money
rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, James Cagney, Margaret Livingston
rows.extract: Smart Money is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film produced and distributed by Warner Bros., directed by Alfred E. Green, and starring Edward G. Robinson and James Cagney. It is the only occasion Robinson and Cagney appeared in a film together, despite being the two leading actors, mainly portraying

rows.title: Smart Woman
rows.cast: Mary Astor, Robert Ames
rows.extract: Smart Woman is a 1931 pre-Code comedy-romance and drama film directed by Gregory La Cava and starring Mary Astor, Robert Ames, and John Halliday.

rows.title: The Smiling Lieutenant
rows.cast: Maurice Chevalier, Claudette Colbert, Miriam Hopkins
rows.extract: The Smiling Lieutenant is a 1931 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by Ernst Lubitsch, starring Maurice Chevalier, Claudette Colbert and Miriam Hopkins, and released by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Sob Sister
rows.cast: James Dunn, Linda Watkins
rows.extract: Sob Sister is a 1931 American romance film directed by Alfred Santell and written by Edwin J. Burke, and starring James Dunn, Linda Watkins, Minna Gombell, Howard Phillips, George E. Stone and Molly O'Day. It was released on October 25, 1931, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Son of India
rows.cast: Ramón Novarro, Madge Evans
rows.extract: Son of India is a 1931 American pre-Code romance film directed by Jacques Feyder and starring Ramón Novarro and Madge Evans. The film is based on the 1882 novel Mr. Isaacs written by Francis Marion Crawford.

rows.title: Sooky
rows.cast: Jackie Cooper, Robert Coogan, Jackie Searl
rows.extract: Sooky is a 1931 American pre-Code adventure film directed by Norman Taurog and written by Joseph L. Mankiewicz, Norman Z. McLeod and Sam Mintz. It is a sequel to the 1931 film Skippy. rows.title: Soul of the Slums
rows.cast: William Collier Jr., Blanche Mehaffey
rows.extract: Soul of the Slums is a 1931 American Pre-Code crime melodrama directed by Frank R. Strayer from an original screenplay by W. Scott Darling. The film stars William Collier Jr., Blanche Mehaffey, and Murray Smith, and was released by Action Pictures on November 15, 1931.

rows.title: The Spider
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Lois Moran
rows.extract: The Spider is a 1931 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Kenneth MacKenna and William Cameron Menzies and starring Edmund Lowe, Lois Moran, El Brendel and John Arledge. Farrell MacDonald. It was released on October 13, 1931,

rows.cast: Clark Gable, Madge Evans, Ernest Torrence
rows.extract: Sporting Blood is a 1931 American MGM pre-Code sports drama film directed by Charles Brabin. The film stars Clark Gable, Ernest Torrence, and Madge Evans. rows.title: Sporting Chance
rows.cast: William Collier Jr., Claudia Dell, James Hall
rows.extract: Sporting Chance is a 1931 drama film directed and produced by Albert Herman, and written by King Baggot. The film was released on 21 November 1931 by Peerless Pictures Corporation and States Rights.

rows.title: The Spy
rows.cast: Kay Johnson, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: The Spy is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Berthold Viertel and written by Ernest Pascal. The film stars Kay Johnson, Neil Hamilton, John Halliday, Milton Holmes, Freddie Burke Frederick and Austen Jewell. The film was released on April 26, 1931, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: The Squaw Man
rows.cast: Warner Baxter, Lupe Vélez, Eleanor Boardman
rows.extract: The Squaw Man is a 1931 American pre-Code Western film directed by Cecil B. DeMille. It was his third time filming the same play but the first in sound. It stars Warner Baxter in the leading role.

rows.title: The Star Witness
rows.cast: Walter Huston, Frances Starr
rows.extract: The Star Witness is a 1931 American pre-Code crime drama film produced and distributed by Warner Bros. and directed by William A. Wellman. rows.title: Stepping Out
rows.cast: Charlotte Greenwood, Leila Hyams, Reginald Denny
rows.extract: Stepping Out is a 1931 American Pre-Code farce directed by Charles Reisner and produced and distributed by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. It is based on the 1929 Broadway play Stepping Out by Elmer Harris. Lilian Bond appeared in the original Broadway play and in this film in the same role.

rows.title: Stolen Heaven

rows.title: Street Scene
rows.cast: Sylvia Sidney, Estelle Taylor, Beulah Bondi
rows.extract: Street Scene is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film produced by Samuel Goldwyn and directed by King Vidor. With a screenplay by Elmer Rice adapted from his Pulitzer Prize-winning play of the same name, Street Scene takes place on a New York City street from one evening until the following afternoon.

rows.title: Strictly Dishonorable
rows.cast: Paul Lukas, Sidney Fox, Lewis Stone
rows.extract: Strictly Dishonorable is a 1931 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by John M. Stahl and starring Paul Lukas, Sidney Fox and Lewis Stone, George Meeker, and Sidney Toler. rows.cast: Hal Skelly, Zita Johann

rows.title: Subway Express
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Aileen Pringle
rows.extract: Subway Express is a 1931 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Fred C. Newmeyer and starring Jack Holt, Aileen Pringle and Fred Kelsey.

rows.title: Suicide Fleet
rows.cast: William Boyd, James Gleason, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: Suicide Fleet is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Albert S. Rogell, written by Lew Lipton and F. McGrew Willis, and starring William Boyd, Robert Armstrong, James Gleason, and Ginger Rogers. It was released on November 20, 1931, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Sundown Trail
