rows.title: Working Girls
rows.cast: Judith Wood, Dorothy Hall, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: Working Girls is a 1931 American pre-Code drama film directed by Dorothy Arzner and written by Zoë Akins, based on the play Blind Mice, written by Vera Caspary and Winifred Lenihan. The film stars Judith Wood, Charles "Buddy" Rogers, Paul Lukas, Stuart Erwin, and Frances Dee. The film was released o

rows.title: X Marks the Spot
rows.cast: Sally Blane, Lew Cody, Fred Kohler
rows.extract: X Marks the Spot is a 1931 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Erle C. Kenton and released by Tiffany Pictures, which operated from 1921 to 1932.

rows.title: Yankee Don
rows.cast: Richard Talmadge, Lupita Tovar
rows.extract: Yankee Don is a 1931 American Western film directed by Noel M. Smith and starring Richard Talmadge, Lupita Tovar and Julian Rivero.

rows.title: The Yellow Ticket
rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, Laurence Olivier, Elissa Landi
rows.extract: The Yellow Ticket is a 1931 pre-Code American drama film based on the 1914 play of the same name by Michael Morton, produced by the Fox Film Corporation, directed by Raoul Walsh, and starring Elissa Landi, Lionel Barrymore and Laurence Olivier. Boris Karloff appears briefly in a small supporting rol

rows.title: Young as You Feel
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Fifi D'Orsay, Lucien Littlefield
rows.extract: Young as You Feel is a 1931 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Frank Borzage and starring Will Rogers, Fifi D'Orsay and Lucien Littlefield. The story was later remade by Fox in 1940 under the same title as part of the Jones Family series of films.

rows.title: Young Donovan's Kid
rows.cast: Richard Dix, Marion Shilling, Jackie Cooper
rows.extract: Young Donovan's Kid is a 1931 American pre-Code melodrama film directed by Fred Niblo, from a screenplay by J. Walter Ruben, based upon the short story, Big Brother, by Rex Beach. It was a remake of a 1923 silent film of the same, produced by Famous Players-Lasky, and directed by Allan Dwan. This ve

rows.title: Young Sinners
rows.cast: Thomas Meighan, Dorothy Jordan
rows.extract: Young Sinners is an American Pre-Code drama film released on May 17, 1931, directed by John G. Blystone. The screenplay was initially written by Maurine Watkins though the script filmed was William Conselman's, not Watkins'.. Conselman scrapped her screenplay in favor of his own based on the play Yo

rows.title: 20,000 Years in Sing Sing
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Bette Davis, Arthur Byron
rows.extract: 20,000 Years in Sing Sing is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film set in Sing Sing Penitentiary, the maximum security prison in Ossining, New York, starring Spencer Tracy as an inmate and Bette Davis as his girlfriend. It was directed by Michael Curtiz and based upon the nonfiction book Twenty Thousa

rows.title: 70,000 Witnesses
rows.cast: Dorothy Jordan, Phillips Holmes
rows.extract: 70,000 Witnesses is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Ralph Murphy, written by Garrett Fort, Robert N. Lee, Allen Rivkin and P.J. Wolfson, and starring Phillips Holmes, Dorothy Jordan, Charlie Ruggles, Johnny Mack Brown, J. Farrell MacDonald, Lew Cody and David Landau. It was release

rows.title: Afraid to Talk
rows.cast: Sidney Fox, Eric Linden, Louis Calhern
rows.extract: Afraid to Talk is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Edward L. Cahn and written by Tom Reed. The film stars Eric Linden, Sidney Fox, Tully Marshall, Louis Calhern, George Meeker and Robert Warwick.

rows.title: After the Ball
rows.cast: Esther Ralston, Basil Rathbone
rows.extract: After the Ball is a 1932 British-American comedy film directed by Milton Rosmer and starring Esther Ralston, Basil Rathbone and Marie Burke.

rows.title: After Tomorrow
rows.cast: Charles Farrell, Marian Nixon
rows.extract: After Tomorrow is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Frank Borzage and starring Charles Farrell, Marian Nixon, Minna Gombell, Josephine Hull and William Collier, Sr.

rows.title: The Age of Consent
rows.cast: Dorothy Wilson, Arline Judge, John Halliday
rows.extract: The Age of Consent is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Gregory La Cava. The film stars Richard Cromwell as a young man who becomes involved with a waitress of a seedy restaurant, co-starring Dorothy Wilson and Arline Judge.

rows.title: Air Mail
rows.cast: Ralph Bellamy, Pat O'Brien, Gloria Stuart
rows.extract: Air Mail is a 1932 American pre-Code adventure film directed by John Ford, based on a story by Dale Van Every and Frank "Spig" Wead. The film stars Ralph Bellamy, Pat O'Brien and Gloria Stuart. A copy is preserved in the Library of Congress.

rows.title: Alias Mary Smith
rows.cast: Blanche Mehaffey, Raymond Hatton
rows.extract: Alias Mary Smith is a 1932 American mystery crime film directed by E. Mason Hopper and starring Blanche Mehaffey, John Darrow and Raymond Hatton. It was released by the independent company Mayfair Pictures.

rows.title: Alias the Doctor
rows.cast: Richard Barthelmess, Marian Marsh
rows.extract: Alias the Doctor is a 1932 pre-Code American drama film directed by Michael Curtiz and starring Richard Barthelmess and Marian Marsh.

rows.title: The All American
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Andy Devine
rows.extract: The All American is a 1932 American pre-Code sports drama film directed by Russell Mack and written by Ferdinand Reyher and Frank Wead. The film stars Richard Arlen, Andy Devine and Gloria Stuart. It was given its premiere in Los Angeles on October 7, 1932, by Universal Pictures. Many noted real-lif

rows.title: Almost Married
rows.cast: Violet Heming, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: Almost Married is a 1932 American pre-Code thriller film directed by William Cameron Menzies and written by Guy Bolton, Alexander Kirkland and Wallace Smith. The film stars Violet Heming, Ralph Bellamy, Alexander Kirkland and Alan Dinehart.

rows.title: Amateur Daddy
rows.cast: Warner Baxter, Marian Nixon
rows.extract: Amateur Daddy is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by John G. Blystone and written by Frank Dolan and Doris Malloy. The film stars Warner Baxter, Marian Nixon, Rita La Roy, and David Landau. The film was released on April 10, 1932, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: American Madness
rows.cast: Walter Huston, Pat O'Brien, Kay Johnson
rows.extract: American Madness is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Frank Capra and starring Walter Huston as a New York banker embroiled in scandal.

rows.title: The Animal Kingdom
rows.cast: Leslie Howard, Ann Harding, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: The Animal Kingdom is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by Edward H. Griffith based upon a comedy of manners play of the same name by Philip Barry. The film stars Leslie Howard, Ann Harding, Myrna Loy, William Gargan, Ilka Chase, and Neil Hamilton. Howard, Gargan, and Chase also st

rows.title: Aren't We All?
rows.cast: Gertrude Lawrence, Hugh Wakefield
rows.extract: Aren't We All? is a 1932 British comedy film directed by Harry Lachman and starring Gertrude Lawrence, Hugh Wakefield and Owen Nares. It is based on the play Aren't We All? by Frederick Lonsdale. It was made at British and Dominions Elstree Studios.

rows.title: Are You Listening?
rows.cast: William Haines, Madge Evans, Anita Page
rows.extract: Are You Listening? is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Harry Beaumont and starring William Haines, Madge Evans and Anita Page.

rows.title: The Arm of the Law
rows.cast: Rex Bell, Marceline Day, Lina Basquette
rows.extract: The Arm of the Law is a 1932 American pre-Code action film directed by Louis King and starring Rex Bell, Marceline Day and Lina Basquette. It was distributed by Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: Arsène Lupin
rows.cast: John Barrymore, Lionel Barrymore, Karen Morley
rows.extract: Arsène Lupin is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Jack Conway and starring John Barrymore and Lionel Barrymore. It was produced and distributed by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.The film is based on a popular 1909 play by Maurice Leblanc and Francis de Croisset. Leblanc created the character Ar

rows.title: As the Devil Commands
rows.cast: Alan Dinehart, Mae Clarke, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: As the Devil Commands is a 1932 American pre-Code film written by Jo Swerling from a story by Keene Thompson. It is directed by Roy William Neill and stars Alan Dinehart, Mae Clarke and Neil Hamilton.

rows.title: As You Desire Me
rows.cast: Greta Garbo, Melvyn Douglas, Erich von Stroheim
rows.extract:
As You Desire Me is a 1932 American pre-Code film adaptation of the 1929 play by Luigi Pirandello released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. It was produced and directed by George Fitzmaurice with Irving Thalberg as co-producer. The adaptation was by Gene Markey, the cinematography by
William H. Daniels, the

rows.title: Attorney for the Defense
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Constance Cummings, Evelyn Brent
rows.extract: Attorney for the Defense is a 1932 American pre-Code crime film directed by Irving Cummings and starring Edmund Lowe, Evelyn Brent, and Constance Cummings.

rows.title: Bachelor's Affairs
rows.cast: Adolphe Menjou, Minna Gombell, Joan Marsh
rows.extract: Bachelor's Affairs also known as Fancy Free is a 1932 American Pre-Code film based on the play "Precious" by James Forbes. While its availability for viewing is currently limited, it has been preserved by the UCLA Film and Television Archive.

rows.title: Bachelor Mother
rows.cast: Evalyn Knapp, Margaret Seddon
rows.extract: Bachelor Mother is a 1932 Pre-Code action film directed by Charles Hutchison.

rows.title: Back Street
rows.cast: Irene Dunne, John Boles, ZaSu Pitts
rows.extract: Back Street is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by John M. Stahl and starring Irene Dunne and John Boles. Based on the best-selling novel of the same name by Fannie Hurst, it tells the story of a woman who spends her life as the secret mistress of a wealthy married man. The devotion and

rows.title: Battling Buckaroo
rows.cast: Lane Chandler, Doris Hill, Yakima Canutt
rows.extract: Battling Buckaroo is a 1932 American western film directed by Armand Schaefer and starring Lane Chandler, Doris Hill and Yakima Canutt.

rows.title: The Beast of the City
rows.cast: Walter Huston, Jean Harlow, Wallace Ford
rows.extract: The Beast of the City is a 1932 American pre-Code gangster film featuring cops as vigilantes and known for its singularly vicious ending. Written by W.R. Burnett, Ben Hecht (uncredited), and John Lee Mahin, and directed by Charles Brabin, the film stars Walter Huston, Jean Harlow, Wallace Ford, Jean

rows.title: Beauty and the Boss
rows.cast: Marian Marsh, David Manners, Warren William
rows.extract: Beauty and the Boss is a 1932 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Roy Del Ruth and starring Marian Marsh, David Manners and Warren William. It was based on a 1928 Hungarian play by Ladislas Fodor about a secretary who eventually marries her boss. An English language adaptation of the

rows.title: Beauty Parlor
rows.cast: Barbara Kent, Joyce Compton, Dorothy Revier
rows.extract: Beauty Parlor (Movie) is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Barbara Kent, Joyce Compton and John Harron.

rows.title: Behind Jury Doors
rows.cast: Helen Chandler, William Collier Jr., Blanche Friderici
rows.extract: Behind Jury Doors is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film directed by B. Reeves Eason and starring Helen Chandler, William Collier Jr. and Blanche Friderici.

rows.title: Behind Stone Walls
rows.cast: Edward Nugent, Priscilla Dean
rows.extract: Behind Stone Walls is a 1932 American Pre-Code film directed by Frank R. Strayer and starring Edward J. Nugent, Priscilla Dean and Ann Christy.

rows.title: Behind the Mask
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Boris Karloff, Constance Cummings
rows.extract: Behind the Mask is a 1932 American pre-Code crime/horror film directed by John Francis Dillon and starring Jack Holt, Boris Karloff and Edward Van Sloan.

rows.title: Between Fighting Men
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Ruth Hall, Josephine Dunn

rows.title: Beyond the Rockies
rows.cast: Tom Keene, Rochelle Hudson
rows.extract: Beyond the Rockies is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film directed by Fred Allen and written by Oliver Drake. The film stars Tom Keene, Rochelle Hudson, Marie Wells, Julian Rivero and Ernie Adams. The film was released on July 8, 1932, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: The Big Broadcast
rows.cast: Bing Crosby, George Burns, Gracie Allen
rows.extract: The Big Broadcast is a 1932 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by Frank Tuttle and starring Bing Crosby, Stuart Erwin, and Leila Hyams. Based on the play Wild Waves by William Ford Manley, the film is about a radio-singer who becomes a popular hit with audiences, but takes a disrespectfu

rows.title: Big City Blues
rows.cast: Eric Linden, Joan Blondell, Walter Catlett
rows.extract: Big City Blues is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Mervyn LeRoy and distributed by Warner Bros. The film is based on the play New York Town by Ward Morehouse and stars Joan Blondell and Eric Linden, with uncredited early appearances by Humphrey Bogart and Lyle Talbot.

rows.title: The Big Stampede
rows.cast: John Wayne, Noah Beery
rows.extract: The Big Stampede is a 1932 pre-Code American Western film starring John Wayne and Noah Beery. It is a remake of the 1927 film The Land Beyond the Law.

rows.title: The Big Timer
rows.cast: Ben Lyon, Constance Cummings, Thelma Todd
rows.extract: The Big Timer is a 1932 American Pre-Code sports drama film directed by Edward Buzzell and starring Ben Lyon, Constance Cummings and Thelma Todd. Produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures, it is about a boxer whose success goes to his head.

rows.title: Big Town
rows.cast: Lester Vail, Frances Dade

rows.title: A Bill of Divorcement
rows.cast: John Barrymore, Billie Burke, Katharine Hepburn
rows.extract: A Bill of Divorcement is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Cukor and starring John Barrymore and Katharine Hepburn in her film debut. It is based on the 1921 British play of the same name, written by Clemence Dane as a reaction to a law passed in Britain in the early 1920s that

rows.title: Bird of Paradise
rows.cast: Dolores del Río, Joel McCrea
rows.extract: Bird of Paradise is a 1932 American pre-Code romantic adventure drama film directed by King Vidor and starring Dolores del Río and Joel McCrea. Based on the 1912 play of the same name by Richard Walton Tully, it was released by RKO Radio Pictures.

rows.title: Blessed Event
rows.cast: Lee Tracy, Mary Brian
rows.extract: Blessed Event is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by Roy Del Ruth and starring Lee Tracy as a newspaper gossip columnist who becomes entangled with a gangster. The Tracy character was reportedly patterned after Walter Winchell, famous gossip columnist of the era. The film was Dick

rows.title: Blonde Venus
rows.cast: Marlene Dietrich, Herbert Marshall, Cary Grant
rows.extract: Blonde Venus is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film starring Marlene Dietrich, Herbert Marshall and Cary Grant. It was produced, edited and directed by Josef von Sternberg from a screenplay by Jules Furthman and S. K. Lauren, adapted from a story by Furthman and von Sternberg. The original story "Mo

rows.title: Blondie of the Follies
rows.cast: Marion Davies, Robert Montgomery, Billie Dove
rows.extract: Blondie of the Follies is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Edmund Goulding and written by Anita Loos and Frances Marion.

rows.title: The Boiling Point
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Helen Foster

rows.title: Border Devils
rows.cast: Gabby Hayes, Kathleen Collins, Harry Carey
rows.extract: Border Devils is a 1932 American Western black and white sound film directed by William Nigh and starring Harry Carey, Kathleen Collins, and Gabby Hayes. The film is Collins's last role and her only sound film.

rows.title: Breach of Promise
rows.cast: Chester Morris, Mae Clarke, Theodore von Eltz
rows.extract: Breach of Promise is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Paul L. Stein and starring Chester Morris, Mae Clarke and Mary Doran.

rows.title: Broadway to Cheyenne
rows.cast: Rex Bell, Marceline Day
rows.extract: Broadway to Cheyenne is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by Harry L. Fraser. The film is also known as From Broadway to Cheyenne. The film successfully combines the Western with the gangster film and vigilante film.

rows.title: Broken Lullaby
rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, Nancy Carroll
rows.extract: Broken Lullaby is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Ernst Lubitsch and released by Paramount Pictures. The screenplay by Samson Raphaelson and Ernest Vajda is based on the 1930 play L'homme que j'ai tué by Maurice Rostand and its 1931 English-language adaptation, The Man I Killed, by R

rows.title: The Broken Wing
rows.cast: Lupe Vélez, Melvyn Douglas, Leo Carrillo
rows.extract: The Broken Wing is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Lloyd Corrigan and written by Grover Jones and William Slavens McNutt, adapted from the play of the same name by Paul Dickey and Charles W. Goddard. The film stars Lupe Vélez, Leo Carrillo, Melvyn Douglas, George Barbier, Willard Rob

rows.title: Business and Pleasure
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Joel McCrea, Dorothy Peterson
rows.extract: Business and Pleasure is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by David Butler, starring Will Rogers and featuring Boris Karloff.

rows.title: But the Flesh Is Weak
rows.cast: Robert Montgomery, Nora Gregor, Heather Thatcher
rows.extract: But the Flesh Is Weak is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Jack Conway and written by Ivor Novello based on his 1928 play The Truth Game. The film stars Robert Montgomery, Nora Gregor, Heather Thatcher, Edward Everett Horton, C. Aubrey Smith and Nils Asther. The film was released on A

rows.title: By Whose Hand?
rows.cast: Ben Lyon, Barbara Weeks, Tom Dugan
rows.extract: By Whose Hand? is a 1932 American mystery film directed by Benjamin Stoloff and starring Ben Lyon, Barbara Weeks and Kenneth Thomson.

rows.title: The Cabin in the Cotton
rows.cast: Bette Davis, Richard Barthelmess, Dorothy Jordan
rows.extract: The Cabin in the Cotton is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Michael Curtiz. The screenplay by Paul Green is based on the novel of the same title by Harry Harrison Kroll.

rows.title: Call Her Savage
rows.cast: Clara Bow, Thelma Todd, Gilbert Roland
rows.extract: Call Her Savage is a 1932 pre-Code drama film directed by John Francis Dillon and starring Clara Bow. The film was Bow's second-to-last film role. It is also one of the first portrayals of homosexuals on screen, including a scene in a gay bar.

rows.title: Cannonball Express
rows.cast: Rex Lease, Leon Ames, Ruth Renick
rows.extract: Cannonball Express is a 1932 American action film directed by Wallace Fox and starring Rex Lease, Tom Moore and Lucile Browne.

rows.title: Careless Lady
rows.cast: Joan Bennett, John Boles
rows.extract: Careless Lady is a 1932 American comedy film directed by Kenneth MacKenna and written by Guy Bolton. The film stars Joan Bennett, John Boles, Minna Gombell, Weldon Heyburn, Nora Lane and Raul Roulien. The film was released on April 3, 1932, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Carnival Boat
rows.cast: William Boyd, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: Carnival Boat is a 1932 American Pre-Code adventure film directed by Albert S. Rogell and written by James Seymour. The film stars William Boyd, Ginger Rogers, Fred Kohler, and Hobart Bosworth. The film was released on March 21, 1932, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Central Park
rows.cast: Joan Blondell, Wallace Ford, Guy Kibbee
rows.extract: Central Park is a 1932 United States pre-Code feature-length crime drama film directed by John G. Adolfi. This rarely seen film stars Wallace Ford and Joan Blondell and exists in a nitrate print at the Library of Congress. It has seen a DVD release by Teakwood Video.

rows.title: Chandu the Magician
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Bela Lugosi
rows.extract: Chandu the Magician is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery-fantasy film starring Edmund Lowe as Frank Chandler and Bela Lugosi as the villain Roxor that he must stop. Based on the radio play of the same name, written by Harry A. Earnshaw, Vera M. Oldham and R.R. Morgan. The radio series was broadcast f

rows.title: Charlie Chan's Chance
rows.cast: Warner Oland, Marian Nixon, H. B. Warner
rows.extract: Charlie Chan's Chance is a 1932 American pre-Code murder mystery film, the third to star Warner Oland as detective Charlie Chan. It is based on the 1928 novel Behind That Curtain by Earl Derr Biggers, who also contributed to the film. The film is considered to be lost.

rows.title: Cheaters at Play
rows.cast: Thomas Meighan, Charlotte Greenwood
rows.extract: Cheaters at Play is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and written by Malcolm Stuart Boylan. The film stars Thomas Meighan, Charlotte Greenwood, William Bakewell, Ralph Morgan, Barbara Weeks and Linda Watkins. The film was released on January 27, 1932, by Fox Film Cor

rows.title: Cock of the Air
rows.cast: Chester Morris, Billie Dove, Walter Catlett
rows.extract: Cock of the Air is a 1932 American pre-Code aviation comedy film directed by Tom Buckingham and written by Charles Lederer and Robert E. Sherwood. The film stars Chester Morris, Billie Dove, Matt Moore, Walter Catlett and Luis Alberni. Cock of the Air was released on January 23, 1932, by United Arti

rows.title: The Cohens and Kellys in Hollywood
rows.cast: June Clyde, Norman Foster
rows.extract: The Cohens and Kellys in Hollywood is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by John Francis Dillon and written by Howard J. Green. The film stars George Sidney, Charles Murray, June Clyde, Norman Foster, Esther Howard, and Emma Dunn. The film was released on March 28, 1932, by Universal Pict

rows.title: Come On Danger!
rows.cast: Tom Keene, Julie Haydon
rows.extract: Come On Danger! is a 1932 Pre-Code Western film, and the first film Tom Keene would make at RKO Studios. It made a profit of $30,000.

rows.title: Come On, Tarzan
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Merna Kennedy, Niles Welch
rows.extract: Come On, Tarzan is a 1932 American pre-Code western film starring Ken Maynard, Merna Kennedy, and Niles Welch.

rows.title: The Conquerors
rows.cast: Richard Dix, Edna May Oliver, Guy Kibbee
rows.extract: The Conquerors is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film that spans several generations in a family that lives through a series of financial crises with faith in the future of the country. It was directed by William A. Wellman, and stars Richard Dix and Ann Harding as a young couple who move from New

rows.title: Cornered
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Cornered is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by B. Reeves Eason and starring Tim McCoy. It was produced and released by Columbia Pictures.

rows.title: The County Fair
rows.cast: Hobart Bosworth, Marion Shilling
rows.extract: The County Fair is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Louis King and starring Hobart Bosworth, Marion Shilling and Ralph Ince. A Kentucky Colonel and a former jockey manage to defeat a gang of criminals who hope to rig a horse race.

rows.title: Cowboy Counsellor
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Sheila Bromley
rows.extract: Cowboy Counsellor is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film starring Hoot Gibson and directed by George Melford. It mixed in strong elements of comedy with courtroom drama. One reviewer deemed it "the best of Gibson's films for Allied."

rows.title: The Crash
rows.cast: Ruth Chatterton, George Brent
rows.extract: The Crash is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by William Dieterle. The film is based on the 1932 novel Children of Pleasure written by Larry Barretto, and stars Ruth Chatterton as a luxury-loving wife devastated by the Wall Street crash of 1929.

rows.title: Crashin' Broadway
rows.cast: Rex Bell, Doris Hill
rows.extract: Crashin' Broadway is a 1933 American Western film directed by John P. McCarthy and written by Wellyn Totman.

rows.title: The Crooked Circle
rows.cast: ZaSu Pitts, Ben Lyon, James Gleason
rows.extract: The Crooked Circle is a 1932 American pre-Code film, a comedy-mystery directed by H. Bruce Humberstone.

rows.title: Crooner
rows.cast: David Manners, Ann Dvorak
rows.extract: Crooner is a 1932 American pre-Code musical drama film directed by Lloyd Bacon and starring David Manners along with Ann Dvorak and Ken Murray. It concerns the abrupt rise and fall of a popular crooner, Teddy Taylor.

rows.title: Cross-Examination
rows.cast: H. B. Warner, Sally Blane
rows.extract: Cross-Examination is a 1932 American drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring H. B. Warner, Sally Blane and Natalie Moorhead.

rows.title: The Crowd Roars
rows.cast: James Cagney, Joan Blondell
rows.extract: The Crowd Roars is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Howard Hawks starring James Cagney and featuring Joan Blondell, Ann Dvorak, Eric Linden, Guy Kibbee, and Frank McHugh. A film of the same name was made in 1938 with a different story, starring Robert Taylor.

rows.title: The Crusader
rows.cast: Evelyn Brent, H. B. Warner
rows.extract: The Crusader is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film based upon the play of the same name by Wilson Collison, directed by Frank R. Strayer, and starring Evelyn Brent.

rows.title: Cynara
rows.cast: Ronald Colman, Kay Francis, Phyllis Barry
rows.extract: Cynara is an American pre-Code 1932 romantic drama film about a British lawyer who pays a heavy price for an affair. It stars Ronald Colman, Kay Francis, and Phyllis Barry. It is based on the 1928 novel An Imperfect Lover by Robert Gore-Browne. In February 2020, the film was shown at the 70th Berlin

rows.title: Dancers in the Dark
rows.cast: Miriam Hopkins, George Raft
rows.extract: Dancers in the Dark is a 1932 American pre-Code film about a taxi dancer, a big band leader, and a gangster.

rows.title: Dance Team
rows.cast: James Dunn, Sally Eilers
rows.extract: Dance Team is a 1932 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Sidney Lanfield and written by Edwin J. Burke. The film stars James Dunn, Sally Eilers, Ralph Morgan, Minna Gombell, Edward Crandall and Nora Lane. The film was released on January 17, 1932, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Daring Danger
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Alberta Vaughn
rows.extract: Daring Danger is a 1932 American pre-Code Western directed by D. Ross Lederman.

rows.title: The Dark Horse
rows.cast: Bette Davis, Warren William, Guy Kibbee
rows.extract: The Dark Horse is a 1932 American pre-Code political comedy film, starring Warren William and Bette Davis. The movie was directed by Alfred E. Green.

rows.title: The Death Kiss
rows.cast: David Manners, Adrienne Ames
rows.extract: The Death Kiss is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film starring David Manners as a crusading studio writer, Adrienne Ames as an actress, and Bela Lugosi as a studio manager. The thriller features three leading players from the previous year's Dracula, and was the first film directed by Edwin L. Mar

rows.title: Deception
rows.cast: Leo Carillo, Thelma Todd
rows.extract: Deception  is a 1932 American Pre-Code sports drama centering on crooked fight promoter Jim Hurley and naive former football player Bucky O'Neill whom he dupes into becoming an untrained wrestler in fixed bouts. When Hurley's girlfriend Lola Del Mont becomes romantically attracted to O'Neill, Hurley

rows.title: The Dentist
rows.cast: W. C. Fields, Marjorie Kane
rows.extract: The Dentist is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy short starring W. C. Fields. The film is one of four shorts Fields made with the "king of comedy," Mack Sennett, at Paramount. Although Sennett was near the end of his career, he found good use of the new medium of talking pictures for comedy, as the fi

rows.title: Destry Rides Again
rows.cast: Tom Mix, Claudia Dell, ZaSu Pitts
rows.extract: Destry Rides Again is a 1932 American pre-Code Western movie starring Tom Mix and directed by Benjamin Stoloff, about a man framed for a crime he didn't commit, who returns to wreak havoc following his release from prison. The film was based on a novel by Max Brand. The supporting cast includes Clau

rows.title: Devil and the Deep
rows.cast: Tallulah Bankhead, Gary Cooper, Charles Laughton
rows.extract: Devil and the Deep is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Marion Gering, based on Maurice Larrouy's novel, and starring Tallulah Bankhead, Gary Cooper, Charles Laughton and Cary Grant. It follows a naval commander who has alienated his wife due to his insane jealousy over every man she s

rows.title: The Devil Is Driving
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Wynne Gibson
rows.extract: The Devil is Driving is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Benjamin Stoloff and starring Edmund Lowe. The film's title was typical of the sensationalistic titles of many pre-Code films. It runs a mere 63 minutes, and like many Pre-Code movies deals openly with issues like sex and violence. Lo

rows.title: Devil on Deck
rows.cast: Reed Howes, Molly O'Day
rows.extract: Devil on Deck is a 1932 Pre-code talking film directed by Wallace Fox and starring Reed Howes and Molly O'Day. It was produced and distributed by Sono Art-World Wide Pictures, a B-movie studio that turned out occasionally some successful pictures like The Great Gabbo.

rows.title: Devil's Lottery
rows.cast: Elissa Landi, Victor McLaglen, Paul Cavanagh
rows.extract: Devil's Lottery is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Sam Taylor and written by Guy Bolton. The film stars Elissa Landi, Victor McLaglen, Alexander Kirkland, Ralph Morgan, Paul Cavanagh and Barbara Weeks. The film was released on March 27, 1932, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Discarded Lovers
rows.cast: Natalie Moorhead, Russell Hopton, Barbara Weeks
rows.extract: Discarded Lovers is a 1932 American Pre-Code mystery film directed by Fred C. Newmeyer.

rows.title: Disorderly Conduct
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Sally Eilers
rows.extract: Disorderly Conduct is a 1932 American Pre-Code film directed by John W. Considine Jr. starring Spencer Tracy, Sally Eilers and Ralph Bellamy. It was the seventh picture Tracy made under his contract with Fox Film Corporation, and the first to make a profit since his debut Up the River.

rows.title: Divorce in the Family
rows.cast: Jackie Cooper, Conrad Nagel, Lewis Stone
rows.extract: Divorce in the Family is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Charles Reisner and written by Delmer Daves. The film stars Jackie Cooper, Conrad Nagel, Lewis Stone, Lois Wilson and Jean Parker. It was released on August 27, 1932, by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

rows.title: The Divorce Racket
rows.cast: James Rennie, Olive Borden

rows.title: Docks of San Francisco
rows.cast: Mary Nolan, Marjorie Beebe
rows.extract: Docks of San Francisco is a 1932 American pre-Code crime film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Mary Nolan, Jason Robards Sr. and Marjorie Beebe. It was originally released by Mayfair Pictures, and later re-released by Commonwealth Pictures in 1948. The film was long considered to be a lost f

rows.title: Doctor X
rows.cast: Fay Wray, Lionel Atwill, Lee Tracy
rows.extract: Doctor X is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery horror film produced jointly by First National and Warner Bros. Based on the 1931 play originally titled The Terror by Howard W. Comstock and Allen C. Miller, it was directed by Michael Curtiz and stars Lionel Atwill, Fay Wray and Lee Tracy.

rows.title: Doomed Battalion
rows.cast: Luis Trenker, Tala Birell
rows.extract: Doomed Battalion is a 1932 American drama film directed by Cyril Gardner and written by Karl Hartl, Patrick Kearney, Paul Perez and Luis Trenker. The film stars Luis Trenker, Tala Birell, Albert Conti, Victor Varconi, Henry Armetta and Gustav von Seyffertitz. The film was released on June 16, 1932,

rows.title: Down to Earth
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Dorothy Jordan
rows.extract: Down to Earth is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by David Butler and starring Will Rogers, Dorothy Jordan and Irene Rich. It is a sequel to the 1929 film They Had to See Paris, with the Peters family returning to America where their wealthy lifestyle is suddenly hit by the Great Depres

rows.title: Downstairs
rows.cast: John Gilbert, Paul Lukas, Hedda Hopper
rows.extract: Downstairs is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film. It stars John Gilbert as a charming but self-serving chauffeur who wreaks havoc on his new employer's household, romancing and fleecing the women on the staff, and blackmailing the employer's wife. Gilbert had written the story in 1928 for a propose

rows.title: The Drifter
rows.cast: William Farnum, Noah Beery Sr., Phyllis Barrington
rows.extract: The Drifter is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by William A. O'Connor.

rows.title: Drifting Souls
rows.cast: Lois Wilson, Theodore von Eltz, Raymond Hatton
rows.extract: Drifting Souls is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Louis King and starring Lois Wilson, Theodore von Eltz and Raymond Hatton.

rows.title: Dynamite Denny
rows.cast: Jay Wilsey, Blanche Mehaffey
rows.extract: Dynamite Denny is a 1932 American drama film directed by Frank R. Strayer from an original screenplay by W. Scott Darling. The film stars Jay Wilsey, Blanche Mehaffey, and William V. Mong. Produced by Action Pictures, it was distributed through Mayfair pictures, and was released on May 27, 1932.

rows.title: Dynamite Ranch
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Ruth Hall
rows.extract: Dynamite Ranch is a 1932 American Western film directed by Forrest Sheldon and written by Barry Barrington. The film stars Ken Maynard, Ruth Hall, Alan Roscoe, Martha Mattox, Arthur Hoyt and Albert J. Smith. The film was produced by K.B.S. Productions released on July 31, 1932, by Sono Art-World Wid

rows.title: Emma
rows.cast: Marie Dressler, Richard Cromwell, Jean Hersholt
rows.extract: Emma is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy-drama film released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, starring Marie Dressler, written by Leonard Praskins from a story by Frances Marion, and directed by Clarence Brown. The supporting cast features Richard Cromwell, Jean Hersholt and Myrna Loy.

rows.title: End of the Trail
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Luana Walters, Wheeler Oakman
rows.extract: End of the Trail is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film directed by D. Ross Lederman.

rows.title: Escapade
rows.cast: Jameson Thomas, Sally Blane
rows.extract: Escapade is a 1932 Pre-Code American crime film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Jameson Thomas, Sally Blane and Anthony Bushell. It is also known by the alternative title of Dangerous Ground.

rows.title: Evenings for Sale
rows.cast: Herbert Marshall, Sari Maritza
rows.extract: Evenings for Sale is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Stuart Walker and written by S.K. Lauren, Agnes Brand Leahy and I. A. R. Wylie. The film stars Herbert Marshall, Sari Maritza, Charlie Ruggles, Mary Boland, George Barbier and Bert Roach. The film was released on November 12, 1932

rows.title: The Expert
rows.cast: Charles Sale, Dickie Moore, Lois Wilson
rows.extract: The Expert is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy-drama directed by Archie Mayo and starring Chic Sale and Dickie Moore. It is based on a 1924 Edna Ferber and George S. Kaufman play, Minick, which is based on the short story "Old Man Minick" by Ferber. The film was produced and distributed by Warner Bro

rows.title: Exposed
rows.cast: William Collier Jr., Barbara Kent, Raymond Hatton
rows.extract: Exposed is a 1932 American pre-Code crime film directed by Albert Herman and starring William Collier Jr., Barbara Kent and Raymond Hatton. It was released in Britain by Butcher's Film Service under the alternative title of	Strange Roads.

rows.title: Exposure
rows.cast: Lila Lee, Walter Byron
rows.extract: Exposure is a 1932 American drama film directed by Norman Houston and starring Lila Lee, Walter Byron and Tully Marshall.

rows.title: The Face on the Barroom Floor
rows.cast: Dulcie Cooper, Bramwell Fletcher
rows.extract: The Face on the Barroom Floor is a 1932 pre-Code American crime film directed by Bertram Bracken and starring Dulcie Cooper, Bramwell Fletcher and Alice Ward.

rows.title: Faithless
rows.cast: Tallulah Bankhead, Robert Montgomery, Hugh Herbert
rows.extract: Faithless is a 1932 American pre-Code romantic drama film about a spoiled socialite who learns a sharp lesson when she loses all her money during the Great Depression. The film stars Tallulah Bankhead and Robert Montgomery and is based on Mildred Cram's novel Tinfoil, which was the film's working ti

rows.title: False Faces
rows.cast: Peggy Shannon, Lila Lee

rows.title: The Famous Ferguson Case
rows.cast: Joan Blondell, Grant Mitchell
rows.extract: The Famous Ferguson Case is a 1932 American pre-Code crime film directed by Lloyd Bacon and starring Joan Blondell, Grant Mitchell and Vivienne Osborne. The film's sets were designed by the art director Jack Okey.

rows.title: A Farewell to Arms
rows.cast: Gary Cooper, Helen Hayes, Adolphe Menjou
rows.extract: A Farewell to Arms is a 1932 American pre-Code romance drama film directed by Frank Borzage and starring Helen Hayes, Gary Cooper, and Adolphe Menjou. Based on the 1929 semi-autobiographical novel A Farewell to Arms by Ernest Hemingway, with a screenplay by Oliver H. P. Garrett and Benjamin Glazer,

rows.title: Fast Companions
rows.cast: Tom Brown, Maureen O'Sullivan
rows.extract: Fast Companions is a 1932 American pre-Code sports drama film directed by Kurt Neumann and starring Tom Brown, Maureen O'Sullivan and James Gleason.

rows.title: Fast Life
rows.cast: William Haines, Madge Evans, Conrad Nagel
rows.extract: Fast Life is a 1932 American Pre-Code romantic comedy film starring William Haines and Madge Evans, directed by Harry A. Pollard and is based upon the story Let's Go by E.J. Rath.

rows.title: The Fighting Champ
rows.cast: Bob Steele, Arletta Duncan
rows.extract: The Fighting Champ is a 1932 American Western film directed by John P. McCarthy and written by Wellyn Totman. The film stars Bob Steele, Arletta Duncan, Kit Guard, George Chesebro, George "Gabby" Hayes and Charles King. The film was released on December 15, 1932, by Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: The Fighting Fool
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Marceline Day
rows.extract: The Fighting Fool is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by Lambert Hillyer and released by Columbia Pictures starring Tim McCoy, Marceline Day, and William V. Mong.

rows.title: Fighting for Justice
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Joyce Compton
rows.extract: Fighting for Justice is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film, directed by Otto Brower. It stars Tim McCoy and Joyce Compton.

rows.title: The Fighting Gentleman
rows.cast: William Collier Jr., Josephine Dunn
rows.extract: The Fighting Gentleman is a 1932 American pre-Code sports-drama film directed by Fred C. Newmeyer with William Collier, Jr. and Josephine Dunn in the leads.

rows.title: The Final Edition
rows.cast: Pat O'Brien, Mae Clarke, Bradley Page
rows.extract: The Final Edition is a 1932 American crime drama film directed by Howard Higgin and starring Pat O'Brien, Mae Clark and Morgan Wallace. Made by Columbia Pictures, it is based on a story by Roy Chanslor.

rows.title: Fireman, Save My Child
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Lilian Bond
rows.extract: Fireman, Save My Child is a 1932 American Pre-Code comedy film starring comedian Joe E. Brown and directed by Lloyd Bacon. The picture was produced by the First National Pictures and released by their parent Warner Brothers. The supporting cast features Evalyn Knapp, Lilian Bond and Guy Kibbee.

rows.title: The First Year
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Charles Farrell
rows.extract: The First Year is a 1932 American pre-Code film based on a 1920 play of the same name that originally ran on Broadway at the Little Theatre. The play was written by Frank Craven and produced by John Golden. It closed in 1922 after 760 performances.

rows.title: Flames
rows.cast: Johnny Mack Brown, Noel Francis
rows.extract: Flames is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Karl Brown and starring Johnny Mack Brown, George Cooper and Noel Francis. It follows the adventures of two young firefighters and the girlfriends they meet after rescuing their stranded cat.

rows.title: Flaming Guns
rows.cast: Tom Mix, Ruth Hall
rows.extract: Flaming Guns is a 1932 American Western film directed by Arthur Rosson and written by Jack Cunningham. The film stars Tom Mix, William Farnum, Ruth Hall, Clarence Wilson, George Hackathorne and Duke R. Lee. The film was released on December 22, 1932, by Universal Pictures. It was based on a story by

rows.title: Flesh
rows.cast: Wallace Beery, Ricardo Cortez, Karen Morley
rows.extract: Flesh is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film starring Wallace Beery as a German wrestler. Some of the script was written by Moss Hart and an uncredited William Faulkner, and the film was co-produced and directed by John Ford, who removed his director's credit from the picture.

rows.title: Flowers and Trees
rows.extract: Flowers and Trees is a 1932 Silly Symphonies cartoon produced by Walt Disney, directed by Burt Gillett, and released to theatres by United Artists on July 30, 1932. It was the first commercially released film to be produced in the full-color three-strip Technicolor process after several years of two

rows.title: A Fool's Advice
rows.cast: Frank Fay, Nat Pendleton
rows.extract: A Fool's Advice is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Ralph Ceder. The film is also known as His Honor the Mayor and Meet the Mayor. It was produced by its star, Frank Fay, and released by Warner Bros. Pictures.

rows.title: Forbidden
rows.cast: Barbara Stanwyck, Adolphe Menjou, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: Forbidden is a 1932 American pre-Code melodrama film directed by Frank Capra and starring Barbara Stanwyck, Adolphe Menjou, and Ralph Bellamy. An original story inspired by the 1931 novel Back Street by Fannie Hurst, with a screenplay by Jo Swerling, the film is about a young librarian who falls in

rows.title: Forbidden Company
rows.cast: Sally Blane, John Darrow
rows.extract: Forbidden Company is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Sally Blane, John Darrow and John St. Polis.

rows.title: Forbidden Trail
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Barbara Weeks
rows.extract:
Forbidden Trail is a 1932 American pre-Code
western film directed by Lambert Hillyer and starring Buck Jones, Barbara Weeks and George Cooper.

rows.title: Forgotten Commandments
rows.cast: Sari Maritza, Gene Raymond, Marguerite Churchill
rows.extract: Forgotten Commandments is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Louis J. Gasnier and William Schorr and written by James B. Fagan and Agnes Brand Leahy. The film stars Sari Maritza, Gene Raymond, Marguerite Churchill, Irving Pichel, Harry Beresford and Kent Taylor. The film was released on

rows.title: The Forty-Niners
rows.cast: Tom Tyler, Betty Mack

rows.title: The Fourth Horseman
rows.cast: Tom Mix, Margaret Lindsay
rows.extract: The Fourth Horseman is a 1932 American Western film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and written by Jack Cunningham. The film stars Tom Mix, Margaret Lindsay, Fred Kohler, Donald Kirke, Raymond Hatton and Buddy Roosevelt. It was released on September 25, 1932, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Freaks
rows.cast: Wallace Ford, Leila Hyams, Olga Baclanova
rows.extract: Freaks is a 1932 American pre-Code horror film produced and directed by Tod Browning, starring Wallace Ford, Leila Hyams, Olga Baclanova, and Roscoe Ates.

rows.title: Frisco Jenny
rows.cast: Ruth Chatterton, Louis Calhern
rows.extract: Frisco Jenny is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by William A. Wellman and starring Ruth Chatterton and Louis Calhern. Its storyline bears a resemblance to Chatterton's previous hit film, Madame X (1929).

rows.title: The Gambling Sex
rows.cast: Ruth Hall, Grant Withers
rows.extract: The Gambling Sex is a 1932 American drama film directed by Fred C. Newmeyer and starring Ruth Hall, Grant Withers and Maston Williams.

rows.title: The Gay Buckaroo
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Roy D'Arcy
rows.extract: The Gay Buckaroo is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film, directed by Phil Rosen. It stars Hoot Gibson, Merna Kennedy, and Roy D'Arcy, and was released on January 17, 1932.

rows.title: The Gay Caballero
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Victor McLaglen
rows.extract: The Gay Caballero is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by Alfred L. Werker and written by Barry Conners and Philip Klein. The film stars George O'Brien, Victor McLaglen, Conchita Montenegro, Linda Watkins, C. Henry Gordon and Weldon Heyburn. The film's screenplay was adapted from the no

rows.title: Get That Girl
rows.cast: Richard Talmadge, Shirley Grey, Carl Stockdale
rows.extract: Get That Girl is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film directed by George Crone and starring Richard Talmadge, Shirley Grey and Fred Malatesta.

rows.title: Ghost City
rows.cast: Bill Cody, Helen Foster
rows.extract: Ghost City is a 1932 American western film directed by Harry L. Fraser and starring Bill Cody, Andy Shuford and Helen Foster. It was distributed by Monogram Pictures which specialized in low-budget second features, many of them westerns.

rows.title: Ghost Valley
rows.cast: Tom Keene, Merna Kennedy
rows.extract: Ghost Valley is a 1932 American pre-Code film starring Tom Keene. It made a profit of $20,000.

rows.title: Girl Crazy
rows.cast: Bert Wheeler, Robert Woolsey
rows.extract: Girl Crazy is a 1932 American pre-Code musical film adaptation of the 1930 stage play of the same name. The film was very unlike the stage play except for its score. It was tailored for the comic talents of Wheeler & Woolsey, a popular comedy team of the time. Three songs written by George and Ira G

rows.title: The Girl from Calgary
rows.cast: Fifi D'Orsay, Paul Kelly
rows.extract: The Girl from Calgary is a 1932 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by Phil Whitman, and starring Fifi D'Orsay and Paul Kelly.

rows.title: The Girl from Chicago
rows.cast: Grace Smith, Carl Mahon, Juano Hernandez
rows.extract: The Girl from Chicago is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film produced and directed by Oscar Micheaux, with an all-African-American cast including lead actors Grace Smith and Carl Mahon. The story concerns a federal agent who falls in love while on assignment in Mississippi. He helps his lover escape

rows.title: Girl of the Rio
rows.cast: Dolores del Río, Leo Carrillo
rows.extract: Girl of the Rio is a 1932 American Pre-Code RKO musical film starred Dolores del Río and Leo Carrillo. Directed by Herbert Brenon, the screenplay was written by Elizabeth Meehan and Louis Stevens, based on the play, The Dove by Willard Mack, which was itself based on a magazine article by Gerald Bea

rows.title: Gold
rows.cast: Jack Hoxie, Alice Day, Lafe McKee
rows.extract: Gold is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film directed by Otto Brower. An early sound B western, the film starred Jack Hoxie in the second of his six sound westerns, featuring Hooper Atchley as the villain Kramer. The film also marked the last screen appearance of silent movie actress Alice Day.

rows.title: The Golden West
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Marion Burns
rows.extract: The Golden West is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film directed by David Howard and written by Gordon Rigby. The film stars George O'Brien, Janet Chandler, Marion Burns, Arthur Pierson, Onslow Stevens and Emmett Corrigan. It is based on the novel The Last Trail by Zane Grey. The film was released

rows.title: Gorilla Ship
rows.cast: Ralph Ince, Vera Reynolds, Reed Howes
rows.extract: Gorilla Ship is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Frank Strayer from an original screenplay by George Waggner. Starring Ralph Ince, Vera Reynolds, and Reed Howes, the film was produced by Ralph M. Like, Ltd. and distributed by Mayfair Pictures. It was released on June 11, 1932.

rows.title: Grand Hotel
rows.cast: Greta Garbo, John Barrymore, Joan Crawford
rows.extract: Grand Hotel is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Edmund Goulding and produced by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. The screenplay by William A. Drake is based on the 1930 play of the same title by Drake, who had adapted it from the 1929 novel Menschen im Hotel by Vicki Baum. To date, it is the only

rows.title: The Greeks Had a Word for Them
rows.cast: Joan Blondell, Madge Evans
rows.extract: The Greeks Had a Word for Them is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Lowell Sherman, produced by Samuel Goldwyn, and released by United Artists. It stars Ina Claire, Joan Blondell, and Madge Evans and is based on the play The Greeks Had a Word for It by Zoe Akins. The studio originally

rows.title: Guilty as Hell
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Victor McLaglen, Richard Arlen
rows.extract: Guilty as Hell is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Erle C. Kenton and written by Arthur Kober and Frank Partos. The film stars Edmund Lowe, Victor McLaglen, Richard Arlen, Adrienne Ames, Henry Stephenson, Ralph Ince and Noel Francis. The film was released on August 5, 1932, by Param

rows.title: Guilty or Not Guilty (film)
rows.cast: Betty Compson, Claudia Dell

rows.title: Guns for Hire
rows.cast: Lane Chandler, Neal Hart
rows.extract: Guns for Hire is a 1932 American Western film directed by Lewis D. Collins and starring Lane Chandler, Sally Darling and Neal Hart.

rows.title: The Half-Naked Truth
rows.cast: Lupe Vélez, Lee Tracy, Franklin Pangborn
rows.extract: The Half-Naked Truth is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Gregory La Cava.
