rows.title: Tangled Destinies
rows.cast: Gene Morgan, Doris Hill, Glenn Tryon
rows.extract: Tangled Destinies is a 1932 pre-Code American murder mystery film directed by Frank R. Strayer. The film is also known as Who Killed Harvey Forbes? in the United Kingdom.

rows.title: Tangled Fortunes
rows.cast: Buzz Barton, Caryl Lincoln
rows.extract: Tangled Fortunes is a 1932 American Western film directed by J.P. McGowan and starring Buzz Barton, Francis X. Bushman Jr. and Caryl Lincoln.

rows.title: Tarzan the Ape Man
rows.cast: Maureen O'Sullivan, Johnny Weissmuller, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: Tarzan the Ape Man is a 1932 pre-Code American action adventure film released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer featuring Edgar Rice Burroughs' famous jungle hero Tarzan and starring Johnny Weissmuller, Neil Hamilton, C. Aubrey Smith and Maureen O'Sullivan. It was Weissmuller's first of 12 Tarzan films. O'Sull

rows.title: Taxi!
rows.cast: James Cagney, Loretta Young
rows.extract: Taxi! is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Roy Del Ruth and starring James Cagney and Loretta Young.

rows.title: Temptation's Workshop
rows.cast: Helen Foster, Tyrell Davis
rows.extract: Temptation's Workshop is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Helen Foster, Tyrell Davis and Dorothy Granger. It was released by the independent Poverty Row studio Mayfair Pictures.

rows.title: The Tenderfoot
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: The Tenderfoot is a 1932 American Pre-Code comedy western film directed by Ray Enright and written by Earl Baldwin, Monty Banks and Arthur Caesar. The film stars Joe E. Brown and Ginger Rogers. The film was released by Warner Bros. on May 23, 1932. It is based on Richard Carle's 1903 play The Tender

rows.title: Tess of the Storm Country
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Charles Farrell
rows.extract: Tess of the Storm Country is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by directed by Alfred Santell and starring Janet Gaynor, Charles Farrell, and Dudley Digges. It was released by Fox Film Corporation. It is based on the novel of the same name by Grace Miller White and its adaptation for the s

rows.title: Tex Takes a Holiday
rows.cast: Wallace MacDonald, Virginia Brown Faire

rows.title: The Texan
rows.cast: Jay Wilsey, Lucile Browne
rows.extract: The Texan is a 1932 American Western film directed by Clifford S. Smith, starring Jay Wilsey, Lucile Browne, and Bobby Nelson.

rows.title: The Texas Bad Man
rows.cast: Tom Mix, Lucille Powers
rows.extract: The Texas Bad Man is a 1932 American Western film directed by Edward Laemmle, written by Jack Cunningham and Richard Schayer, and starring Tom Mix, Lucille Powers, Willard Robertson, Fred Kohler, Joseph W. Girard and Tetsu Komai. It was released on June 30, 1932, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Texas Buddies
rows.cast: Bob Steele, Nancy Drexel
rows.extract: Texas Buddies is a 1932 American Western film written and directed by Robert North Bradbury. The film stars Bob Steele, Nancy Drexel, Francis McDonald, Harry Semels, George "Gabby" Hayes and William Dyer. The film was released on October 19, 1932, by Sono Art-World Wide Pictures.

rows.title: Texas Cyclone
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, John Wayne
rows.extract: Texas Cyclone is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film directed by D. Ross Lederman for Columbia Pictures. The film stars Tim McCoy as "Texas Grant", Shirley Grey, Wheeler Oakman and John Wayne, and features an early appearance by Walter Brennan as the sheriff.

rows.title: Texas Gun Fighter
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Sheila Mannors
rows.extract: Texas Gun Fighter is a 1932 American Western film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Ken Maynard. It was produced and distributed by the soon to be defunct Tiffany Pictures.

rows.title: Texas Pioneers
rows.cast: Bill Cody, LeRoy Mason, Sheila Bromley
rows.extract: Texas Pioneers is a 1932 American Western film written and directed by Harry L. Fraser. The film stars Bill Cody, Andy Shuford, LeRoy Mason, Sheila Bromley, John Elliott and Harry Allen. The film was released on June 18, 1932, by Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: The Texas Tornado
rows.cast: Lane Chandler, Doris Hill, Ben Corbett
rows.extract: The Texas Tornado is a 1932 pre-Code American Western film directed by Oliver Drake and starring Lane Chandler, Doris Hill and Ben Corbett.

rows.title: That Night in London
rows.cast: Robert Donat, Pearl Argyle, Miles Mander
rows.extract: That Night in London is a 1932 British crime film directed by Rowland V. Lee, produced by Alexander Korda, and written by Dorothy Greenhill and Arthur Wimperis. It stars Robert Donat, Pearl Argyle, Miles Mander and Roy Emerton. It was released in the United States under the alternative title of Over

rows.title: That's My Boy
rows.cast: Richard Cromwell, Dorothy Jordan
rows.extract: That's My Boy is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Roy William Neill and starring Richard Cromwell and Dorothy Jordan. John Wayne had a very small uncredited role in the film.

rows.title: They Call It Sin
rows.cast: Loretta Young, George Brent
rows.extract: They Call It Sin is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Thornton Freeland and starring Loretta Young as a farmer's daughter who follows a traveling salesman to New York City, only to discover he already is engaged.

rows.title: They Just Had to Get Married
rows.cast: Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts, Roland Young
rows.extract: They Just Had to Get Married is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Edward Ludwig and starring Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts, Roland Young, and Verree Teasdale.

rows.title: They Never Come Back
rows.cast: Regis Toomey, Dorothy Sebastian
rows.extract: They Never Come Back is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Fred C. Newmeyer and starring Regis Toomey and Dorothy Sebastian.

rows.title: Thirteen Women
rows.cast: Myrna Loy, Irene Dunne, Ricardo Cortez
rows.extract: Thirteen Women is a 1932 American pre-Code psychological thriller film, produced by David O. Selznick and directed by George Archainbaud. It stars Myrna Loy, Irene Dunne and Ricardo Cortez. The film is based on the 1930 bestselling novel of the same name by Tiffany Thayer and was adapted for the scr

rows.title: The Thirteenth Guest
rows.cast: Ginger Rogers, Lyle Talbot
rows.extract: The Thirteenth Guest is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery comedy thriller film, released on August 9, 1932. The film is also known as Lady Beware in the United Kingdom. It is based on the 1929 novel The Thirteenth Guest written by crime fiction author Armitage Trail, best known for the novel Scarface

rows.title: This Is the Night
rows.cast: Roland Young, Thelma Todd, Cary Grant
rows.extract: This Is the Night is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Frank Tuttle, and starring Lili Damita, Charles Ruggles, Roland Young, Thelma Todd, and Cary Grant in his film debut. It was made by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: This Reckless Age
rows.cast: Charles "Buddy" Rogers, Peggy Shannon
rows.extract: This Reckless Age is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Frank Tuttle and starring Charles "Buddy" Rogers and produced and distributed by Paramount Pictures. The film is based on a Broadway play The Goose Hangs High by Lewis Beach.

rows.title: This Sporting Age
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Evalyn Knapp
rows.extract: This Sporting Age is a 1932 American sports drama film directed by Andrew Bennison and A.F. Erickson and starring Jack Holt, Evalyn Knapp and Walter Byron.

rows.title: Those We Love
rows.cast: Mary Astor, Kenneth MacKenna
rows.extract: Those We Love is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Robert Florey. It was adapted by F. Hugh Herbert from the play by George Abbott and S.K. Lauren. The film was independently produced and distributed.

rows.title: Three on a Match
rows.cast: Joan Blondell, Bette Davis, Humphrey Bogart
rows.extract: Three on a Match is a 1932 American pre-Code crime drama released by Warner Bros. The film was directed by Mervyn LeRoy and stars Joan Blondell, Warren William, Ann Dvorak and Bette Davis. The film also features Lyle Talbot, Humphrey Bogart, Allen Jenkins and Edward Arnold.

rows.title: Three Wise Girls
rows.cast: Jean Harlow, Mae Clarke
rows.extract: Three Wise Girls is a 1932 American pre-Code romantic drama film directed by William Beaudine and featuring Jean Harlow in her first starring role. The supporting cast features a young Andy Devine. This film is preserved in the Library of Congress collection.

rows.title: Thrill of Youth
rows.cast: June Clyde, Dorothy Peterson
rows.extract: Thrill of Youth is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring June Clyde and Dorothy Peterson.

rows.title: Thunder Below
rows.cast: Tallulah Bankhead, Charles Bickford
rows.extract: Thunder Below is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Richard Wallace, written by Sidney Buchman and Josephine Lovett, and starring Tallulah Bankhead, Charles Bickford, Paul Lukas, Eugene Pallette, Ralph Forbes and Leslie Fenton. It was released on June 17, 1932, by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Tiger Shark
rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Richard Arlen
rows.extract: Tiger Shark is a 1932 American pre-Code melodrama romantic film directed by Howard Hawks and starring Edward G. Robinson, Richard Arlen and Zita Johann.

rows.cast: Ruth Chatterton, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: Tomorrow and Tomorrow is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film that was adapted from Philip Barry's play of the same name by Josephine Lovett. rows.extract: Tom Brown of Culver is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by William Wyler.

rows.title: Tombstone Canyon
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Cecilia Parker
rows.extract: Tombstone Canyon is a 1932 American Western film directed by Alan James.

rows.title: Too Busy to Work
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Marian Nixon
rows.extract: Too Busy to Work is a 1932 American drama film directed by John G. Blystone, written by Barry Conners and Philip Klein, and starring Will Rogers, Marian Nixon, Dick Powell, Frederick Burton, Charles Middleton and Louise Beavers. It was released on December 2, 1932, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Trailing the Killer
rows.cast: Francis McDonald, Heinie Conklin
rows.extract: Trailing the Killer, also known as Call of the Wilderness and Lobo, is a 1932 American film directed by Herman C. Raymaker and released by Sono Art-World Wide Pictures.

rows.title: Trapped in Tia Juana
rows.cast: Edwina Booth, Duncan Renaldo, Dot Farley
rows.extract: Trapped in Tia Juana is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by Wallace Fox. Duncan Renaldo plays twin brothers separated at birth: West Point graduate Kenneth Holbert and Mexican bandit El Zorro.

rows.cast: Joan Bennett, Donald Cook
rows.extract: The Trial of Vivienne Ware is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by William K. rows.cast: Miriam Hopkins, Kay Francis, Herbert Marshall
rows.extract: Trouble in Paradise is a 1932 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Ernst Lubitsch and starring Miriam Hopkins, Kay Francis, and Herbert Marshall. rows.title: Two Against the World
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: Two Against the World is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Archie Mayo and starring Constance Bennett as a woman who tries her best to keep her sister and brother out of trouble. It is based on the play A Dangerous Set by Marion Dix and Jerry Horwin.

rows.title: Two-Fisted Law
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, John Wayne
rows.extract: Two-Fisted Law is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by D. Ross Lederman for Columbia Pictures, starring Tim McCoy and featuring John Wayne playing a character named "Duke". The picture also features Alice Day, Wheeler Oakman, Tully Marshall, Wallace MacDonald, and Walter Brennan.

rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Guy Kibbee
rows.extract: Two Seconds is a 1932 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Mervyn LeRoy and starring Edward G. Robinson, Vivienne Osborne and Preston Foster. rows.title: Unashamed
rows.cast: Helen Twelvetrees, Robert Young
rows.extract: Unashamed is a 1932 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Harry Beaumont, written by Bayard Veiller and starring Helen Twelvetrees, Robert Young, Lewis Stone, Jean Hersholt, John Miljan and Monroe Owsley. It was released on July 2, 1932 by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

rows.title: Under-Cover Man
rows.cast: George Raft, Nancy Carroll
rows.extract: Under Cover Man is a 1932 American pre-Code crime film directed by James Flood and starring George Raft and Nancy Carroll.

rows.title: The Unexpected Father

rows.extract: The Unexpected Father is a 1932 American comedy film directed by Thornton Freeland and starring Slim Summerville, Zasu Pitts, and Cora Sue Collins.

rows.title: Unholy Love
rows.cast: H. B. Warner, Lila Lee
rows.extract: Unholy Love is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed and produced by Albert Ray. It was the first film adaptation of Gustave Flaubert's 1857 French novel Madame Bovary produced.

rows.title: Union Depot
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Joan Blondell
rows.extract: Union Depot is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Alfred E. Green for Warner Bros., starring Douglas Fairbanks Jr. and Joan Blondell, and based on an unpublished play by Joe Laurie Jr., Gene Fowler, and Douglas Durkin. rows.title: The Unwritten Law
rows.cast: Greta Nissen, Richard "Skeets" Gallagher
rows.extract: The Unwritten Law is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Christy Cabanne and starring Greta Nissen, Richard "Skeets" Gallagher, and Mary Brian. It was released on November 15, 1932.

rows.title: Uptown New York
rows.cast: Jack Oakie, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Uptown New York is a 1932 American Pre-Code film directed by Victor Schertzinger and starring Jack Oakie, Shirley Grey, and Leon Ames. It is based on the story by Vina Delmar.

rows.cast: Johnny Mack Brown, Evalyn Knapp
rows.extract: The Vanishing Frontier is a 1932 American pre-Code adventure film directed by Phil Rosen, written by Stuart Anthony, and starring Johnny Mack Brown, Evalyn Knapp, ZaSu Pitts, Raymond Hatton, Ben Alexander, J. rows.cast: Tom Tyler, Adele Lacy, Raymond Keane
rows.extract: Vanishing Men is a 1932 American Western film directed by Harry L. Fraser and starring Tom Tyler, Adele Lacy, and Raymond Keane. rows.title: Vanity Fair
rows.cast: Myrna Loy, Conway Tearle, Barbara Kent
rows.extract: Vanity Fair is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Chester M. Franklin and starring Myrna Loy, Conway Tearle and Anthony Bushell. rows.title: Vanity Street
rows.cast: Charles Bickford, Helen Chandler
rows.extract: Vanity Street is a 1932 American Pre-Code crime drama film directed by Nick Grinde and starring Charles Bickford, Helen Chandler and Mayo Methot.

rows.cast: Carole Lombard, Pat O'Brien, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Virtue is a 1932 American Pre-Code romance film directed by Edward Buzzell and starring Carole Lombard and Pat O'Brien.

rows.cast: Shirley Temple, Georgie Smith
rows.extract: War Babies is a 1932 American comedy short film directed by Charles Lamont. It is the second in a series of eight one-reelers that satirized adult films and themes called Baby Burlesks. rows.title: War Correspondent
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Ralph Graves, Lila Lee
rows.extract: War Correspondent is a 1932 American drama film directed by Paul Sloane. The film stars Jack Holt, Ralph Graves and Lila Lee. Although set in war-torn China, War Correspondent was entirely shot in California.

rows.title: The Washington Masquerade
rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, Karen Morley
rows.extract: The Washington Masquerade is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Charles Brabin and written by John Meehan and Samuel Blythe. rows.title: Wayward
rows.cast: Nancy Carroll, Richard Arlen
rows.extract: Wayward is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Edward Sloman and written by Gladys Unger. The film stars Nancy Carroll, Richard Arlen, Pauline Frederick, John Litel, and Margalo Gillmore. It was released on February 19, 1932, by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Week Ends Only
rows.cast: Joan Bennett, Ben Lyon
rows.extract: Week Ends Only is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Alan Crosland and starring Joan Bennett, Ben Lyon and John Halliday. It was made by Fox Film Corporation. The screenplay was written by William M. Conselman and Samuel Hopkins Adams, based on novel by Samuel Hopkins Adams.

rows.title: Week-End Marriage
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Norman Foster
rows.extract: Week-End Marriage is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Thornton Freeland and starring Loretta Young. rows.title: The Western Code
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Nora Lane
rows.extract: The Western Code is a 1932 American Western film directed by John P. McCarthy and starring Tim McCoy, Nora Lane, and Mischa Auer.

rows.title: Western Limited
rows.cast: Estelle Taylor, Edmund Burns, Lucien Prival
rows.extract: Western Limited is a 1932 American drama film directed by Christy Cabanne and starring Estelle Taylor, Edmund Burns, and Lucien Prival. It was released on August 5, 1932.

rows.title: Westward Passage
rows.cast: Ann Harding, Laurence Olivier
rows.extract: Westward Passage is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Robert Milton and starring Ann Harding, Laurence Olivier, ZaSu Pitts and Irving Pichel. rows.title: The Wet Parade
rows.cast: Robert Young, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: The Wet Parade is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Victor Fleming and starring Robert Young, Myrna Loy, Walter Huston, Lewis Stone and Jimmy Durante. rows.title: What Price Hollywood?
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: What Price Hollywood? is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Cukor and starring Constance Bennett with Lowell Sherman. rows.cast: Jackie Cooper, Ralph Graves
rows.extract: When a Feller Needs a Friend is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Harry A. Pollard and written by Frank Butler and Sylvia Thalberg. rows.title: While Paris Sleeps
rows.cast: Victor McLaglen, Helen Mack
rows.extract: While Paris Sleeps is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Allan Dwan and starring Victor McLaglen, Helen Mack and Rita La Roy.

rows.title: Whistlin' Dan
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Joyzelle Joyner
rows.extract: Whistlin' Dan is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Ken Maynard, Joyzelle Joyner, and Georges Renavent. It was released on March 20, 1932, by Tiffany Productions. It was re-released in 1937 by Amity Pictures.

rows.title: White Eagle
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Barbara Weeks
rows.extract: White Eagle is a 1932 American pre-Code Western movie directed by Lambert Hillyer. The film stars Buck Jones, Barbara Weeks, and Robert Ellis. Columbia Pictures later adapted this film into a 1941 serial of the same title, also starring Buck Jones.

rows.title: White Zombie
rows.cast: Bela Lugosi, Madge Bellamy, Joseph Cawthorn
rows.extract: White Zombie is a 1932 American pre-Code horror film independently produced by Edward Halperin and directed by Victor Halperin. rows.title: The Widow in Scarlet
rows.cast: Dorothy Revier, Kenneth Harlan
rows.extract: The Widow in Scarlet is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery crime film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Dorothy Revier, Kenneth Harlan and Lloyd Whitlock. It was distributed by the independent Mayfair Pictures.

rows.title: Wild Girl
rows.cast: Charles Farrell, Joan Bennett
rows.extract: Wild Girl is a 1932 American pre-Code historical drama western film directed by Raoul Walsh and starring Charles Farrell, Joan Bennett, Ralph Bellamy, and Eugene Pallette. rows.title: Wild Horse Mesa
rows.cast: Randolph Scott, Sally Blane
rows.extract: Wild Horse Mesa is a 1932 American Pre-Code Western film directed by Henry Hathaway and starring Randolph Scott and Sally Blane. rows.title: Winner Take All
rows.cast: James Cagney, Marian Nixon
rows.extract: Winner Take All is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by Roy Del Ruth and starring James Cagney as a boxer. rows.title: The Wiser Sex
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Melvyn Douglas
rows.extract: The Wiser Sex is a 1932 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by Berthold Viertel and Victor Viertel and starring Claudette Colbert, Melvyn Douglas, Lilyan Tashman, William "Stage" Boyd and Ross Alexander. Made by Paramount Pictures, its working title was The Weaker Sex.

rows.title: Without Honor
rows.cast: Harry Carey, Mae Busch
rows.extract: Without Honor is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by William Nigh.

rows.title: A Woman Commands
rows.cast: Pola Negri, Roland Young, Basil Rathbone
rows.extract: A Woman Commands is a 1932 American pre-Code film directed by Paul L. Stein and starring Pola Negri, Roland Young, and Basil Rathbone. Some additional scenes were directed by an uncredited Harry Joe Brown.

rows.title: The Woman from Monte Carlo
rows.cast: Lil Dagover, Walter Huston, Warren William
rows.extract: The Woman from Monte Carlo is an American pre-Code film produced by Warner Bros. subsidiary First National Pictures in 1931 and released on January 9, 1932. It was directed by Michael Curtiz and gave top billing to German star Lil Dagover in her sole Hollywood film. Leading men Walter Huston and War

rows.title: The Woman in Room 13
rows.cast: Elissa Landi, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: The Woman in Room 13 is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Henry King and adapted by Guy Bolton from the play of the same name. The film stars Elissa Landi, Ralph Bellamy, Neil Hamilton, Myrna Loy, Gilbert Roland and Walter Walker. The film was released on May 15, 1932, by Fox Film Co

rows.title: Women Won't Tell
rows.cast: Sarah Padden, Otis Harlan

rows.cast: George Bancroft, Miriam Hopkins

rows.cast: Lane Chandler, Adele Lacy

rows.title: You Said a Mouthful
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: You Said a Mouthful is a 1932 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Lloyd Bacon and written by Robert Lord and Bolton Mallory. The film stars Joe E. rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Doris Kenyon
rows.extract: Young America is a 1932 American Pre-Code drama film about two juvenile delinquents - Arthur and Nutty - directed by Frank Borzage and starring Spencer Tracy and Doris Kenyon. It was first adapted for the screen by Maurine Watkins from the play by Fred Ballard. William M. Conselman rewrote the scree

rows.title: Young Blood
rows.cast: Bob Steele, Helen Foster
rows.extract: Young Blood is a 1932 American pre-Code Western film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Bob Steele, Helen Foster, and Charles King. It was released on November 5, 1932.

rows.title: Young Bride
rows.cast: Helen Twelvetrees, Eric Linden
rows.extract: Young Bride is a 1932 American pre-Code drama film directed by William A. Seiter and written by Garrett Fort, Ralph Murphy and Jane Murfin. The film stars Helen Twelvetrees, Eric Linden, Arline Judge, Roscoe Ates and Polly Walters. The film was released on April 8, 1932, by RKO Pictures.

rows.cast: Dick Powell, Ruby Keeler, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: 42nd Street is a 1933 American pre-Code musical film directed by Lloyd Bacon, and a script by Rian James and James Seymour, adapted from the 1932 novel of the same name by Bradford Ropes. rows.cast: Richard Cromwell, Dorothy Wilson

rows.cast: Richard Dix, Ralph Bellamy, Elizabeth Allan
rows.extract: Ace of Aces, also known as Bird of Prey, is a 1933 American pre-Code war film based on the story "The Bird of Prey" by World War I pilot John Monk Saunders that explores how war can turn a man's moral compass from pacifism to warmonger. rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Henri Garat, C. Aubrey Smith
rows.extract: Adorable is a 1933 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by William Dieterle and starring Janet Gaynor as a princess who disguises herself in order to go out socially and have fun, falling in love with a "commoner" in the process. The film also stars Herbert Mundin and Sterling Holloway

rows.cast: Lee Tracy, Sally Blane
rows.extract: Advice to the Lovelorn is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Alfred L. Werker and starring Lee Tracy, Sally Blane, Paul Harvey and Sterling Holloway. The film was released on December 1, 1933, by United Artists. It is based on the novel Miss Lonelyhearts by Nathanael West with a number

rows.title: After Tonight
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Gilbert Roland
rows.extract: After Tonight is a 1933 American pre-Code World War I spy film directed by George Archainbaud and starring Constance Bennett and Gilbert Roland. The studio considered firing Bennett after the film lost $100,000 at the box office.

rows.title: Aggie Appleby, Maker of Men
rows.cast: Charles Farrell, Wynne Gibson, ZaSu Pitts
rows.extract: Aggie Appleby, Maker of Men is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Mark Sandrich and written by Humphrey Pearson and Edward Kaufman. The film stars Charles Farrell, Wynne Gibson, William Gargan, ZaSu Pitts, Betty Furness and Blanche Friderici. The film was released on November 3, 1933,

rows.cast: Evalyn Knapp, James Murray
rows.extract: Air Hostess is a 1933 American Pre-Code aviation-themed melodrama based on a serial published in a 1919 True Story Magazine article called Air Hostess by Grace Perkins, also known as Dora Macy. Director Albert Rogell who had moved from shorts to B-films, had been interested in aviation having alread

rows.title: Alice in Wonderland
rows.cast: Charlotte Henry, Edward Everett Horton, W. C. Fields
rows.extract: Alice in Wonderland is a 1933 American pre-Code fantasy film adapted from the novels by Lewis Carroll. The film was produced by Paramount Pictures, featuring an all-star cast. It is all live action, except for the Walrus and The Carpenter sequence, which was animated by Harman-Ising Studio.

rows.title: Alimony Madness
rows.cast: Helen Chandler, Leon Ames, Alberta Vaughn
rows.extract: Alimony Madness is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by B. Reeves Eason and starring Helen Chandler, Leon Ames, and Edward Earle. The film's sets were designed by the art director Paul Palmentola.

rows.title: Ann Carver's Profession
rows.cast: Fay Wray, Gene Raymond
rows.extract: Ann Carver's Profession is an American pre-Code 1933 film directed by Edward Buzzell. It focuses on the relationship of a female lawyer and her husband, and on the strain that her financial success places on their marriage. The film stars actress Fay Wray and this film was made during the year she c

rows.title: Ann Vickers
rows.cast: Irene Dunne, Walter Huston, Edna May Oliver
rows.extract: Ann Vickers is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic drama directed by John Cromwell and starring Irene Dunne and Walter Huston. It is based on the novel of the same name by Sinclair Lewis.

rows.title: Another Language
rows.cast: Robert Montgomery, Helen Hayes
rows.extract: Another Language is a 1933 American Pre-Code romantic drama film directed by Edward H. Griffith and starring Robert Montgomery and Helen Hayes.

rows.title: Arizona to Broadway
rows.cast: James Dunn, Joan Bennett, Herbert Mundin
rows.extract: Arizona to Broadway is a 1933 American pre-Code crime romance film directed by James Tinling and starring James Dunn and Joan Bennett. It was made by Fox Film Corporation. The screenplay was written by William M. Conselman and Henry Johnson.

rows.title: As the Devil Commands
rows.cast: Mae Clarke, Alan Dinehart, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: As the Devil Commands is a 1932 American pre-Code film written by Jo Swerling from a story by Keene Thompson. It is directed by Roy William Neill and stars Alan Dinehart, Mae Clarke and Neil Hamilton.

rows.title: The Avenger
rows.cast: Ralph Forbes, Adrienne Ames, Charlotte Merriam
rows.extract: The Avenger is a 1933 American drama film directed by Edwin L. Marin and starring Ralph Forbes, Adrienne Ames and Arthur Vinton. The screenplay concerns a former district attorney who seeks vengeance against the gang who framed him leading to his disgrace.

rows.title: Baby Face
rows.cast: Barbara Stanwyck, George Brent, Donald Cook
rows.extract: Baby Face is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Alfred E. Green for Warner Bros., starring Barbara Stanwyck as Lily Powers, and featuring George Brent. rows.title: The Barbarian
rows.cast: Myrna Loy, Ramon Novarro, Edward Arnold
rows.extract: The Barbarian, also known as A Night in Cairo, is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic drama film produced and directed by Sam Wood and starring Ramon Novarro and Myrna Loy. Written by Elmer Harris and Anita Loos, and based on the 1911 play The Arab by Edgar Selwyn, the film is about an American woman

rows.title: Beauty for Sale
rows.cast: Madge Evans, Otto Kruger, Alice Brady
rows.extract: Beauty for Sale is a 1933 American pre-Code film about the romantic entanglements of three beauty salon employees. Based on the 1933 novel Beauty by Faith Baldwin, it stars Madge Evans, Alice Brady, Otto Kruger and Una Merkel.

rows.title: Bed of Roses
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Joel McCrea, Franklin Pangborn
rows.extract: Bed of Roses (1933) is a pre-Code romantic comedy film co-written and directed by Gregory La Cava and starring Constance Bennett. The picture was released by RKO Radio Pictures with a supporting cast featuring Joel McCrea and Pert Kelton.

rows.title: A Bedtime Story
rows.cast: Maurice Chevalier, Edward Everett Horton, Helen Twelvetrees
rows.extract: A Bedtime Story is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic comedy film starring Maurice Chevalier.

rows.title: Before Dawn
rows.cast: Dorothy Wilson, Warner Oland
rows.extract: Before Dawn is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Irving Pichel and written by Garrett Fort. rows.title: Before Midnight
rows.cast: Ralph Bellamy, June Collyer
rows.extract: Before Midnight is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery crime film directed by Lambert Hillyer and starring Ralph Bellamy, June Collyer and Claude Gillingwater. Produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures, it was the first in a series of four films featuring Inspector Steve Trent of the NYPD. Bellamy

rows.title: Before Morning
rows.cast: Leo Carrillo, Taylor Holmes
rows.extract:
Before Morning is a 1933 American pre-Code crime drama directed by Arthur Hoerl, and starring Leo Carrillo, Lora Baxter, and Taylor Holmes. The film was
adapted for the screen by 
Arthur Hoerl, from the 1933 Broadway play of the same name by Edward and Edna Riley.

rows.title: Below the Sea
rows.cast: Ralph Bellamy, Fay Wray, Frederick Vodeding
rows.extract: Below the Sea is a 1933 American Pre-Code action film directed by Albert S. Rogell and starring Fay Wray, Ralph Bellamy and Esther Howard.

rows.title: Berkeley Square
rows.cast: Leslie Howard, Heather Angel, Valerie Taylor
rows.extract: Berkeley Square is a 1933 American pre-Code fantasy drama film produced by Fox Film Corporation, directed by Frank Lloyd, and starring Leslie Howard and Heather Angel. rows.title: Best of Enemies
rows.cast: Buddy Rogers, Marian Nixon, Greta Nissen
rows.extract: Best of Enemies is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Rian James and written by Sam Mintz and Rian James. The film stars Charles "Buddy" Rogers, Marian Nixon, Frank Morgan, Greta Nissen, Joseph Cawthorn and Arno Frey. The film was released on June 23, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.cast: Reginald Denny, Claudia Dell

rows.title: The Big Chance
rows.cast: John Darrow, Mickey Rooney, Natalie Moorhead
rows.extract: The Big Chance is a 1933 American Pre-Code crime film directed by Albert Herman. It was produced by the independent Eagle Pictures and released on the states-rights market.

rows.cast: Clyde Beatty, Anita Page

rows.extract: Big Executive is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Erle C. Kenton and written by Alice Duer Miller and Laurence Stallings. rows.cast: Esther Ralston, Alexander Kirkland, Hale Hamilton
rows.extract: Black Beauty is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Esther Ralston, Alexander Kirkland and Gavin Gordon. rows.title: Blind Adventure
rows.cast: Robert Armstrong, Helen Mack
rows.extract: Blind Adventure is a 1933 American Pre-Code film directed by Ernest B. Schoedsack and starring Robert Armstrong, Helen Mack, Ralph Bellamy, and Roland Young. It was released by RKO Radio Pictures.

rows.title: Breed of the Border

rows.extract: Breed of the Border is a 1933 American Western feature film directed by Robert N. Bradbury and starring Bob Steele. It was distributed through Monogram Pictures.

rows.cast: Joan Blondell, Ricardo Cortez, Ginger Rogers
