rows.title: Design for Living
rows.cast: Fredric March, Gary Cooper, Miriam Hopkins
rows.extract: Design for Living is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Ernst Lubitsch from a screenplay by Ben Hecht, based on the 1932 play of the same name by Noël Coward. Starring Fredric March, Gary Cooper, and Miriam Hopkins, the film is about a woman who cannot decide between two men who love h

rows.title: Destination Unknown
rows.cast: Pat O'Brien, Ralph Bellamy, Alan Hale
rows.extract: Destination Unknown is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Tay Garnett and written by Tom Buckingham. The film stars Pat O'Brien, Ralph Bellamy, Alan Hale, Sr., Russell Hopton, Tom Brown and Betty Compson. The film was released on April 1, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: The Devil's Brother
rows.cast: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Thelma Todd
rows.extract: The Devil's Brother or Fra Diavolo outside the U.S. is a 1933 American Pre-Code comedy film starring Laurel and Hardy. It is based on Daniel Auber's operetta Fra Diavolo about the Italian bandit Fra Diavolo.

rows.title: The Devil's in Love
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Victor Jory, Vivienne Osborne
rows.extract: The Devil's in Love is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by William Dieterle and written by Howard Estabrook. The film stars Victor Jory, Loretta Young, Vivienne Osborne, David Manners, C. Henry Gordon and Herbert Mundin. The film was released on July 21, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: The Devil's Mate
rows.cast: Peggy Shannon, Preston Foster
rows.extract: The Devil's Mate is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Phil Rosen, starring Peggy Shannon and Preston Foster.

rows.title: Diamond Trail
rows.cast: Rex Bell, Frances Rich
rows.extract: Diamond Trail is a 1933 American Pre-Code film directed by Harry L. Fraser.

rows.title: Dinner at Eight
rows.cast: John Barrymore, Wallace Beery, Jean Harlow
rows.extract: Dinner at Eight is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by George Cukor from a screenplay by Frances Marion and Herman J. Mankiewicz, based on George S. Kaufman and Edna Ferber's 1932 play of the same title. The film features an ensemble cast of Marie Dressler, John Barrymore, Wallace

rows.title: Diplomaniacs
rows.cast: Bert Wheeler, Robert Woolsey, Marjorie White
rows.extract: Diplomaniacs is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film starring Wheeler and Woolsey. The film in noted for its absurdist political satire, somewhat in the manner of Million Dollar Legs or Duck Soup, both of which were released within a year of Diplomaniacs.

rows.title: Disgraced!
rows.cast: Helen Twelvetrees, Bruce Cabot, Adrienne Ames
rows.extract: Disgraced! is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Erle C. Kenton and written by Francis Martin and Alice D. G. Miller. The film stars Helen Twelvetrees, Bruce Cabot, Adrienne Ames, William Harrigan, Ken Murray, Charles Middleton and Adrienne D'Ambricourt. The film was released on July

rows.title: Doctor Bull
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Marian Nixon, Vera Allen
rows.extract: Doctor Bull is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by John Ford, based on the James Gould Cozzens novel The Last Adam. Will Rogers portrays a small-town doctor who must deal with a typhoid outbreak in the community.

rows.title: Don't Bet on Love
rows.cast: Lew Ayres, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: Don't Bet on Love is a 1933 American comedy film directed by Murray Roth and written by Howard Emmett Rogers, Murray Roth and Ben Ryan. The film stars Lew Ayres, Ginger Rogers, Charley Grapewin, Shirley Grey, Tom Dugan and Merna Kennedy. The film was released on July 1, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Double Harness
rows.cast: Ann Harding, William Powell
rows.extract: Double Harness (1933) is an American pre-Code film starring Ann Harding and William Powell. It was based on the play of the same name by Edward Poor Montgomery. A young woman maneuvers a lazy playboy into marrying her.

rows.title: Drum Taps
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Charles Stevens
rows.extract: Drum Taps is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed and co-written by J.P. McGowan. It stars Ken Maynard and his brother Kermit Maynard playing brothers.

rows.title: Duck Soup
rows.cast: Groucho Marx, Chico Marx, Margaret Dumont
rows.extract: Duck Soup is a 1933 American pre-Code musical black comedy film written by Bert Kalmar and Harry Ruby, with additional dialogue by Arthur Sheekman and Nat Perrin, directed by Leo McCarey. Released theatrically by Paramount Pictures on November 17, 1933, it starred the Marx Brothers and also featured

rows.title: The Eagle and the Hawk
rows.cast: Fredric March, Cary Grant, Carole Lombard
rows.extract: The Eagle and the Hawk is a 1933 American Pre-Code aerial war film set in World War I. It was directed by Stuart Walker and Mitchell Leisen and was based on an original story by John Monk Saunders. The film stars Fredric March and Cary Grant as Royal Flying Corps fighter pilots. The supporting cast

rows.title: East of Fifth Avenue
rows.cast: Wallace Ford, Mary Carlisle
rows.extract: East of Fifth Avenue is a 1933 American drama film directed by Albert S. Rogell and starring Wallace Ford, Mary Carlisle and Dorothy Tree. It was produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures. The plot revolves around the inhabitants of a cheap New York boarding house.

rows.title: Easy Millions
rows.cast: Richard 'Skeets' Gallagher, Dorothy Burgess
rows.extract: Easy Millions is a 1933 American comedy film directed by Fred C. Newmeyer and starring Richard 'Skeets' Gallagher, Dorothy Burgess and Merna Kennedy.

rows.title: The Eleventh Commandment
rows.cast: Marian Marsh, Theodore von Eltz
rows.extract: The Eleventh Commandment is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Melford and starring Marian Marsh, Theodore von Eltz and Alan Hale. It is based on a play by Brandon Fleming. The story had previously been made into a 1924 British silent film.

rows.title: Elmer, the Great
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Patricia Ellis
rows.extract: Elmer, the Great is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Mervyn LeRoy, starring Joe E. Brown and Patricia Ellis.

rows.title: Emergency Call
rows.cast: William Boyd, Wynne Gibson, Betty Furness
rows.extract: Emergency Call is a 1933 American Pre-Code action film directed by Edward L. Cahn and written by Houston Branch and Joseph L. Mankiewicz. The film stars William Boyd, Wynne Gibson, William Gargan, George E. Stone and Betty Furness. The film was released on June 24, 1933 by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: The Emperor Jones
rows.cast: Paul Robeson, Frank H. Wilson, Dudley Digges
rows.extract: The Emperor Jones is a 1933 American pre-Code film adaptation of Eugene O'Neill's 1920 play of the same title, directed by iconoclast Dudley Murphy, written for the screen by playwright DuBose Heyward and starring Paul Robeson in the title role, and co-starring Dudley Digges, Frank H. Wilson, Fredi

rows.title: Employees' Entrance
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Warren William, Wallace Ford
rows.extract: Employees' Entrance is a 1933 pre-Code film about the devious manager of a New York department store and his romantic involvement with a reluctant new employee. It was directed by Roy Del Ruth. In 2019, the film was selected by the Library of Congress for preservation in the National Film Registry f

rows.title: Eskimo
rows.cast: Ray Mala, Lulu Wong
rows.extract: Eskimo is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by W. S. Van Dyke and released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (MGM). It is based on the books Der Eskimo and Die Flucht ins weisse Land by Danish explorer and author Peter Freuchen. The film stars Ray Mala as Mala, Lulu Wong Wing as Mala's first wife Ab

rows.title: Ever in My Heart
rows.cast: Barbara Stanwyck, Otto Kruger, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: Ever in My Heart is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Archie Mayo and starring Barbara Stanwyck, Otto Kruger, and Ralph Bellamy. It portrays the tragic consequences of the virulent propaganda that spread false stories of atrocities and stigmatized anything German during the Great War.

rows.title: Ex-Lady
rows.cast: Bette Davis, Gene Raymond, Claire Dodd
rows.extract: Ex-Lady is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy/drama film directed by Robert Florey. The screenplay by David Boehm is a remake of the Barbara Stanwyck film Illicit (1931), both crediting a story by Edith Fitzgerald and Robert Riskin. The film focuses on a pair of lovers, commercial illustrator Helen Bau

rows.title: Face in the Sky
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Marian Nixon, Stuart Erwin
rows.extract: Face in the Sky is a 1933 American Pre-Code comedy film.

rows.title: Fargo Express
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Helen Mack, Paul Fix
rows.extract: Fargo Express is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Alan James and starring Ken Maynard, Helen Mack and Roy Stewart.

rows.title: Fast Workers
rows.cast: John Gilbert, Robert Armstrong, Mae Clarke
rows.extract: Fast Workers, also known as Rivets, is a 1933 pre-Code drama film starring John Gilbert and Robert Armstrong as construction workers and romantic rivals for the character played by Mae Clarke. The film, which is based on the unproduced play Rivets by John McDermott, was directed by an uncredited Tod

rows.title: Female
rows.cast: Ruth Chatterton, George Brent, Lois Wilson
rows.extract: Female is a 1933 Warner Bros. pre-Code film directed by Michael Curtiz and starring Ruth Chatterton and George Brent. It is based on the 1933 novel of the same name by Donald Henderson Clarke.

rows.title: The Fiddlin' Buckaroo
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Gloria Shea
rows.extract: The Fiddlin' Buckaroo is a 1933 American Western film directed by Ken Maynard and written by Nate Gatzert. The film stars Ken Maynard, Gloria Shea, Fred Kohler, Frank Rice, Jack Rockwell and Joseph W. Girard. The film was released on July 20, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: The Fighting Code
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Diane Sinclair, Ward Bond
rows.extract:
The Fighting Code is a 1933 American Western film written and directed by Lambert Hillyer. The film stars Buck Jones, 
Diane Sinclair, Ward Bond, Richard Alexander, Alfred P. James and Erville Alderson. The film was released on December 30, 1933, by Columbia Pictures.

rows.title: The Fighting Parson
rows.cast: Hoot Gibson, Marceline Day
rows.extract: The Fighting Parson is a 1933 American Western film directed by Harry L. Fraser and starring Hoot Gibson, Marceline Day and Ethel Wales.

rows.title: Fighting Texans
rows.cast: Rex Bell, Luana Walters
rows.extract: Fighting Texans is a 1933 American Western film directed by Armand Schaefer and written by Wellyn Totman. The film stars Rex Bell, Luana Walters, Betty Mack, Yakima Canutt, Wally Wales and George "Gabby" Hayes. The film was released on June 15, 1933, by Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: File 113
rows.cast: Lew Cody, Mary Nolan
rows.extract: File 113 is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Chester Franklin and starring Lew Cody, Mary Nolan and June Clyde. Monsieur Lecoq, a Parisian detective solves a series of crimes. It is based on a story by the nineteenth century French writer Émile Gaboriau.

rows.title: Flaming Gold
rows.cast: William Boyd, Pat O'Brien, Mae Clarke
rows.extract: Flaming Gold is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Ralph Ince and written by Malcolm Stuart Boylan and John F. Goodrich. The film stars William Boyd, Pat O'Brien, Mae Clarke, Rollo Lloyd and Helen Ware. The film was released on September 29, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Flying Devils
rows.cast: Bruce Cabot, Arline Judge, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: Flying Devils is a 1933 American Pre-Code action film dealing with aviation. The film was directed by former Hollywood agent Russell Birdwell and photographed by film noir cinematographer Nicholas Musuraca. The screenplay was written by Byron Morgan and Louis Stevens, based on an original story by S

rows.title: Flying Down to Rio
rows.cast: Dolores del Río, Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: Flying Down to Rio is a 1933 American pre-Code RKO musical film famous for being the first screen pairing of Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, although Dolores del Río and Gene Raymond received top billing and the leading roles. Among the featured players are Franklin Pangborn and Eric Blore. The song

rows.title: Fog
rows.cast: Mary Brian, Reginald Denny
rows.extract:
Fog is a 1933 American pre-Code thriller film directed by Albert S. Rogell and produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures. It stars Mary Brian, Donald Cook and Reginald Denny.
The Library of Congress holds a print of the film.

rows.title: Footlight Parade
rows.cast: James Cagney, Joan Blondell, Ruby Keeler
rows.extract: Footlight Parade is a 1933 American pre-Code musical film starring James Cagney, Joan Blondell, Ruby Keeler and Dick Powell and featuring Frank McHugh, Guy Kibbee, Hugh Herbert and Ruth Donnelly. The film was written by Manuel Seff and James Seymour based on a story by Robert Lord and Peter Milne, a

rows.title: Forgotten
rows.cast: Lee Kohlmar, June Clyde
rows.extract: Forgotten is a 1933 American Pre-Code film directed by Richard Thorpe.

rows.title: Found Alive
rows.cast: Barbara Bedford, Maurice Murphy, Robert Frazer
rows.extract: Found Alive is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Charles Hutchison and starring Barbara Bedford, Maurice Murphy and Robert Frazer.

rows.title: From Headquarters
rows.cast: George Brent, Margaret Lindsay, Eugene Pallette
rows.extract: From Headquarters is a 1933 American pre-Code murder mystery film starring George Brent, Margaret Lindsay and Eugene Pallette, and directed by William Dieterle.

rows.title: From Hell to Heaven
rows.cast: Carole Lombard, Jack Oakie, Adrienne Ames
rows.extract: From Hell to Heaven is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film. It was directed by Erle C. Kenton, and features an ensemble cast including Carole Lombard, Jack Oakie, Adrienne Ames and Sidney Blackmer. It was adapted from the stage play by Lawrence Hazard.

rows.title: The Fugitive
rows.cast: Rex Bell, Cecilia Parker
rows.extract: The Fugitive is a 1933 American Western film directed by Harry L. Fraser and starring Rex Bell, Cecilia Parker and Bob Kortman.

rows.title: Fury of the Jungle
rows.cast: Donald Cook, Peggy Shannon
rows.extract: Fury of the Jungle is a 1933 American adventure film directed by Roy William Neill and starring Donald Cook, Peggy Shannon and Alan Dinehart. It was co-written by Dore Schary from a story by Horace McCoy.

rows.title: Gabriel Over the White House
rows.cast: Walter Huston, Franchot Tone, Karen Morley
rows.extract: Gabriel Over the White House is a 1933 American pre-Code political fantasy film starring Walter Huston as a genial but politically corrupt U.S. President who has a near-fatal automobile accident and comes under divine influence—specifically the Archangel Gabriel and the spirit of Abraham Lincoln. Ev

rows.title: The Gallant Fool
rows.cast: Bob Steele, Arletta Duncan
rows.extract: The Gallant Fool is a 1933 American Western film directed by Robert N. Bradbury and starring Bob Steele, Arletta Duncan and George 'Gabby' Hayes.

rows.title: Galloping Romeo
rows.cast: Bob Steele, Doris Hill
rows.extract: Galloping Romeo is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film released by Monogram Pictures, written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, and starring Bob Steele.

rows.title: Gambling Ship
rows.cast: Cary Grant, Jack La Rue, Benita Hume
rows.extract: Gambling Ship is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Louis J. Gasnier and Max Marcin, and starring Cary Grant and Benita Hume. It was based on Paul Cain's short stories: "Fast One", "Lead Party", "Velvet" and "The Heat", which were published in Black Mask magazine. It was released on Jun

rows.title: Gigolettes of Paris
rows.cast: Madge Bellamy, Gilbert Roland, Natalie Moorhead
rows.extract: Gigolettes of Paris is a 1933 American movie directed by Alphonse Martell, produced by Equitable Pictures, and starring Madge Bellamy and Gilbert Roland.

rows.title: The Girl in 419
rows.cast: Gloria Stuart, David Manners
rows.extract: The Girl in 419 is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Alexander Hall and George Somnes and written by Allen Rivkin, Manuel Seff and P.J. Wolfson. The film stars James Dunn, Gloria Stuart, David Manners, William Harrigan, Shirley Grey and Jack La Rue. The film was released on May 26, 193

rows.title: Girl Missing
rows.cast: Glenda Farrell, Mary Brian, Ben Lyon
rows.extract: Girl Missing is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film starring Glenda Farrell, Ben Lyon and Mary Brian. It was directed by Robert Florey and released by Warner Bros. on March 4, 1933. Two women stranded in Palm Beach become involved in the case of a new bride who goes missing on her wedding night.

rows.title: Girl Without a Room
rows.cast: Charles Ruggles, Marguerite Churchill
rows.extract: Girl Without a Room is a 1933 American pre-Code musical comedy film starring Charles Farrell, Charles Ruggles, and Marguerite Churchill. This early light comedy farce set in Paris was written by Claude Binyon, Frank Butler, and Jack Lait, and directed by Ralph Murphy.

rows.title: Going Hollywood
rows.cast: Bing Crosby, Marion Davies, Ned Sparks
rows.extract: Going Hollywood is a 1933 American pre-Code musical film directed by Raoul Walsh and starring Marion Davies and Bing Crosby. It was written by Donald Ogden Stewart and based on a story by Frances Marion. Going Hollywood was released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer on December 22, 1933.

rows.title: Gold Diggers of 1933
rows.cast: Warren Williams, Ginger Rogers, Aline MacMahon
rows.extract: Gold Diggers of 1933 is a pre-Code Warner Bros. musical film directed by Mervyn LeRoy with songs by Harry Warren (music) and Al Dubin (lyrics), staged and choreographed by Busby Berkeley. It stars Warren William, Joan Blondell, Aline MacMahon, Ruby Keeler, and Dick Powell, and features Guy Kibbee, N

rows.title: Golden Harvest
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Genevieve Tobin
rows.extract: Golden Harvest is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Ralph Murphy and written by Nina Wilcox Putnam and Casey Robinson. The film stars Richard Arlen, Chester Morris, Genevieve Tobin, Roscoe Ates, Julie Haydon, Elizabeth Patterson and Berton Churchill. The film was released on September

rows.title: Goldie Gets Along
rows.cast: Lili Damita, Charles Morton
rows.extract: Goldie Gets Along is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Malcolm St. Clair and starring Lili Damita, Charles Morton and Sam Hardy. The screenplay was written by William A. Drake, based on the 1931 novel of the same title by Hawthorne Hurst.

rows.title: Goodbye Again
rows.cast: Warren William, Joan Blondell, Genevieve Tobin
rows.extract: Goodbye Again is a 1933 pre-Code romantic comedy film made by First National Pictures and Warner Bros.

rows.title: Goodbye Love
rows.cast: Charles Ruggles, Verree Teasdale
rows.extract: Goodbye Love is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by H. Bruce Humberstone and starring Charles Ruggles.

rows.title: Grand Slam
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Paul Lukas, Frank McHugh
rows.extract: Grand Slam is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by William Dieterle and Alfred E. Green and starring Paul Lukas, Loretta Young and Frank McHugh. The film was released by Warner Bros. on March 18, 1933.

rows.title: The Great Jasper
rows.cast: Richard Dix, Edna May Oliver
rows.extract: The Great Jasper is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by J. Walter Ruben and written by H.W. Hanemann and Samuel Ornitz. The film stars Richard Dix, Edna May Oliver, Florence Eldridge, Wera Engels and Walter Walker. The film was released on February 17, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Gun Justice
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Cecilia Parker
rows.extract: Gun Justice is a 1933 American Western film directed by Alan James and written by Robert Quigley. The film stars Ken Maynard, Cecilia Parker, Hooper Atchley, Walter Miller, William Gould and Jack Rockwell. The film was released on December 11, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Gun Law
rows.cast: Jack Hoxie, Betty Boyd, Mary Carr
rows.extract:
Gun Law is a 1933 American pre-Code
Western film directed by Lewis D. Collins and starring Jack Hoxie, Betty Boyd and Mary Carr. It was remade in 1937 as Melody of the Plains.

rows.title: Hallelujah, I'm a Bum
rows.cast: Al Jolson, Madge Evans, Frank Morgan
rows.extract: Hallelujah, I'm a Bum is a 1933 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by Lewis Milestone and set in the Great Depression.

rows.title: Hard to Handle
rows.cast: James Cagney, Mary Brian, Allen Jenkins
rows.extract: Hard to Handle (1933) is a pre-Code comedy film starring James Cagney as a breezily clowning con artist who organizes a Depression-era dance marathon. His character remarks at one point, "The mass is a cow. It must be milked". The movie was produced at Warner Bros. and directed by Mervyn LeRoy.

rows.title: Havana Widows
rows.cast: Joan Blondell, Glenda Farrell, Guy Kibbee
rows.extract: Havana Widows is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Ray Enright, starring Joan Blondell and Glenda Farrell. It was released by Warner Bros. on November 18, 1933. Two chorus girls travel to Havana in search of rich husbands. Their target is Deacon Jones, a self-appointed moralist who ca

rows.title: He Couldn't Take It
rows.cast: Ray Walker, Virginia Cherrill
rows.extract: He Couldn't Take It is a 1933 American comedy film directed by William Nigh and starring Ray Walker, Virginia Cherrill and George E. Stone. The script was written by Dore Schary and George Waggner and was made for Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: Headline Shooter
rows.cast: William Gargan, Frances Dee, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: Headline Shooter is a 1933 American pre-Code drama about the life of a newsreel photographer. Director Otto Brower intertwined the screenplay written by Agnes Christine Johnston, Allen Rivkin, and Arthur Kober, with actual newsreel footage of natural and man-made disasters. The film starred William

rows.title: Hell and High Water
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Guy Standing
rows.extract: Hell and High Water is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Grover Jones and William Slavens McNutt and written by Grover Jones, Agnes Brand Leahy, William Slavens McNutt and Max Miller. The film stars Richard Arlen, Judith Allen, Charley Grapewin, Gertrude Hoffman, Guy Standing, and Will

rows.title: Hell Below
rows.cast: Robert Montgomery, Walter Huston, Jimmy Durante
rows.extract: Hell Below is a 1933 American MGM pre-Code film set in the Adriatic Sea during World War I about submarine warfare based on Commander Edward Ellsberg's novel Pigboats. The film stars Robert Montgomery, Walter Huston, Robert Young, Madge Evans and Jimmy Durante.

rows.title: Hello, Everybody!
rows.cast: Kate Smith, Randolph Scott
rows.extract: Hello, Everybody! is a 1933 American Pre-Code musical film directed by William A. Seiter and written by Lawrence Hazard, Fannie Hurst, and Dorothy Yost. The film stars Kate Smith, Randolph Scott, Sally Blane, Charley Grapewin, George Barbier, Wade Boteler and Julia Swayne Gordon. The film was releas

rows.title: Hello, Sister!
rows.cast: James Dunn, ZaSu Pitts
rows.extract: Hello, Sister! is a 1933 American pre-Code drama-romance film produced by Fox Film Corporation. It was directed by Erich von Stroheim, Raoul Walsh, and Alfred L. Werker, although no directorial credit is given. The film is a re-edited version of von Stroheim's now-lost film Walking Down Broadway.

rows.title: Her Bodyguard
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Wynne Gibson
rows.extract: Her Bodyguard is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by William Beaudine and starring Edmund Lowe, Wynne Gibson and Edward Arnold.

rows.title: Her First Mate
rows.cast: Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts, Una Merkel
rows.extract: Her First Mate is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by William Wyler and written by Clarence Marks, Earle Snell and H. M. Walker, who adapted it from the play written by Frank Craven, John Golden and Daniel Jarrett. The film stars Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts, Una Merkel, Warren Hymer, B

rows.title: Her Forgotten Past
rows.cast: Monte Blue, Barbara Kent, Henry B. Walthall
rows.extract: Her Forgotten Past is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Wesley Ford and starring Monte Blue, Barbara Kent and Henry B. Walthall.

rows.title: Her Resale Value
rows.cast: June Clyde, Noel Francis, Crauford Kent
rows.extract: Her Resale Value is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by B. Reeves Eason and starring June Clyde, George J. Lewis and Noel Francis. The film's sets were designed by the art director Paul Palmentola.

rows.title: Her Splendid Folly
rows.cast: Lilian Bond, Theodore von Eltz

rows.title: Heroes for Sale
rows.cast: Richard Barthelmess, Aline MacMahon, Loretta Young
rows.extract: Heroes for Sale (1933) is an American pre-Code drama film directed by William Wellman, starring Richard Barthelmess, Aline MacMahon, and Loretta Young, and released by Warner Bros. and First National Pictures. The 76-minute original is considered lost; a 71-minute version is available from Turner En

rows.title: High Gear
rows.cast: James Murray, Joan Marsh, Theodore von Eltz
rows.extract: High Gear is a 1933 American Pre-Code film directed by Leigh Jason. It stars James Murray and Joan Marsh. The film was known as The Big Thrill in the United Kingdom.

rows.title: His Double Life
rows.cast: Roland Young, Lillian Gish, Montagu Love
rows.extract: His Double Life is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by Broadway theatrical impresario and first time film director Arthur Hopkins with directorial input from the experienced William C. deMille, Cecil's older brother. It stars Roland Young and Lillian Gish.

rows.title: His Private Secretary
rows.cast: John Wayne, Evalyn Knapp, Reginald Barlow
rows.extract: His Private Secretary is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Phil Whitman and starring Evalyn Knapp and John Wayne. It is an early Wayne non-Western film appearance, made when he was 26 years old.

rows.title: Hold Me Tight
rows.cast: James Dunn, Sally Eilers, June Clyde
rows.extract: Hold Me Tight is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by David Butler and written by Gladys Lehman. The film stars James Dunn, Sally Eilers, Frank McHugh and June Clyde. The film was released on May 20, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Hold the Press
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Hold the Press is a 1933 American pre-Code crime drama film, directed by Phil Rosen. It stars Tim McCoy, Shirley Grey, and Wheeler Oakman, and was released on October 25, 1933.

rows.title: Hold Your Man
rows.cast: Clark Gable, Jean Harlow, Stuart Erwin
rows.extract: Hold Your Man  is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic drama film directed by an uncredited Sam Wood and starring Jean Harlow and Clark Gable, the third of their six films together. The screenplay by Anita Loos and Howard Emmett Rogers was based on a story by Loos.

rows.title: Hoop-La
rows.cast: Clara Bow, Preston Foster
rows.extract: Hoop-La is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Frank Lloyd, and starring Clara Bow, Preston Foster, Richard Cromwell and Minna Gombell also in the cast. The film is based on the play The Barker by Kenyon Nicholson, which was also filmed in 1928 under the same title as the play.

rows.title: Horse Play
rows.cast: Slim Summerville, Andy Devine, Leila Hyams
rows.extract: Horse Play is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Edward Sedgwick and written by H. M. Walker and Dale Van Every. The film stars Slim Summerville, Andy Devine, Leila Hyams, May Beatty, Una O'Connor and David Torrence. The film was released on June 1, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Hot Pepper
rows.cast: Lupe Vélez, Edmund Lowe, Victor McLaglen
rows.extract: Hot Pepper (1933) is an American pre-Code comedy film starring Lupe Vélez, Edmund Lowe, and Victor McLaglen, directed by John G. Blystone and released by Fox Film Corporation. The film appeared before the enforcement of the Production Code.

rows.title: Hotel Variety
rows.cast: Hal Skelly, Olive Borden, Sally Rand

rows.title: The House on 56th Street
rows.cast: Kay Francis, Ricardo Cortez, Margaret Lindsay
rows.extract: The House on 56th Street is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film. The film's plot involves a miscarriage of justice, wrongful conviction and imprisonment, and alienation of a prisoner from her only living relative.

rows.title: Humanity
rows.cast: Ralph Morgan, Irene Ware
rows.extract: Humanity is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by John Francis Dillon and written by Bradley King. The film stars Ralph Morgan, Boots Mallory, Alexander Kirkland, Irene Ware, Noel Madison and Wade Boteler. The film was released om March 3, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: I Am Suzanne
rows.cast: Lilian Harvey, Gene Raymond, Leslie Banks
rows.extract: I Am Suzanne! is a 1933 American pre-Code romance film involving puppeteers in Paris written by Edwin Justus Mayer, directed by Rowland V. Lee, and starring Lilian Harvey, Gene Raymond and Leslie Banks. The picture's puppetry sequences feature the Yale Puppeteers and Podrecca's Piccoli Theater. The

rows.title: I Cover the Waterfront
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Ben Lyon, Ernest Torrence
rows.extract: I Cover the Waterfront is a 1933 American Pre-Code romantic drama film directed by James Cruze and starring Ben Lyon, Claudette Colbert, Ernest Torrence, and Hobart Cavanaugh.

rows.title: I Have Lived
rows.cast: Alan Dinehart, Anita Page, Gertrude Astor
rows.extract: I Have Lived is a 1933 American drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Alan Dinehart, Anita Page and Allen Vincent.

rows.title: I Love That Man
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Nancy Carroll
rows.extract: I Love That Man is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Harry Joe Brown and written by C. Graham Baker, Casey Robinson and Gene Towne. The film stars Edmund Lowe, Nancy Carroll, Robert Armstrong, Lew Cody, Warren Hymer, Grant Mitchell and Dorothy Burgess. The film was released on June 9,

rows.title: I Loved a Woman
rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Kay Francis, Genevieve Tobin
rows.extract: I Loved a Woman is a 1933 American pre-Code drama directed by Alfred E. Green, starring Kay Francis, Edward G. Robinson, and Genevieve Tobin. According to producer Hal Wallis' autobiography, Robinson and Francis "were oddly matched. Kay was so tall that we had to put Eddie [Robinson] on a box in som

rows.title: I Loved You Wednesday
rows.cast: Warner Baxter, Elissa Landi
rows.extract: I Loved You Wednesday is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy drama film directed by Henry King and William Cameron Menzies and written by Philip Klein and Horace Jackson, adapted from the 1932 play of the same title by Molly Ricardel and William DuBois. The film stars Warner Baxter, Elissa Landi, Victor

rows.title: I'm No Angel
rows.cast: Mae West, Cary Grant, Edward Arnold
rows.extract: I'm No Angel is a 1933 pre-Code film directed by Wesley Ruggles, and starring Mae West and Cary Grant. West received sole story and screenplay credit. It is one of her films that was not subjected to heavy censorship.

rows.title: If I Were Free
rows.cast: Irene Dunne, Clive Brook, Nils Asther
rows.extract: If I Were Free is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Elliott Nugent and written by Dwight Taylor, based on the play, Behold, We Live by John Van Druten. The film stars Irene Dunne, Clive Brook, Nils Asther and Henry Stephenson. The film was released on December 1, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: The Important Witness
rows.cast: Noel Francis, Dorothy Burgess
rows.extract: The Important Witness is an American 1933 pre-Code crime drama directed by Sam Newfield which stars Noel Francis, Dorothy Burgess, and Donald Dillaway.

rows.title: In the Money
rows.cast: Richard "Skeets" Gallagher, Lois Wilson
rows.extract: In the Money is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Frank Strayer from an original screenplay by Robert Ellis. Starring Richard "Skeets" Gallagher, Lois Wilson, and Warren Hymer, the film was produced and distributed by the common tandem duo of Poverty Row studios, Invincible Corp. and

rows.title: Infernal Machine
rows.cast: Chester Morris, Genevieve Tobin
rows.extract: Infernal Machine is a 1933 American pre-Code thriller film directed by Marcel Varnel and starring Chester Morris, Genevieve Tobin and Victor Jory. The film was based on a novel by Karl Sloboda. Released by Fox Film Corporation, the title is sometimes written as The Infernal Machine. After finishing

rows.title: International House
rows.cast: W. C. Fields, Stuart Erwin, George Burns
rows.extract: International House is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film starring Peggy Hopkins Joyce and W. C. Fields, directed by A. Edward Sutherland and released by Paramount Pictures. The tagline of the film was "The Grand Hotel of comedy". It is a mixture of comedy and musical acts tied together by a slim

rows.title: The Intruder
rows.cast: Lila Lee, Monte Blue, William B. Davidson
rows.extract: The Intruder is a 1933 Pre code comedy crime film directed by Albert Ray and starring Monte Blue and Lila Lee, two silent screen veterans. The cast also featured Gwen Lee, Arthur Housman and Mischa Auer. Shot at the RKO-Pathé Studios in California, it was produced and distributed by the Poverty Row

rows.title: The Invisible Man
rows.cast: Claude Rains, Gloria Stuart, Henry Travers
rows.extract: The Invisible Man is a 1933 American science fiction horror film directed by James Whale based on H. G. Wells' 1897 novel The Invisible Man, produced by Universal Pictures, and starring Gloria Stuart, Claude Rains and William Harrigan. The film involves a Dr. Jack Griffin (Rains) who is covered in b

rows.title: The Iron Master
rows.cast: Reginald Denny, Lila Lee

rows.title: It's Great to Be Alive
rows.cast: Edna May Oliver, Gloria Stuart, Raul Roulien
rows.extract: It's Great to Be Alive (1933) is an American Pre-Code science fiction musical comedy film produced by Fox Film Corporation, is a remake of The Last Man on Earth (1924), and later influenced the novel Mr. Adam (1946) by Pat Frank.

rows.title: Jennie Gerhardt
rows.cast: Sylvia Sidney, Mary Astor, Edward Arnold
rows.extract: Jennie Gerhardt is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Marion Gering for Paramount Pictures. It stars Sylvia Sidney, Mary Astor, and Edward Arnold. The film is based on the 1911 novel Jennie Gerhardt by Theodore Dreiser.

rows.title: Jimmy and Sally
rows.cast: James Dunn, Claire Trevor
rows.extract: Jimmy and Sally is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by James Tinling and written by Paul Schofield and Marguerite Roberts with additional dialogue by William Conselman. Starring James Dunn, Claire Trevor, Harvey Stephens, Lya Lys, and Jed Prouty, the story concerns a self-centered

rows.title: Jungle Bride
rows.cast: Anita Page, Charles Starrett, Kenneth Thomson
rows.extract: Jungle Bride is a 1933 American pre-Code film directed by Harry O. Hoyt and Albert H. Kelley.

rows.title: Justice Takes a Holiday
rows.cast: H.B. Warner, John Ince
rows.extract: Justice Takes a Holiday is a 1933 American crime film directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet and written by John T. Neville. The film stars H. B. Warner, Patricia O'Brien, John Ince, Matty Kemp, Huntley Gordon, Audrey Ferris and Robert Frazer. The film was released on April 18, 1933, by Mayfair Pictures.

rows.title: The Kennel Murder Case
rows.cast: William Powell, Mary Astor, Eugene Pallette
rows.extract: The Kennel Murder Case is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film adapted from the 1933 novel of the same name by S. S. Van Dine. Directed by Michael Curtiz for Warner Bros., it stars William Powell and Mary Astor. Powell's role as Philo Vance is not the actor's first performance as the aristocratic s

rows.title: The Keyhole
rows.cast: Kay Francis, George Brent, Glenda Farrell
rows.extract: The Keyhole is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by Michael Curtiz, starring Kay Francis, George Brent, Glenda Farrell and Allen Jenkins. It was released by Warner Bros. on March 25, 1933. A woman with two husbands tries to divorce one of them by heading down to Havana where things

rows.title: King for a Night
rows.cast: Chester Morris, Helen Twelvetrees, Alice White
rows.extract: King for a Night is a 1933 American pre-Code crime film directed by Kurt Neumann starring Chester Morris and Helen Twelvetrees.

rows.title: King Kong
rows.cast: Fay Wray, Robert Armstrong, Bruce Cabot
rows.extract: King Kong is a 1933 American pre-Code adventure horror monster film directed and produced by Merian C. Cooper and Ernest B. Schoedsack, with special effects by Willis H. O'Brien. Produced and distributed by RKO Radio Pictures, it is the first film in the King Kong franchise. The film stars Fay Wray,

rows.title: King of the Arena
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Lucile Browne
rows.extract:
King of the Arena is a 1933 American pre-Code
Western film written and directed by Alan James. The film stars Ken Maynard, Lucile Browne, John St. Polis, Bob Kortman, Michael Visaroff and James A. Marcus. The film was released on June 1, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: King of the Jungle
rows.cast: Buster Crabbe, Frances Dee, Irving Pichel
rows.extract: King of the Jungle is a 1933 American pre-Code adventure film directed by H. Bruce Humberstone and Max Marcin and written by Charles Thurley Stoneham, Max Marcin, Fred Niblo, Jr. and Philip Wylie. The film stars Buster Crabbe, Frances Dee, Sidney Toler, Nydia Westman, Robert Barrat, Irving Pichel an

rows.title: King of the Wild Horses
rows.cast: William Janney, Dorothy Appleby
rows.extract: King of the Wild Horses is a 1933 American Columbia Pictures Western film directed by Earl Haley. It was produced and released by Columbia Pictures with stunts by Yakima Canutt.

rows.title: The King's Vacation
rows.cast: George Arliss, Patricia Ellis
rows.extract: The King's Vacation is a 1933 American pre-Code romance film starring George Arliss and Marjorie Gateson and directed by John G. Adolfi. The supporting cast features Dick Powell, Patricia Ellis, Florence Arliss, Dudley Digges and O. P. Heggie.

rows.title: The Kiss Before the Mirror
rows.cast: Nancy Carroll, Frank Morgan, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: The Kiss Before the Mirror is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film adapted from the 1932 play by Ladislas Fodor, directed by James Whale and starring Nancy Carroll, Frank Morgan, Paul Lukas, and Gloria Stuart.

rows.title: Kiss of Araby
rows.cast: Maria Alba, Walter Byron, Claire Windsor
rows.extract: Kiss of Araby is a 1933 American Pre-Code adventure film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Maria Alba, Walter Byron and Claire Windsor. It is an action melodrama set in the Middle East.

rows.title: Ladies Must Love
rows.cast: June Knight, Neil Hamilton, Sally O'Neil
rows.extract: Ladies Must Love is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by E. A. Dupont and written by John Francis Larkin. The film stars June Knight, Neil Hamilton, Sally O'Neil, Dorothy Burgess, Mary Carlisle and George E. Stone. The film was released on September 25, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Ladies They Talk About
rows.cast: Barbara Stanwyck, Preston Foster
rows.extract: Ladies They Talk About is a 1933 pre-Code American crime drama directed by Howard Bretherton and William Keighley, and starring Barbara Stanwyck, Preston Foster, and Lyle Talbot. The film is about an attractive woman who is a member of a bank-robbery gang. It is based on the play Gangstress, or Wome

rows.title: Lady for a Day
rows.cast: Warren William, May Robson, Guy Kibbee
rows.extract: Lady for a Day is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy-drama film directed by Frank Capra. The screenplay by Robert Riskin is based on the 1929 short story "Madame La Gimp" by Damon Runyon. It was the first film for which Capra received an Academy Award nomination for Best Director and the first Columbia

rows.title: Lady Killer
rows.cast: James Cagney, Margaret Lindsay, Mae Clarke
rows.extract: Lady Killer is a 1933 American pre-Code crime drama film starring James Cagney, Mae Clarke, and Margaret Lindsay, based on the story "The Finger Man" by Rosalind Keating Shaffer. The picture was directed by Roy Del Ruth.

rows.title: A Lady's Profession
rows.cast: Alison Skipworth, Roland Young, Sari Maritza
rows.extract: A Lady's Profession is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Norman Z. McLeod and written by Malcolm Stuart Boylan, Walter DeLeon and Nina Wilcox Putnam. The film stars Alison Skipworth, Roland Young, Sari Maritza, Kent Taylor, Roscoe Karns, Warren Hymer and George Barbier. The film was r

rows.title: The Last Trail
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Claire Trevor
rows.extract: The Last Trail is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by James Tinling and written by Stuart Anthony. The film stars George O'Brien, Claire Trevor, El Brendel, Matt McHugh, J. Carrol Naish, and George Reed. The film was released on August 25, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation. The picture was

rows.title: Laughing at Life
rows.cast: Victor McLaglen, Conchita Montenegro
rows.extract: Laughing at Life is a 1933 American pre-Code film directed by Ford Beebe.

rows.title: Laughter in Hell
rows.cast: Pat O'Brien, Gloria Stuart, Merna Kennedy
rows.extract: Laughter in Hell is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Edward L. Cahn and starring Pat O'Brien. The film's title was typical of the sensationalistic titles of many Pre-Code films. Adapted from the 1932 novel of the same name by Jim Tully, the film was inspired in part by I Am a Fugitive

rows.title: Let's Fall in Love
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Ann Sothern
rows.extract: Let's Fall in Love is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic musical film starring Edmund Lowe and Ann Sothern. Released by Columbia Pictures, the film was directed by David Burton and written by Herbert Fields.

rows.title: Life in the Raw
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Claire Trevor, Greta Nissen
rows.extract: Life in the Raw is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film, based on Zane Grey's short story "From Missouri", directed by Louis King and written by Stuart Anthony. It was Claire Trevor's film debut.

rows.title: The Life of Jimmy Dolan
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Loretta Young
rows.extract: The Life of Jimmy Dolan, released in the UK as The Kid's Last Fight, is a 1933 American pre-Code film starring Douglas Fairbanks Jr. and Loretta Young. John Wayne has a small supporting role as a frightened boxer. The story was based on a 1933 play called "Sucker" by Bertram Millhauser. The film was

rows.title: Lilly Turner
rows.cast: Ruth Chatterton, Frank McHugh, Robert Barrat
rows.extract: Lilly Turner is a 1933 American pre-Code melodrama directed by William A. Wellman and starring Ruth Chatterton. It was based on the 1932 play of the same name by Phillip Dunning and George Abbott.

rows.title: The Little Giant
rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Mary Astor, Russell Hopton
rows.extract: The Little Giant is a 1933 American pre-Code crime comedy romance. It follows the attempts of an ex-gangster to make his way into high society.

rows.title: Little Women
rows.cast: Katharine Hepburn, Joan Bennett, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: Little Women is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Cukor and starring Katharine Hepburn, Joan Bennett, Frances Dee and Jean Parker. The screenplay, written by Sarah Y. Mason and Victor Heerman, is based on the 1868-69 two-volume novel of the same name by Louisa May Alcott.

rows.title: The Lone Avenger
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Niles Welch
rows.extract: The Lone Avenger is a 1933 American Western film directed by Alan James and written by Forrest Sheldon and Betty Burbridge. The film stars Ken Maynard, Muriel Gordon, James Marcus, Alan Bridge, Niles Welch and William Bailey. The film was released on May 14, 1933, by Sono Art-World Wide Pictures.

rows.title: Lone Cowboy
rows.cast: Jackie Cooper, Lila Lee
rows.extract: Lone Cowboy is a 1933 American Pre-Code Western film directed by Paul Sloane and written by Paul Sloane, Agnes Brand Leahy, Bobby Vernon, and Will James. The film stars Jackie Cooper, Lila Lee, and Addison Richards. The film was released on December 1, 1933, by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Looking Forward
rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, Lewis Stone, Benita Hume
rows.extract: Looking Forward is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Clarence Brown starring Lionel Barrymore, Lewis Stone and Benita Hume. It was produced and distributed by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. The sets and costumes were designed by studio regulars Cedric Gibbons and Adrian. Based on the 1932 Dodie

rows.title: Love, Honor, and Oh Baby!
rows.cast: Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts, Verree Teasdale
rows.extract: Love, Honor, and Oh Baby! is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film, starring Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts, and George Barbier. The 1940 Universal Pictures film with the same title is not a remake. Adapted from the stage play, "Oh, Promise Me". Pitts plays a secretary that plots with her ambulance cha

rows.title: Love Is Dangerous
rows.cast: John Warburton, Rochelle Hudson
rows.extract: Love Is Dangerous is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring John Warburton, Rochelle Hudson, Bradley Page, Judith Vosselli, and Dorothy Revier. The film is also known as Love Is Like That.

rows.title: Lucky Devils
rows.cast: William Boyd, Bruce Cabot
rows.extract: Lucky Devils is a 1933 American Pre-Code action film about group of Hollywood stuntmen and their dangerous daredevil stunt work, starring William Boyd and Bruce Cabot, and features an early appearance by Lon Chaney Jr.

rows.title: Lucky Dog
rows.cast: Tom O'Brien, Harry Holman
rows.extract: Lucky Dog is a 1933 American drama film directed by Zion Myers and written by Zion Myers and Roland Asher. The film stars Charles "Chic" Sale, Tom O'Brien, Harry Holman and Clarence Geldart. The film was released on April 20, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Luxury Liner
rows.cast: George Brent, Zita Johann, Alice White
rows.extract: Luxury Liner is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Lothar Mendes and starring George Brent, Zita Johann and Vivienne Osborne. It was based on a 1932 novel by Gina Kaus, and made by Paramount Pictures. Mendes worked on a number of films for Paramount during the era. Shortly after making

rows.title: The Mad Game
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Claire Trevor, J. Carrol Naish
rows.extract: The Mad Game is a 1933 American Pre-Code crime drama film starring Spencer Tracy and Claire Trevor.

rows.title: Made on Broadway
rows.cast: Robert Montgomery, Madge Evans, Sally Eilers
rows.extract: Made on Broadway is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Harry Beaumont and written by Courtney Terrett. The film stars Robert Montgomery, Sally Eilers, Madge Evans, Eugene Pallette, C. Henry Gordon and Jean Parker. The film was released on May 19, 1933, by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

rows.title: Mama Loves Papa
rows.cast: Charlie Ruggles, Mary Boland
rows.extract: Mama Loves Papa is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Norman Z. McLeod, with a story by Nunnally Johnson and Douglas MacLean, and a screenplay by MacLean, Keene Thompson, and Arthur Kober. The film was produced by Paramount Pictures and stars Charlie Ruggles and Mary Boland.

rows.title: The Man from Monterey
rows.cast: John Wayne, Ruth Hall, Lafe McKee
rows.extract: The Man from Monterey is a 1933 American pre-Code Western directed by Mack V. Wright and starring John Wayne. The picture was released by Warner Bros. Pictures. This film was the last of six films John Wayne made at Warner Bros. between 1932 and 1933.

rows.title: Man Hunt
rows.cast: Junior Durkin, Charlotte Henry
rows.extract: Man Hunt is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Irving Cummings and written by Sam Mintz and Leonard Praskins. The film stars Junior Durkin, Charlotte Henry, Dorothy Davenport, Arthur Vinton and Edward LeSaint. The film was released on May 24, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Man of Action
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Caryl Lincoln

rows.title: A Man of Sentiment
rows.cast: Marian Marsh, Owen Moore
rows.extract: A Man of Sentiment is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Marian Marsh, Owen Moore and Christian Rub.

rows.title: Man of the Forest
rows.cast: Randolph Scott, Verna Hillie, Noah Beery
rows.extract: Man of the Forest is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Henry Hathaway, based upon a novel by Zane Grey, released by Paramount Pictures, and starring Randolph Scott and Verna Hillie. The supporting cast features Harry Carey, Noah Beery Sr., Barton MacLane, Buster Crabbe and Guinn "Big

rows.title: The Man Who Dared
rows.cast: Preston Foster, Zita Johann
rows.extract:
The Man Who Dared is a 1933 American pre-Code 
drama film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and written by Dudley Nichols and Lamar Trotti. The film stars Preston Foster, Zita Johann, Joan Marsh, Phillip Trent, and June Lang. The film was released on June 30, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Man's Castle
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Loretta Young
rows.extract: Man's Castle is a 1933 pre-Code American film directed by Frank Borzage and starring Spencer Tracy and Loretta Young.

rows.title: Marriage on Approval
rows.cast: Barbara Kent, William Farnum
rows.extract: Marriage on Approval is a 1933 pre-Code American drama film directed by Howard Higgin and starring Barbara Kent, Don Dillaway and William Farnum. It was released in the United Kingdom by British Lion under the alternative title of Married in Haste.

rows.title: Mary Stevens, M.D.
rows.cast: Kay Francis, Lyle Talbot, Glenda Farrell
rows.extract: Mary Stevens, M.D. is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film starring Kay Francis, Lyle Talbot and Glenda Farrell. rows.title: The Masquerader
rows.cast: Ronald Colman, Elissa Landi
rows.extract: The Masquerader is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Richard Wallace and starring Ronald Colman, Elissa Landi and Juliette Compton.

rows.title: Master of Men
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Fay Wray, Walter Connolly
rows.extract: Master of Men is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Lambert Hillyer and starring Jack Holt, Fay Wray and Walter Connolly. It was produced and distributed by Columbia Pictures.

rows.title: The Mayor of Hell
rows.cast: James Cagney, Allen Jenkins, Dudley Digges
rows.extract: The Mayor of Hell is a 1933 American pre-Code Warner Brothers film starring James Cagney. The film was remade in 1938 as Crime School with Humphrey Bogart taking over James Cagney's role and Hell's Kitchen with Ronald Reagan in 1939.

rows.title: Meet the Baron
rows.cast: Jack Pearl, Jimmy Durante, Edna May Oliver
rows.extract: Meet the Baron is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film starring Jack Pearl, Jimmy Durante, Edna May Oliver, ZaSu Pitts, Ted Healy and His Stooges. The title of the film refers to Pearl's character of Baron Munchhausen, which he made famous on his radio show.

rows.title: Melody Cruise
rows.cast: June Brewster, Shirley Chambers
rows.extract: Melody Cruise is a 1933 American pre-Code musical romantic comedy film directed by Mark Sandrich, his first feature film with sound. The film received praise for Sandrich's creative direction and solidly established him as a commercial director.

rows.title: Men Must Fight
rows.cast: Diana Wynyard, Lewis Stone, Phillips Holmes
rows.extract: Men Must Fight is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film starring Diana Wynyard, Lewis Stone and Phillips Holmes. It is based on the 1932 Broadway play of the same name by Reginald Lawrence and S. K. Lauren. When her lover is killed in World War I, a woman raises their son as a pacifist. However, when

rows.title: Midnight Club
rows.cast: George Raft, Clive Brook, Alison Skipworth
rows.extract:
Midnight Club is a 1933 American pre-Code crime drama film about a gang of London jewel thieves infiltrated by an undercover agent. The film was directed by Alexander Hall and George Somnes. Produced and distributed by Paramount Pictures it is based on the 1931 short story Gangster's Glory
by E. Phi

rows.title: Midnight Mary
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Franchot Tone
rows.extract: Midnight Mary is a 1933 American pre-Code crime drama film directed by William A. Wellman and starring Loretta Young, Ricardo Cortez, and Franchot Tone.

rows.title: The Midnight Patrol
rows.cast: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy
rows.extract: The Midnight Patrol is a short American pre-Code comedy film starring Laurel and Hardy released August 3, 1933.

rows.title: Midshipman Jack
rows.cast: Bruce Cabot, Betty Furness
rows.extract: Midshipman Jack is a 1933 American pre-Code action film directed by Christy Cabanne and written by Frank Wead and F. McGrew Willis. The film stars Bruce Cabot, Betty Furness, Frank Albertson, Arthur Lake, and Florence Lake. The film was released on September 22, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: The Mind Reader
rows.cast: Warren William, Constance Cummings
rows.extract: The Mind Reader is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Roy Del Ruth and written by Robert Lord and Wilson Mizner. The film stars Warren William, Constance Cummings, Allen Jenkins, Natalie Moorhead, Mayo Methot and Clarence Muse. The film was released by Warner Bros. on April 1, 1933.

rows.title: The Monkey's Paw
rows.cast: Ivan F. Simpson, C. Aubrey Smith
rows.extract: The Monkey's Paw is a 1933 American pre-Code horror film co-directed by Ernest B. Schoedsack (prologue) and Wesley Ruggles, based on the short story, "The Monkey's Paw" (1902) by W. W. Jacobs. The film was considered lost until pictures from it were posted online in 2016; the extant copy is dubbed i

rows.title: Moonlight and Pretzels
rows.cast: William Frawley, Mary Brian
rows.extract: Moonlight and Pretzels is a 1933 American Pre-Code musical film, directed by Karl Freund, about a man who puts on a Broadway show. The film was released by Universal Studios and featured Mary Brian and William Frawley, now best-known as "Fred Mertz" on the 1950s TV show I Love Lucy; Freund was the g

rows.title: Morning Glory
rows.cast: Katharine Hepburn, Douglas Fairbanks Jr.
rows.extract: Morning Glory is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film which tells the story of an eager would-be actress and her journey to stardom, and her gains and losses. The picture stars Katharine Hepburn, Douglas Fairbanks Jr., and Adolphe Menjou, was adapted by Howard J. Green from a then-unproduced stage pl

rows.title: Mr. Broadway
rows.cast: Ed Sullivan, Jack Benny, Ruth Etting
rows.extract: Mr. Broadway is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film written by Abel Green and Ed Sullivan. The film was directed by Johnnie Walker (1894–1949) who was also a silent film actor and producer, and stars Sullivan along with a cast of celebrity walk-ons. It was shot in New York City.

rows.title: Mr. Skitch
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Rochelle Hudson
rows.extract: Mr. Skitch is a 1933 American comedy film directed by James Cruze and written by Sonya Levien and Ralph Spence. The film stars Will Rogers, Rochelle Hudson, ZaSu Pitts, Florence Desmond, Harry Green and Charles Starrett. The film was released on December 22, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Murder on the Campus
rows.cast: Shirley Grey, Charles Starrett, Ruth Hall
rows.extract: Murder on the Campus is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Richard Thorpe. The film is also known as On the Stroke of Nine in the United Kingdom. It is based on the novel The Campanile Murders, by Whitman Chambers.

rows.title: Murders in the Zoo
rows.cast: Charlie Ruggles, Lionel Atwill, Kathleen Burke
rows.extract: Murders in the Zoo is 1933 pre-Code horror film directed by A. Edward Sutherland, written by Philip Wylie and Seton I. Miller. Particularly dark, even for its time, film critic Leonard Maltin called the film "astonishingly grisly."

rows.title: My Lips Betray
rows.cast: Lilian Harvey, John Boles
rows.extract: My Lips Betray is a 1933 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by John G. Blystone and starring Lilian Harvey, John Boles and El Brendel. The film's sets were designed by the art director Joseph C. Wright.

rows.title: My Weakness
rows.cast: Lilian Harvey, Lew Ayres
rows.extract: My Weakness is a 1933 American pre-Code musical film directed by David Butler and starring Lilian Harvey, Lew Ayres and Charles Butterworth. It was the second of four films made by the British-German actress Harvey in Hollywood, who had emerged as major star during Weimar Germany.

rows.title: My Woman
rows.cast: Helen Twelvetrees, Victor Jory
rows.extract: My Woman is a 1933 American pre-Code drama romance film directed by Victor Schertzinger and starring Helen Twelvetrees, Victor Jory and Wallace Ford.

rows.title: Myrt and Marge
rows.cast: Myrtle Vail, Donna Damerel (actress), Ted Healy
rows.extract: Myrt and Marge is a 1933 American pre-Code Universal Studios feature film, starring Myrtle Vail and Donna Damerel. rows.title: The Mysterious Rider
rows.cast: Kent Taylor, Lona Andre
rows.extract: The Mysterious Rider is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Fred Allen and written by Harvey Gates and Robert N. Lee. The film stars Kent Taylor, Lona Andre, Berton Churchill, Irving Pichel, Warren Hymer, Gail Patrick and Cora Sue Collins. The film was released on January 20, 1933, by

rows.title: The Mystic Hour
rows.cast: Charles Hutchison, Lucille Powers, Montagu Love
rows.extract: The Mystic Hour is a 1933 American mystery film directed by Melville De Lay and starring Charles Hutchison, Lucille Powers and Montagu Love. It is also known by the alternative title of At Twelve Midnight. The film was one of the earliest releases of the Poverty Row studio Reliable Pictures. The mov

rows.title: Mystery of the Wax Museum
rows.cast: Lionel Atwill, Fay Wray, Glenda Farrell
rows.extract: Mystery of the Wax Museum is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery-horror film directed by Michael Curtiz and starring Lionel Atwill, Fay Wray, Glenda Farrell, and Frank McHugh. It was produced and released by Warner Bros. and filmed in two-color Technicolor; Doctor X and Mystery of the Wax Museum were t

rows.title: Nagana
rows.cast: Tala Birell, Melvyn Douglas
rows.extract: Nagana is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Ernst L. Frank and written by Don Ryan and Dale Van Every. The film stars Tala Birell, Melvyn Douglas, Miki Morita, Onslow Stevens, Everett Brown and Billy McClain. The film was released on February 1, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: The Narrow Corner
rows.cast: Douglas Fairbanks, Patricia Ellis, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: The Narrow Corner is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Alfred E. Green and starring Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Patricia Ellis and Ralph Bellamy. It is an adaptation of Somerset Maugham's 1932 novel The Narrow Corner. It was remade in 1936 as Isle of Fury.

rows.title: Neighbors' Wives
rows.cast: Dorothy Mackaill, Tom Moore, Vivien Oakland
rows.extract: Neighbors' Wives is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by B. Reeves Eason and starring Dorothy Mackaill, Tom Moore and Mary Kornman.

rows.title: Night Flight
rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, John Barrymore, Clark Gable
rows.extract: Night Flight is a 1933 American pre-Code aviation drama film produced by David O. Selznick, distributed by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, directed by Clarence Brown and starring John Barrymore, Lionel Barrymore, Clark Gable, Helen Hayes, Robert Montgomery and Myrna Loy.

rows.title: Night of Terror
rows.cast: Bela Lugosi, Sally Blane, Wallace Ford
rows.extract: Night of Terror is a 1933 American pre-Code horror film directed by Benjamin Stoloff, and starring Bela Lugosi, Sally Blane, Wallace Ford, and Tully Marshall. Despite receiving top billing, Bela Lugosi has a relatively small part. The film is also known as He Lived to Kill and Terror in the Night.

rows.title: No Marriage Ties
rows.cast: Richard Dix, Elizabeth Allan
rows.extract: No Marriage Ties is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by J. Walter Ruben and written by Arthur Caesar, H.W. Hanemann, Sam Mintz. The film stars Richard Dix, Elizabeth Allan, Doris Kenyon, Alan Dinehart and David Landau. The film was released on August 8, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: No Other Woman
rows.cast: Irene Dunne, Charles Bickford
rows.extract: No Other Woman is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic melodrama film starring Irene Dunne, and featuring Charles Bickford, Gwili Andre and Eric Linden. It was directed by J. Walter Ruben from a screenplay by Wanda Tuchock and Bernard Schubert based on the play Just a Woman by Eugene Walter, which ran

rows.title: Notorious But Nice
rows.cast: Marian Marsh, Betty Compson, Rochelle Hudson
rows.extract: Notorious but Nice is a 1933 pre-Code American sound film drama directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Marian Marsh and Betty Compson. It was produced and distributed by B movie studio Chesterfield Motion Pictures.

rows.title: The Nuisance
rows.cast: Lee Tracy, Madge Evans
rows.extract: The Nuisance is a 1933 American pre-Code film starring Lee Tracy as a lawyer, Madge Evans as his love interest, and Frank Morgan as his accomplice.

rows.title: Obey the Law
rows.cast: Leo Carrillo, Lois Wilson
rows.extract: Obey the Law is a 1933 American Pre-Code crime drama film released by Columbia Pictures.

rows.title: Oliver Twist
rows.cast: Irving Pichel, Dickie Moore
rows.extract: Oliver Twist is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by William J. Cowen. The earliest sound adaptation of Charles Dickens's 1838 novel of the same name, it stars Dickie Moore as Oliver, Irving Pichel as Fagin, Doris Lloyd as Nancy, and William "Stage" Boyd as Bill Sikes.

rows.title: Olsen's Big Moment
rows.cast: El Brendel, Barbara Weeks
rows.extract: Olsen's Big Moment is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Malcolm St. Clair and written by Henry Johnson and James J. Tynan. The film stars El Brendel, Walter Catlett, Barbara Weeks, Susan Fleming, John Arledge and Joe Sawyer. The film was released on November 17, 1933, by Fox Film Corp

rows.cast: Richard Talmadge, Dorothy Burgess, DeWitt Jennings

rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, May Robson, Joel McCrea
rows.extract: One Man's Journey is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film starring Lionel Barrymore as Dr. Eli Watt. The picture was based on the short story Failure written by Katharine Haviland-Taylor. It was remade by RKO as A Man to Remember (1938). The story tells of a small-town doctor working under difficult

rows.title: One Sunday Afternoon
rows.cast: Gary Cooper, Fay Wray
rows.extract: One Sunday Afternoon is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic comedy-drama film directed by Stephen Roberts and starring Gary Cooper and Fay Wray. rows.title: One Year Later
rows.cast: Mary Brian, Russell Hopton
rows.extract: One Year Later is a 1933 American Pre-Code film directed by E. Mason Hopper.

rows.title: Only Yesterday
rows.cast: Margaret Sullavan, John Boles
rows.extract: Only Yesterday is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film about a young woman who becomes pregnant by her boyfriend before he rushes off to fight in World War I. It stars Margaret Sullavan and John Boles.

rows.title: Our Betters
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Anita Louise
rows.extract: Our Betters is a 1933 American pre-Code satirical comedy film directed by George Cukor and starring Constance Bennett, Anita Louise and Gilbert Roland. rows.title: Out All Night
rows.cast: Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts
rows.extract: Out All Night is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Sam Taylor and written by William Anthony McGuire. The film stars Slim Summerville, ZaSu Pitts, Laura Hope Crews, Shirley Grey, Alexander Carr and Rollo Lloyd. The film was released April 8, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Paddy the Next Best Thing
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Warner Baxter
rows.extract: Paddy the Next Best Thing is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Harry Lachman and starring Janet Gaynor, Warner Baxter and Walter Connolly. rows.title: Parachute Jumper
rows.cast: Bette Davis, Douglas Fairbanks Jr.
rows.extract: Parachute Jumper is a 1933 American pre-Code black-and-white comedy drama film directed by Alfred E. Green. Based on a story by Rian James titled "Some Call It Love", it stars Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Bette Davis and Frank McHugh.

rows.title: Parole Girl
rows.cast: Mae Clarke, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: Parole Girl is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic drama film directed by Edward Cline. The film stars Mae Clarke and Ralph Bellamy.

rows.title: The Past of Mary Holmes
rows.cast: Eric Linden, Jean Arthur
rows.extract: The Past of Mary Holmes is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film, directed by Harlan Thompson and Slavko Vorkapich, and released by RKO. The film is a remake of the silent film The Goose Woman (1925), which is based on a short story by Rex Beach, partly based on the Hall-Mills murder case.

rows.title: Peg o' My Heart
rows.cast: Marion Davies, Onslow Stevens
rows.extract: Peg o' My Heart is a 1933 American Pre-Code film adaptation of the play of the same name by J. Hartley Manners. It starred Marion Davies as a poor Irish girl, Margaret 'Peg' O'Connell, who stands to inherit a fortune if she satisfies certain conditions.

rows.title: Penthouse
rows.cast: Warner Baxter, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: Penthouse is a 1933 American Pre-Code crime film starring Warner Baxter as a lawyer and Myrna Loy as a call girl who helps him with a murder case. The film features Charles Butterworth as the butler, Mae Clarke as the murder victim, Phillips Holmes as the suspected murderer, and C. Henry Gordon as t

rows.title: The Perils of Pauline (1933 serial)
rows.cast: Evalyn Knapp, Sonny Ray
rows.extract: The Perils of Pauline is a 1933 American Pre-Code film serial, and sound film remake, of the Pathé original. The 12-chapter "cliffhanger" was produced by Universal Studios. Evalyn Knapp, herself a graduate of Pathé silent short subjects, starred as the heroine, Pauline Hargraves. Historic newsreel f

rows.title: The Phantom Broadcast
rows.cast: Ralph Forbes, Vivienne Osborne
rows.extract: The Phantom Broadcast is a 1933 American mystery film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Ralph Forbes, Vivienne Osborne and Gail Patrick. It was based on a story by Tristram Tupper entitled Phantom of the Air.

rows.title: Phantom Thunderbolt
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Frances Lee
rows.extract: Phantom Thunderbolt is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Alan James.

rows.title: Pick-Up
rows.cast: Sylvia Sidney, George Raft
rows.extract: Pick-Up is a 1933 American Pre-Code crime film directed by Marion Gering and starring Sylvia Sidney and George Raft.

rows.title: Picture Brides
rows.cast: Dorothy Mackaill, Regis Toomey
rows.extract: Picture Brides is a 1933 American Pre-Code adventure film, directed by Phil Rosen. The film stars Dorothy Mackaill, Regis Toomey and Alan Hale.

rows.title: Picture Snatcher
rows.cast: James Cagney, Ralph Bellamy
rows.extract: Picture Snatcher is a 1933 American pre-code drama film starring James Cagney as a gangster who decides to quit to pursue his dream.

rows.title: Pilgrimage
rows.cast: Henrietta Crosman, Norman Foster
rows.extract: Pilgrimage is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by John Ford. The film was a box office disappointment for Fox.

rows.title: Pleasure Cruise
rows.cast: Genevieve Tobin, Roland Young, Ralph Forbes
rows.extract: Pleasure Cruise is a 1933 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Frank Tuttle and written by Guy Bolton. The film stars Genevieve Tobin, Roland Young, Ralph Forbes, Una O'Connor, Herbert Mundin and Minna Gombell. The film was released on March 24, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Police Call
rows.cast: Nick Stuart, Merna Kennedy, Roberta Gale
rows.extract: Police Call is a 1933 Pre-code American crime drama film directed by Phil Whitman and starring Nick Stuart and Merna Kennedy.

rows.title: Police Car 17
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Evalyn Knapp
rows.extract: Police Car 17 is a 1933 American pre-Code crime film directed by Lambert Hillyer and starring Tim McCoy, Evalyn Knapp and Edwin Maxwell.

rows.title: The Power and the Glory
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, Colleen Moore
rows.extract: The Power and the Glory is a 1933 pre-Code film starring Spencer Tracy and Colleen Moore, written by Preston Sturges, and directed by William K. Howard. rows.title: Primavera en otoño
rows.cast: Catalina Bárcena
rows.extract: Primavera en otoño is a 1933 Spanish-language American romantic comedy directed by Eugene Forde and stars Catalina Bárcena.

rows.title: Private Detective 62
rows.cast: William Powell, Margaret Lindsay
rows.extract: Private Detective 62 is a 1933 American pre-Code detective film directed by Michael Curtiz and starring William Powell as a private detective who falls for a woman whom he has been hired to frame in a scandal.

rows.cast: Lee Tracy, Gloria Stuart
rows.extract: Private Jones is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Russell Mack and written by Prescott Chaplin, Bill Cohen, George Jessel, William N. Robson and Sam Spewack. rows.cast: Charles Laughton, Binnie Barnes

rows.cast: Myrna Loy, Walter Huston, Max Baer
rows.extract: The Prizefighter and the Lady is a 1933 pre-Code Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer romance film starring Myrna Loy and the professional boxers Max Baer, Primo Carnera, and Jack Dempsey. rows.title: Professional Sweetheart
rows.cast: Ginger Rogers, Norman Foster, ZaSu Pitts
rows.extract: Professional Sweetheart is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic comedy directed by William A. Seiter from a screenplay by Maurine Watkins. It stars Ginger Rogers in her first film for RKO Radio Pictures, with Norman Foster, ZaSu Pitts and Frank McHugh. The film is a satire of the radio industry.

rows.title: Queen Christina
rows.cast: Greta Garbo, John Gilbert
rows.extract: Queen Christina is a pre-Code Hollywood biographical film, produced for Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer in 1933 by Walter Wanger and directed by Rouben Mamoulian. It stars Swedish-born actress Greta Garbo and John Gilbert in their fourth and last film together.

rows.extract: Rafter Romance is an American 1933 pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by William A. Seiter and released by RKO Radio Pictures. rows.title: Ranger's Code
rows.cast: Bob Steele, Doris Hill
rows.extract: Ranger's Code is a 1933 American Western film directed by Robert North Bradbury and written by Harry L. Fraser. The film stars Bob Steele, Doris Hill, Ernie Adams, George Nash, Ed Brady and George "Gabby" Hayes. The film was released on August 15, 1933, by Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: Rainbow Over Broadway
rows.cast: Joan Marsh, Frank Albertson
rows.extract:
Rainbow Over Broadway is a 1933 American pre-Code
musical drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Joan Marsh, Frank Albertson and Lucien Littlefield. The film's sets were designed by the art director Edward C. Jewell.

rows.extract: Reunion in Vienna is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic drama produced and distributed by MGM. Sidney Franklin served as director. The film stars John Barrymore in a story taken from the 1931 stage play of the same name by Robert Emmet Sherwood.

rows.title: Revenge at Monte Carlo
rows.cast: June Collyer, José Crespo, Dorothy Gulliver
rows.extract: Revenge at Monte Carlo is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by B. Reeves Eason and starring June Collyer, José Crespo and Wheeler Oakman. It is also known by the alternative title of Mystery at Monte Carlo.

rows.title: Riders of Destiny
rows.cast: John Wayne, Cecilia Parker
rows.extract: Riders of Destiny is a 1933 pre-Code Western musical film starring 26-year-old John Wayne as Singin' Sandy Saunders, the screen's second singing cowboy. rows.title: The Right to Romance
rows.cast: Ann Harding, Robert Young, Nils Asther

rows.title: Sailor Be Good

Starring Jack Oakie, Vivienne Osborne, George E. Stone, Max Hoffman Jr. and Lincoln Stedman, the film was released on March 7, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Sailor's Luck
rows.cast: James Dunn, Sally Eilers
rows.extract: Sailor's Luck is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Raoul Walsh for Fox Film Corporation. It stars James Dunn, Sally Eilers, Victor Jory, and Frank Moran.

rows.cast: Sally Eilers, Helen Vinson, Ralph Bellamy

rows.extract: Shanghai Madness is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by John G. Blystone and starring Spencer Tracy, Fay Wray, Ralph Morgan, and Albert Conti. It was released by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, Alice Brady
rows.extract: Should Ladies Behave is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Harry Beaumont and written by Bella Spewack and Sam Spewack, adapted from the play, "The Vinegar Tree" by Paul Osborn. rows.extract: A Shriek in the Night is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery crime film with elements of romance directed by Albert Ray and starring Ginger Rogers, Lyle Talbot, and Harvey Clark. It was produced by the independent studio Allied Pictures, and remains the company's best-known release.

rows.title: Silent Men
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, J. Carrol Naish
rows.extract: Silent Men is a 1933 American Pre-Code Western film directed by D. Ross Lederman and starring Tim McCoy.
