rows.title: The Story of Temple Drake
rows.cast: Miriam Hopkins, Jack La Rue
rows.extract: The Story of Temple Drake is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Stephen Roberts and starring Miriam Hopkins and Jack La Rue. It tells the story of Temple Drake, a reckless woman in the American South who falls into the hands of a brutal gangster and rapist. It was adapted from the highl

rows.title: Straightaway
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Sue Carol
rows.extract: Straightaway is a 1933 American Pre-Code crime drama film directed by Otto Brower and starring Tim McCoy, Sue Carol, and William Bakewell.

rows.title: Strange People
rows.cast: John Darrow, Gloria Shea
rows.extract: Strange People is a 1933 American mystery film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring John Darrow, Gloria Shea and Hale Hamilton.

rows.title: The Stranger's Return
rows.cast: Miriam Hopkins, Franchot Tone
rows.extract: The Stranger's Return is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by King Vidor and starring Miriam Hopkins, Lionel Barrymore and Franchot Tone. It was released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer. Miriam Hopkins was loaned out to MGM for the picture while under contract to Paramount.

rows.title: Strawberry Roan
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Ruth Hall
rows.extract: Strawberry Roan is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Alan James and starring Ken Maynard, Ruth Hall and Harold Goodwin.

rows.title: Strictly Personal
rows.cast: Marjorie Rambeau, Dorothy Jordan, Louis Calhern
rows.extract: Strictly Personal is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Ralph Murphy, written by Beatrice Banyard, Willard Mack, Wilson Mizner, Casey Robinson and Robert T. Shannon, and starring Marjorie Rambeau, Dorothy Jordan, Eddie Quillan, Edward Ellis, Louis Calhern, Dorothy Burgess and Rollo Lloy

rows.title: A Study in Scarlet
rows.cast: Reginald Owen, Anna May Wong
rows.extract: A Study in Scarlet is a 1933 American Pre-Code mystery thriller film directed by Edwin L. Marin and starring Reginald Owen as Sherlock Holmes and Anna May Wong as Mrs. Pyke. The title comes from Arthur Conan Doyle's 1887 novel of the same name, the first in the Holmes series, but the screenplay by R

rows.title: Sunset Pass
rows.cast: Randolph Scott, Tom Keene
rows.extract: Sunset Pass is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Henry Hathaway and starring Randolph Scott, Tom Keene, Harry Carey, and Noah Beery. The picture was based on a Zane Grey novel, along with several other theatrical films with similar casts also based upon Zane Grey novels directed by H

rows.title: Supernatural
rows.cast: Carole Lombard, Alan Dinehart, Randolph Scott
rows.extract: Supernatural is a 1933 American pre-Code supernatural horror film directed by Victor Halperin, and starring Carole Lombard and Alan Dinehart. The film follows a woman who attends a staged séance only to find herself possessed by the spirit of an executed murderess.

rows.title: Sweepings
rows.cast: Lionel Barrymore, Gloria Stuart
rows.extract: Sweepings is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by John Cromwell, written by Lester Cohen, and starring Lionel Barrymore, Eric Linden, William Gargan, Gloria Stuart and Alan Dinehart. It was released on April 14, 1933, by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: The Sweetheart of Sigma Chi (film)
rows.cast: Mary Carlisle, Buster Crabbe
rows.extract: The Sweetheart of Sigma Chi is a 1933 American comedy film directed by Edwin L. Marin and written by Luther Reed and Albert DeMond. The film stars Mary Carlisle, Buster Crabbe, Charles Starrett, Florence Lake, Eddie Tamblyn and Sally Starr. The film was released on October 26, 1933, by Monogram Pict

rows.title: Take a Chance
rows.cast: James Dunn, June Knight
rows.extract: Take a Chance is a 1933 American Pre-Code comedy film directed by Monte Brice and Laurence Schwab and written by Monte Brice, Buddy G. DeSylva, Laurence Schwab, Sid Silvers and Richard A. Whiting. It is based on the musical of the same name. The film stars James Dunn, June Knight, Lillian Roth, Clif

rows.title: The Telegraph Trail
rows.cast: John Wayne, Frank McHugh, Marceline Day
rows.extract: The Telegraph Trail is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Tenny Wright and starring John Wayne and Frank McHugh. The film also starred stuntman Yakima Canutt as Indian Chief High Wolf, Marceline Day as the heroine, and Duke the Wonder Horse as John Wayne's trusty steed.

rows.title: Terror Aboard
rows.cast: John Halliday, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Terror Aboard is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Paul Sloane, written by Robert Presnell Sr., Manuel Seff and Harvey F. Thew, and starring John Halliday, Charlie Ruggles, Shirley Grey, Neil Hamilton, Jack La Rue, Verree Teasdale and Stanley Fields. It was released on April 14, 1933

rows.title: Terror Trail
rows.cast: Tom Mix, Raymond Hatton
rows.extract: Terror Trail is a 1933 American Western film directed by Armand Schaefer, written by Jack Cunningham, and starring Tom Mix, Naomi Judge, Arthur Rankin, John St. Polis, Frank Brownlee and Raymond Hatton. It was released on February 2, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: This Day and Age
rows.cast: Charles Bickford, Richard Cromwell
rows.extract: This Day and Age is a 1933 American pre-Code film directed by Cecil B. DeMille and starring Charles Bickford and Richard Cromwell. It is one of his rarest films and has been released on home video through the Universal Pictures Vault Series DVD collection.

rows.title: This Is America
rows.cast: Alois Havrilla

rows.title: Three-Cornered Moon
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Richard Arlen
rows.extract: Three Cornered Moon is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Elliott Nugent, written by Ray Harris and S.K. Lauren, and starring Claudette Colbert, Richard Arlen, Mary Boland, and Wallace Ford. Based on a 1933 play by Gertrude Tonkonogy Friedberg, the film reached No. 9 in the National Bo

rows.title: Three Little Pigs
rows.cast: Pinto Colvig, Billy Bletcher
rows.extract: Three Little Pigs is an animated short film released on May 25, 1933 by United Artists, produced by Walt Disney and directed by Burt Gillett. Based on the fable of the same name, the Silly Symphony won the 1934 Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film of 1933. The short cost $22,000 and grossed $2

rows.title: The Thrill Hunter
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Dorothy Revier
rows.extract: The Thrill Hunter is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by George B. Seitz. Buck Jones stars as a habitual teller of tall tales, while Dorothy Revier plays the film star he tries to impress.

rows.title: The Thundering Herd
rows.cast: Randolph Scott, Judith Allen, Buster Crabbe
rows.extract: The Thundering Herd is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Henry Hathaway and starring Randolph Scott, Judith Allen, Buster Crabbe, Noah Beery, Sr. and Harry Carey.

rows.title: Tillie and Gus
rows.cast: W. C. Fields, Alison Skipworth
rows.extract: Tillie and Gus is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Francis Martin, co-written by Martin and Walter DeLeon, and starring W.C. Fields, Alison Skipworth, Baby LeRoy, Julie Bishop, and Clarence Wilson. It is based on a short story by Rupert Hughes entitled Don't Call Me Madame. The film

rows.title: To the Last Man
rows.cast: Randolph Scott, Esther Ralston
rows.extract: To the Last Man is a 1933 American Pre-Code Western film directed by Henry Hathaway and starring Randolph Scott and Esther Ralston. The screenplay by Jack Cunningham was based on a story by Zane Grey. The Paramount property was previously made as a silent film, Victor Fleming's 1923 film version of

rows.title: Today We Live
rows.cast: Joan Crawford, Gary Cooper, Roland Young
rows.extract: Today We Live is a 1933 American pre-Code romance drama film produced and directed by Howard Hawks and starring Joan Crawford, Gary Cooper, Robert Young and Franchot Tone.

rows.title: Tomorrow at Seven
rows.cast: Chester Morris, Vivienne Osborne, Frank McHugh
rows.extract: Tomorrow at Seven is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery comedy film directed by Ray Enright and written by Ralph Spence. The plot sees a group of people gathered in an old mansion being menaced by a killer known as "The Black Ace".

rows.title: Tonight Is Ours
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Fredric March
rows.extract: Tonight Is Ours is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Stuart Walker and starring Claudette Colbert, Fredric March and Alison Skipworth. Made by Paramount Pictures, it is based on the play The Queen Was in the Parlour by Noël Coward.

rows.title: Too Much Harmony
rows.cast: Bing Crosby, Jack Oakie
rows.extract: Too Much Harmony is a 1933 American black-and-white pre-Code musical film directed by A. Edward Sutherland and starring Bing Crosby, Jack Oakie, Richard "Skeets" Gallagher, Harry Green, and Judith Allen. It was released by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Topaze
rows.cast: John Barrymore, Myrna Loy
rows.extract: Topaze is a 1933 American pre-Code film directed by D'Abbadie D'Arrast and starring John Barrymore and Myrna Loy. It was based on the 1928 French play of the same name by Marcel Pagnol. Another film version of Topaze, this one made in the original French was also released that year, starring Louis J

rows.title: Torch Singer
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Ricardo Cortez
rows.extract: Torch Singer is a 1933 American Pre-Code Paramount Pictures film directed by Alexander Hall and George Somnes and starring Claudette Colbert, Ricardo Cortez, David Manners and Lyda Roberti. The screenplay was written by Lenore J. Coffee and Lynn Starling, based on the short story Mike by Grace Perki

rows.title: The Trail Drive
rows.cast: Ken Maynard, Cecilia Parker
rows.extract: The Trail Drive is a 1933 American Western film directed by Alan James and written by Alan James and Nate Gatzert. The film stars Ken Maynard, Cecilia Parker, William Gould, Frank Rice, Bob Kortman and Fern Emmett. The film was released on September 4, 1933, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Trailing North
rows.cast: Bob Steele, Doris Hill
rows.extract: Trailing North is a 1933 pre-Code American western drama film directed by John P. McCarthy. It was released in 1933 in the US by Monogram Pictures.

rows.title: Treason
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Treason is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Buck Jones.

rows.title: Trick for Trick
rows.cast: Ralph Morgan, Sally Blane
rows.extract: Trick for Trick is a 1933 American pre-Code mystery film directed by Hamilton MacFadden, written by Howard J. Green, and starring Ralph Morgan, Victor Jory, Sally Blane, Tom Dugan, Luis Alberni and Edward Van Sloan. It was released on April 21, 1933, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Trouble Busters
rows.cast: Jack Hoxie, Lane Chandler
rows.extract: Trouble Busters is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Lewis D. Collins and starring Jack Hoxie, Lane Chandler and Kaye Edwards.

rows.title: Tugboat Annie
rows.cast: Marie Dressler, Wallace Beery, Maureen O'Sullivan
rows.extract: Tugboat Annie is a 1933 American pre-Code film directed by Mervyn LeRoy, written by Norman Reilly Raine and Zelda Sears, and starring Marie Dressler and Wallace Beery as a comically quarrelsome middle-aged couple who operate a tugboat. Dressler and Beery were MGM's most popular screen team at that t

rows.title: Turn Back the Clock
rows.cast: Lee Tracy, Mae Clarke
rows.extract: Turn Back the Clock is a 1933 American pre-Code MGM fantasy comedy-drama film directed by Edgar Selwyn, written by Selwyn and Ben Hecht, and starring Mae Clarke and Lee Tracy. The protagonist has 20 years of his life to live over.

rows.title: Twin Husbands
rows.cast: John Miljan, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Twin Husbands is a 1933 American Pre-Code film directed by Frank R. Strayer.

rows.title: Under Secret Orders
rows.cast: Don Dillaway, Nina Quartero, Phyllis Barrington

rows.title: Under the Tonto Rim
rows.cast: Stuart Erwin, Fred Kohler
rows.extract: Under the Tonto Rim is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Henry Hathaway and starring Stuart Erwin and Verna Hillie. The film is a remake of a 1928 silent film starring Richard Arlen and Mary Brian. Both are based on the Zane Grey 1926 novel of the same name, as is a 1947 film.

rows.title: Unknown Valley
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Cecilia Parker
rows.extract: Unknown Valley is a 1933 American pre-Code Western film directed by Lambert Hillyer and starring Buck Jones, Cecilia Parker and Wade Boteler. It was shot at the Iverson Ranch in California.

rows.title: The Vampire Bat
rows.cast: Fay Wray, Lionel Atwill, Melvyn Douglas
rows.extract: The Vampire Bat is a 1933 American Pre-Code horror film directed by Frank R. Strayer and starring Lionel Atwill, Fay Wray, Melvyn Douglas, and Dwight Frye.

rows.title: Via Pony Express
rows.cast: Jack Hoxie, Lane Chandler, Marceline Day
rows.extract: Via Pony Express is a 1933 pre-Code American Western film directed by Lewis D. Collins and starring Jack Hoxie, Lane Chandler and Marceline Day.

rows.title: Voltaire
rows.cast: George Arliss, Doris Kenyon
rows.extract: Voltaire is a 1933 American pre-Code biographical film directed by John G. Adolfi and starring George Arliss as the renowned 18th-century French writer and philosopher.

rows.title: Walls of Gold
rows.cast: Sally Eilers, Norman Foster
rows.extract: Walls of Gold is a 1933 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Kenneth MacKenna and starring Sally Eilers, Norman Foster, and Ralph Morgan.

rows.title: War of the Range
rows.cast: Tom Tyler, Caryl Lincoln, Charles K. French
rows.extract: War of the Range is a 1933 American western film directed by J.P. McGowan and starring Tom Tyler, Charles K. French and Lane Chandler. It was made by the independent Poverty Row company the Monarch Film Corporation.

rows.title: The Warrior's Husband
rows.cast: Elissa Landi, David Manners
rows.extract: The Warrior's Husband is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Walter Lang and starring Elissa Landi, David Manners, and Ernest Truex. It tells the story of the Amazons, who ruled over men thanks to the sacred girdle of Diana, and Hercules who came to steal it. The film is based on a 1932

rows.title: The Way to Love
rows.cast: Maurice Chevalier, Ann Dvorak
rows.extract: The Way to Love is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Norman Taurog and starring Maurice Chevalier and Ann Dvorak. Edward Everett Horton was the principal featured player.

rows.title: West of Singapore
rows.cast: Betty Compson, Weldon Heyburn, Margaret Lindsay
rows.extract:
West of Singapore is a 1933 American pre-Code
drama film directed by Albert Ray and starring Betty Compson, Weldon Heyburn and Margaret Lindsay.

rows.title: What! No Beer?
rows.cast: Buster Keaton, Jimmy Durante, Phyllis Barry
rows.extract: What - No Beer? is a 1933 Pre-Code comedy film released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer directed by Edward Sedgwick and starring Buster Keaton and Jimmy Durante. MGM had also paired Keaton and Durante as a comedy team during this period in The Passionate Plumber and Speak Easily.

rows.title: What Price Decency
rows.cast: Dorothy Burgess, Alan Hale
rows.extract: What Price Decency is a 1933 American drama film directed by Arthur Gregor and starring Dorothy Burgess, Alan Hale and Walter Byron. The director adapted the story from one his own plays. It is now considered a lost film.

rows.title: What Price Innocence?
rows.cast: Jean Parker, Minna Gombell
rows.extract: What Price Innocence? is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film written and directed by, and co-starring, Willard Mack. Produced on a low budget for Columbia Pictures, it has been classed as an exploitation film and "sex hygiene film" because it touches on teenage pregnancy and morality in a didactic m

rows.title: When Ladies Meet
rows.cast: Ann Harding, Myrna Loy, Robert Montgomery
rows.extract: When Ladies Meet is a 1933 pre-Code film directed by Harry Beaumont and starring Ann Harding, Myrna Loy, Robert Montgomery, Alice Brady, and Frank Morgan. The film is the first adaptation of the 1932 Rachel Crothers play of the same name. It was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Art Direction

rows.title: When Strangers Marry
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Lilian Bond
rows.extract: When Strangers Marry is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Clarence G. Badger and starring Jack Holt, Lilian Bond and Gustav von Seyffertitz.

rows.title: The Whirlwind
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Pat O'Malley
rows.extract: The Whirlwind is a 1933 American Pre-Code Western film directed by D. Ross Lederman and starring Tim McCoy.

rows.title: Whistling in the Dark
rows.cast: Una Merkel, Edward Arnold
rows.extract: Whistling in the Dark is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy-mystery film directed by Elliott Nugent and starring Ernest Truex and Una Merkel. The plot concerns a mystery writer whose scheme for a perfect murder comes to the attention of a gangster, who plans to use it.

rows.title: The White Sister
rows.cast: Helen Hayes, Clark Gable
rows.extract: The White Sister is a 1933 American pre-Code romantic drama film directed by Victor Fleming and starring Helen Hayes and Clark Gable. It was based on the 1909 novel of the same name by Francis Marion Crawford and was a remake of the silent film The White Sister (1923).

rows.title: White Woman
rows.cast: Carole Lombard, Charles Laughton
rows.extract: White Woman is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Stuart Walker and starring Carole Lombard, Charles Laughton, and Charles Bickford. The screenplay concerns a young widow who remarries and accompanies her husband to his remote jungle rubber plantation.

rows.title: Wild Boys of the Road
rows.cast: Frankie Darro, Dorothy Coonan
rows.extract: Wild Boys of the Road is a 1933 pre-Code Depression-era American drama film directed by William Wellman and starring Frankie Darro, Rochelle Hudson, and Grant Mitchell. It tells the story of several teens forced into becoming hobos. The screenplay by Earl Baldwin is based on the story Desperate Yout

rows.title: Wine, Women and Song
rows.cast: Lilyan Tashman, Lew Cody
rows.extract: Wine, Women and Song is a 1933 American drama film directed by Herbert Brenon and starring Lilyan Tashman, Lew Cody and Marjorie Reynolds.

rows.title: The Woman Accused
rows.cast: Cary Grant, Nancy Carroll
rows.extract: The Woman Accused is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Paul Sloane and starring Nancy Carroll and Cary Grant as a young engaged couple on a sea cruise, with the woman being implicated in the death of her former lover. The supporting cast includes Jack La Rue in a sequence opposite Gran

rows.title: The Woman I Stole
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Fay Wray
rows.extract: The Woman I Stole is a 1933 American pre-Code adventure film directed by Irving Cummings, starring Jack Holt, Fay Wray and Donald Cook. It is based on the novel Tampico by Joseph Hergesheimer, with the setting shifted from Mexico to North Africa.

rows.title: The Woman Who Dared
rows.cast: Claudia Dell, Monroe Owsley, Lola Lane
rows.extract: The Woman Who Dared is a 1933 American drama black and white film directed by Millard Webb, produced by William Berke and scored by Lee Zahler.

rows.title: The Women in His Life
rows.cast: Otto Kruger, Una Merkel
rows.extract: The Women in His Life is a 1933 American pre-Code crime film directed by George B. Seitz and starring Otto Kruger.

rows.title: The Working Man
rows.cast: George Arliss, Bette Davis
rows.extract: The Working Man is a 1933 pre-Code American comedy film starring George Arliss and Bette Davis, and directed by John G. Adolfi. The screenplay by Charles Kenyon and Maude T. Howell is based on the story The Adopted Father by Edgar Franklin. The film is preserved in the Library of Congress collection

rows.title: The World Changes
rows.cast: Paul Muni, Aline MacMahon, Mary Astor
rows.extract: The World Changes is a 1933 American pre-Code drama film directed by Mervyn LeRoy and starring Paul Muni as an ambitious farm boy who becomes rich, but does not handle success well. Aline MacMahon and Mary Astor play his mother and wife respectively.

rows.title: The World Gone Mad
rows.cast: Pat O'Brien, Evelyn Brent, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: The World Gone Mad is a 1933 American pre-Code crime film directed by Christy Cabanne and starring Pat O'Brien, Evelyn Brent and Neil Hamilton. It was made on a low-budget by the independent Majestic Pictures, a Poverty Row forerunner of Republic Pictures.

rows.title: The Worst Woman in Paris?
rows.cast: Benita Hume, Adolphe Menjou
rows.extract: The Worst Woman in Paris? is a 1933 American drama film directed by Monta Bell and written by Monta Bell and Marion Dix. The film stars Benita Hume, Adolphe Menjou, Harvey Stephens, Helen Chandler, Margaret Seddon and Adele St. Mauer. The film was released on October 20, 1933, by Fox Film Corporatio

rows.title: The Wrecker
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Genevieve Tobin
rows.extract: The Wrecker is a 1933 American Pre-Code action-romance film directed by Albert S. Rogell and starring Jack Holt, Genevieve Tobin and George E. Stone. The screenplay was by Jo Swerling. The film was produced and released by Columbia Pictures.

rows.title: Zoo in Budapest
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Gene Raymond
rows.extract: Zoo in Budapest is a 1933 American Pre-Code romance/melodrama film directed by Rowland V. Lee and starring Loretta Young, Gene Raymond, O.P. Heggie, and Paul Fix. Gene Raymond, playing Zani, a young, mischievous man who has grown up only around the animals and the people that work and visit the zoo.

rows.title: India Speaks
rows.cast: Narrated by, Richard Halliburton
rows.extract: India Speaks is a 1933 Pre-Code adventure film, combining elements of documentaries and travelogue programs, mostly taking place on the Indian sub-continent along with staged bits spliced in to aid story flow. Produced by Walter Futter from a screenplay by Norman Houston, the film was directed, narr

rows.title: This Is America
rows.cast: Alois Havrilla (narrator)

rows.title: Dora's Dunking Doughnuts
rows.cast: Andy Clyde, Shirley Temple
rows.extract: Dora's Dunking Doughnuts is a 1933 American short subject directed by Harry Edwards.

rows.title: Lot in Sodom
rows.cast: Friedrich Haak
rows.extract: Lot in Sodom is a 1933 short silent experimental film, based on the Biblical tale of the city of Sodom and Gomorrah. It was directed by James Sibley Watson and Melville Webber.

rows.title: Narcotic
rows.cast: Harry Cording, Joan Dix

rows.title: 365 Nights in Hollywood
rows.cast: Alice Faye, Grant Mitchell, James Dunn
rows.extract: 365 Nights in Hollywood is a 1934 American Pre-Code drama film directed by George Marshall and starring Alice Faye and James Dunn.

rows.title: 6 Day Bike Rider
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Maxine Doyle, Frank McHugh
rows.extract: 6 Day Bike Rider is a 1934 American comedy film directed by Lloyd Bacon, written by Earl Baldwin, and starring Joe E. rows.title: Adventures of Texas Jack
rows.cast: Hal Taliaferro, Jay Wilsey, Victoria Vinton

rows.title: The Affairs of Cellini
rows.cast: Constance Bennett, Fredric March, Fay Wray
rows.extract: The Affairs of Cellini is a 1934 comedy film directed by Gregory La Cava and starring Frank Morgan, Constance Bennett, Fredric March, Fay Wray, and Louis Calhern. It is set in Florence. The film was adapted by Bess Meredyth from the play The Firebrand of Florence by Edwin Justus Mayer.

rows.title: Affairs of a Gentleman
rows.cast: Paul Lukas, Leila Hyams, Patricia Ellis
rows.extract: Affairs of a Gentleman is a 1934 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Edwin L. Marin and written by Cyril Hume, Peter Ruric and Milton Krims, adapted from the play by Edith Ellis and Edward Ellis (actor). The film stars Paul Lukas, Leila Hyams, Patricia Ellis, Phillip Reed, Onslow Stevens and Do

rows.title: Against the Law
rows.cast: Johnny Mack Brown, Sally Blane

rows.title: The Age of Innocence
rows.cast: Irene Dunne, John Boles, Helen Westley
rows.extract: The Age of Innocence is a 1934 American drama film directed by Philip Moeller and starring Irene Dunne, John Boles and Lionel Atwill. The film is an adaptation of the 1920 novel The Age of Innocence by Edith Wharton, set in the fashionable New York society of the 1870s. Prolific on Broadway, Philip

rows.title: All Men Are Enemies
rows.cast: Helen Twelvetrees, Mona Barrie, Hugh Williams
rows.extract: All Men Are Enemies is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film directed by George Fitzmaurice and written by Lenore J. Coffee. The film stars Helen Twelvetrees, Mona Barrie, Hugh Williams, Herbert Mundin, Henry Stephenson and Walter Byron. The film was released on April 20, 1934, by Fox Film Corporation

rows.title: All of Me
rows.cast: Fredric March, George Raft, Miriam Hopkins
rows.extract: All of Me is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film directed by James Flood and starring Fredric March, Miriam Hopkins, and George Raft. The film was written by actor Thomas Mitchell and Sidney Buchman from Rose Porter's play Chrysalis.

rows.title: Among the Missing
rows.cast: Richard Cromwell, Billie Seward
rows.extract: Among the Missing is a 1934 American drama film directed by Albert S. Rogell and starring Richard Cromwell, Henrietta Crosman and Billie Seward.

rows.title: Anne of Green Gables
rows.cast: Anne Shirley, Helen Westley, O. P. Heggie
rows.extract: Anne of Green Gables is a 1934 film directed by George Nicholls, Jr., based upon the 1908 novel Anne of Green Gables by Canadian author Lucy Maud Montgomery. Dawn O'Day, who portrayed the title character in the film, changed her stage name to Anne Shirley, which she was billed as for this and all su

rows.title: Are We Civilized?
rows.cast: Frank McGlynn, William Farnum, Anita Louise
rows.extract: Are We Civilized? is an independently released 1934 pre-Code American social problem film directed by Edwin Carewe which constituted a veiled attack on Adolf Hitler. The film was given a negative review by Time magazine upon its release. Footage of dinosaurs in the film are recycled from the 1918 Wi

rows.title: As Husbands Go
rows.cast: Warner Baxter, Helen Vinson
rows.extract: As Husbands Go is a 1934 American pre-Code comedy film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and written by S. N. Behrman and Sonya Levien. It is based on the 1931 play As Husbands Go by Rachel Crothers. The film stars Warner Baxter, Helen Vinson, Warner Oland, Catherine Doucet, G. P. Huntley, Frank O'Conn

rows.title: As the Earth Turns
rows.cast: Donald Woods, Jean Muir, Dorothy Peterson
rows.extract: As the Earth Turns is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film directed by Alfred E. Green and starring Jean Muir and Donald Woods, based on a Pulitzer Prize-nominated best-selling novel by Gladys Hasty Carroll.

rows.title: Babbitt
rows.cast: Aline MacMahon, Guy Kibbee
rows.extract: Babbitt is a 1934 film adaptation of the novel of the same name by Sinclair Lewis directed by William Keighley and starring Aline MacMahon, Guy Kibbee and Claire Dodd. The screenplay is about a staid small-town businessman who gets ensnared in shady dealings.

rows.title: Babes in Toyland
rows.cast: Stan Laurel, Oliver Hardy, Charlotte Henry
rows.extract: Babes in Toyland is a Laurel and Hardy musical Christmas film released on November 30, 1934. The film is also known by the alternative titles Laurel and Hardy in Toyland, Revenge Is Sweet, and March of the Wooden Soldiers, a 73-minute abridged version.

rows.title: Baby Take a Bow
rows.cast: Shirley Temple, Claire Trevor, James Dunn
rows.extract: Baby Take a Bow is a 1934 American comedy-drama film directed by Harry Lachman and is one of the earliest Hays code Hollywood films. The screenplay by Philip Klein and Edward E. Paramore Jr. is based on the 1926 play Square Crooks by James P. Judge. Shirley Temple plays the child of an ex-convict tr

rows.title: Bachelor Bait
rows.cast: Stuart Erwin, Rochelle Hudson, Grady Sutton
rows.extract: Bachelor Bait is a 1934 American comedy film about a man who is fired from his job issuing marriage licenses at city hall because of the actions of a co-worker. He starts a match making business which becomes very successful because of Mr. Watts' ability to find suitable matches for everybody except

rows.title: Bachelor of Arts
rows.cast: Anita Louise, Mae Marsh
rows.extract: Bachelor of Arts is a 1934 American drama film directed by Louis King and written by Lamar Trotti. The film stars Tom Brown, Anita Louise, Henry B. Walthall, Mae Marsh, Arline Judge and Frank Albertson. The film was released on November 23, 1934, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Badge of Honor
rows.cast: Buster Crabbe, Ruth Hall, Betty Blythe
rows.extract: Badge of Honor is a 1934 American drama film directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet and starring Buster Crabbe, Ruth Hall and Betty Blythe. It was produced on Poverty Row as a second feature for distribution by Mayfair Pictures. Crabbe was loaned out from Paramount Pictures for the production. The film's

rows.title: The Band Plays On
rows.cast: Robert Young, Stuart Erwin
rows.extract: The Band Plays On is a 1934 American drama film directed by Russell Mack and written by Bernard Schubert, Ralph Spence and Harvey Gates. The film stars Robert Young, Stuart Erwin, Leo Carrillo, Betty Furness, Ted Healy and Preston Foster. The film was released on December 21, 1934, by Metro-Goldwyn-

rows.title: The Barrets of Wimpole Street
rows.cast: Norma Shearer, Fredric March, Charles Laughton
rows.extract: The Barretts of Wimpole Street is a 1934 American romantic drama film directed by Sidney Franklin based on the 1930 play of the same title by Rudolf Besier. It depicts the real-life romance between poets Elizabeth Barrett and Robert Browning, despite the opposition of her abusive father Edward Moult

rows.title: The Beast of Borneo
rows.cast: Eugene Sigaloff, Mae Stuart
rows.extract: The Beast of Borneo is a 1934 American pre-code film directed by Harry Garson. The film is made up mostly of leftover footage from Universal Studios's East of Borneo, made in 1931. A couple of added dialogue scenes were spliced into what was essentially a travelogue and a series of close-ups of an e

rows.title: Bedside
rows.cast: Warren William, Jean Muir, Allen Jenkins
rows.extract: Bedside is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film starring Warren William, Jean Muir and Allen Jenkins.

rows.title: Beggars in Ermine
rows.cast: Lionel Atwill, Jameson Thomas, Betty Furness
rows.extract: Beggars in Ermine is a 1934 American pre-Code film directed by Phil Rosen.

rows.title: Beggar's Holiday
rows.cast: Sally O'Neil, Hardie Albright, J. Farrell MacDonald
rows.extract: Beggar's Holiday is a 1934 American drama film directed by Sam Newfield and starring Hardie Albright, J. Farrell MacDonald and Sally O'Neil. It was produced on Poverty Row as a second feature. Scenes were shot at the Talisman Studios. In Britain it was distributed by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Behold My Wife!
rows.cast: Sylvia Sidney, Ann Sheridan, H. B. Warner
rows.extract: Behold My Wife! is a 1934 drama film directed by Mitchell Leisen. It stars Sylvia Sidney and Gene Raymond. Based on a novel by Sir Gilbert Parker, The Translation of a Savage, the story had been filmed before in the silent era in 1920 as Behold My Wife! starring Mabel Julienne Scott and Milton Sills

rows.title: Belle of the Nineties
rows.cast: Mae West, Johnny Mack Brown, Katherine DeMille
rows.extract: Belle of the Nineties is a 1934 American Western film directed by Leo McCarey and released by Paramount Pictures. rows.title: Beloved
rows.cast: John Boles, Gloria Stuart, Morgan Farley
rows.extract: Beloved is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film directed by Victor Schertzinger and written by Paul Gangelin and George O'Neil. The film stars John Boles, Gloria Stuart, Morgan Farley, Ruth Hall, Albert Conti and Dorothy Peterson. The film was released on January 22, 1934, by Universal Pictures.

rows.title: Beyond the Law
rows.cast: Tim McCoy, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Beyond the Law is a 1934 American crime film directed by D. Ross Lederman.

rows.title: The Big Shakedown
rows.cast: Bette Davis, Ricardo Cortez, Allen Jenkins
rows.extract: The Big Shakedown is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film starring Charles Farrell and Bette Davis, and directed by John Francis Dillon. rows.title: The Black Cat
rows.cast: Boris Karloff, Bela Lugosi, David Manners
rows.extract: The Black Cat is a 1934 American pre-Code horror film directed by Edgar G. Ulmer and starring Boris Karloff and Béla Lugosi. rows.title: Black Moon
rows.cast: Fay Wray, Dorothy Burgess, Jack Holt
rows.extract: Black Moon is a 1934 American pre-Code horror film directed by Roy William Neill and starring Jack Holt, Fay Wray, and Dorothy Burgess. rows.title: Blind Date
rows.cast: Ann Sothern, Neil Hamilton, Paul Kelly
rows.extract: Blind Date is a 1934 American drama film directed by Roy William Neill and starring Ann Sothern, Neil Hamilton, and Paul Kelly.

rows.title: Blue Steel
rows.cast: John Wayne, Eleanor Hunt
rows.extract: Blue Steel is a 1934 American pre-Code Monogram Western film directed by Robert N. Bradbury and starring John Wayne. Wayne plays a U.S. Marshal who is trying to capture the Polka Dot Bandit, who has taken off with $4,000. The film also featured Yakima Canutt and George "Gabby" Hayes. It was released

rows.title: Bolero
rows.cast: George Raft, Carole Lombard, Sally Rand
rows.extract: Bolero is a 1934 American pre-Code musical drama film directed by Wesley Ruggles and starring George Raft and Carole Lombard. The Paramount production was a rare chance for Raft to star and to play a dancer, which had been his profession in New York City, rather than portraying a gangster. The film

rows.title: Bombay Mail
rows.cast: Edmund Lowe, Ralph Forbes, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Bombay Mail is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film directed by Edwin L. Marin and written by Tom Reed. The film stars Edmund Lowe, Ralph Forbes, Shirley Grey, Hedda Hopper, Onslow Stevens, and Jameson Thomas. The film was released on January 6, 1934, by Universal Pictures. The film is based on the L

rows.title: The Border Menace
rows.cast: Bill Cody, George Chesebro
rows.extract: The Border Menace is a 1934 American western film directed by Robert F. Hill and starring Bill Cody, Miriam Rice, George Chesebro and Jimmy Aubrey who also edited the film. It was produced by an independent Poverty Row outfit Aywon Film Corporation for release as a second feature. Location shooting

rows.title: Border Guns
rows.cast: Bill Cody, Blanche Mehaffey

rows.title: Born to be Bad
rows.cast: Loretta Young, Cary Grant, Marion Burns
rows.extract: Born to Be Bad is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film starring Loretta Young and Cary Grant, and directed by Lowell Sherman.

rows.title: Boss Cowboy
rows.cast: Buddy Roosevelt, Frances Morris
rows.extract: Boss Cowboy is a 1934 Western B movie remake of Rough Ridin' (1924)produced and directed by low-budget independent filmmaker Victor Adamson and starring Buddy Roosevelt.

rows.title: Bottoms Up
rows.cast: Spencer Tracy, John Boles, Pat Paterson
rows.extract: Bottoms Up is a 1934 American pre-Code musical comedy film made by Fox Film Corporation, and was directed by David Butler who co-wrote original story and screenplay with producer Buddy G. DeSylva and co-star Sid Silvers. The picture stars Spencer Tracy, Pat Paterson, John Boles and Herbert Mundin, a

rows.title: Bright Eyes
rows.cast: Shirley Temple, James Dunn, Lois Wilson
rows.extract: Bright Eyes is a 1934 American comedy drama film directed by David Butler. The screenplay by William Conselman is based on a story by David Butler and Edwin J. Burke.

rows.title: British Agent
rows.cast: Leslie Howard, Kay Francis, Cesar Romero
rows.extract: British Agent is a 1934 American romantic espionage film directed by Michael Curtiz and starring Leslie Howard and Kay Francis. It is based on Memoirs of a British Agent, the 1932 autobiography of R. H. Bruce Lockhart, who worked for the British Secret Service during the Russian Revolution and had a

rows.title: Broadway Bill
rows.cast: Myrna Loy, Warner Baxter, Walter Connolly
rows.extract: Broadway Bill is a 1934 American comedy-drama film directed by Frank Capra and starring Warner Baxter and Myrna Loy. Screenplay by Robert Riskin and based on the short story "Strictly Confidential" by Mark Hellinger, the film is about a man's love for his thoroughbred race horse and the woman who he

rows.title: Bulldog Drummond Strikes Back
rows.cast: Ronald Colman, Loretta Young, Charles Butterworth
rows.extract: Bulldog Drummond Strikes Back is a 1934 American comedy-mystery-adventure film directed by Roy Del Ruth. The film stars Ronald Colman and Loretta Young. It was a loose sequel to the 1929 film Bulldog Drummond which had also starred Colman.

rows.title: By Your Leave
rows.cast: Frank Morgan, Genevieve Tobin, Neil Hamilton
rows.extract: By Your Leave is a 1934 American domestic comedy film directed by Lloyd Corrigan from a script by Allan Scott, Lewis Foster, and Sam Mintz. The screenplay was based on a play of the same name by Gladys Hurlbut and Emma B. C. Wells, which had a short run early in the year at the Morosco Theatre. The

rows.title: Call It Luck
rows.cast: Pat Paterson, Herbert Mundin
rows.extract: Call It Luck is a 1934 American comedy film directed by James Tinling and written by Dudley Nichols and Lamar Trotti. The film stars Pat Paterson, Herbert Mundin, Charles Starrett, Gordon Westcott, Georgia Caine and Theodore von Eltz. The film was released on June 1, 1934, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: The Captain Hates the Sea
rows.cast: Victor McLaglen, Alison Skipworth, John Gilbert
rows.extract: The Captain Hates the Sea is a 1934 comedy film directed by Lewis Milestone and released by Columbia Pictures. rows.title: Caravan
rows.cast: Charles Boyer, Loretta Young, Jean Parker
rows.extract: Caravan  is a 1934 American musical film released by Fox Film Corporation, directed by Erik Charell, and starring Charles Boyer, Loretta Young, Phillips Holmes and Jean Parker. Fox also produced a French language version of this film, Caravane (1934) starring Boyer, Annabella, and Conchita Montenegr

rows.title: Carolina
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, Lionel Barrymore, Henrietta Crosman
rows.extract: Carolina is a 1934 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by Henry King, with a screenplay by Reginald Berkley based on the 1931 play The House of Connelly by Paul Green, and starring Janet Gaynor, Lionel Barrymore, and Robert Young. The supporting cast features Stepin Fetchit and Shirley T

rows.title: The Case of the Howling Dog
rows.cast: Warren William, Mary Astor
rows.extract: The Case of the Howling Dog is a 1934 American mystery film directed by Alan Crosland, based on the 1934 novel of the same name by Erle Stanley Gardner. The film stars Warren William and Mary Astor. This was the first in a series of four films in which William played Perry Mason. The next three film

rows.title: The Cat and the Fiddle
rows.cast: Ramon Novarro, Jeanette MacDonald
rows.extract: The Cat and the Fiddle is a 1934 American pre-Code romantic musical film directed by William K. Howard based on the hit 1931 Broadway musical of the same name by Jerome Kern and Otto A. Harbach, about a romance between a struggling composer and an American singer. The film stars Ramon Novarro and Je

rows.title: The Cat's-Paw
rows.cast: Harold Lloyd, Una Merkel
rows.extract: The Cat's-Paw (1934) is a comedy film starring Harold Lloyd and directed by Sam Taylor. It was Lloyd's seventh and final collaboration with Taylor and the fourth of his seven starring roles in sound.

rows.title: Chained
rows.cast: Joan Crawford, Clark Gable, Otto Kruger
rows.extract: Chained is a 1934 American drama film directed by Clarence Brown and starring Joan Crawford and Clark Gable with supporting performances by Otto Kruger, Stuart Erwin, Una O'Connor and Akim Tamiroff. The screenplay was written by John Lee Mahin, Albert Hackett and Frances Goodrich based upon a story

rows.title: Change of Heart
rows.cast: Janet Gaynor, James Dunn, Ginger Rogers
rows.extract: Change of Heart is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film starring Janet Gaynor, Charles Farrell, James Dunn, and Ginger Rogers. The movie, about a quartet of college chums who all move to 1934 New York City, was written by James Gleason and Sonya Levien from Kathleen Norris's novel, Manhattan Love Son

rows.title: Charlie Chan in London
rows.cast: Warner Oland, Mona Barrie, Ray Milland
rows.extract: Charlie Chan in London is a 1934 American mystery film directed by Eugene Forde. The film stars Warner Oland as Charlie Chan. This is the sixth film produced by Fox with Warner Oland as the detective, and the second not to be lost, after The Black Camel (1931).

rows.title: Charlie Chan's Courage
rows.cast: Warner Oland, Drue Leyton, Donald Woods
rows.extract: Charlie Chan's Courage (1934) is the fifth film in which Warner Oland played detective Charlie Chan. It is a remake of the 1927 silent film The Chinese Parrot, based upon the novel by Earl Derr Biggers. Both are considered lost films.

rows.title: Cheaters
rows.cast: William Boyd, June Collyer
rows.extract: Cheaters is a 1934 American crime film directed by Phil Rosen and starring William Boyd, June Collyer and Dorothy Mackaill.

rows.title: Cheating Cheaters
rows.cast: Fay Wray, Cesar Romero
rows.extract: Cheating Cheaters is a 1934 American comedy film directed by Richard Thorpe, written by James Mulhauser, Allen Rivkin and Gladys Buchanan Unger and starring Fay Wray and Cesar Romero, with a supporting cast featuring Minna Gombell, Henry Armetta, Francis L. Sullivan and Hugh O'Connell. The picture w

rows.title: The Circus Clown
rows.cast: Joe E. Brown, Patricia Ellis
rows.extract: The Circus Clown is a 1934 American Pre-Code comedy film about a man who wants to join the circus against the wishes of his ex-circus clown father. It stars Joe E. Brown and Patricia Ellis.

rows.title: City Limits
rows.cast: Frank Craven, Sally Blane, Claude Gillingwater
rows.extract: City Limits is a 1934 American Pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by William Nigh and starring Frank Craven, Sally Blane, Ray Walker and Claude Gillingwater. It was remade in 1941 as Father Steps Out.

rows.title: City Park
rows.cast: Sally Blane, Matty Kemp
rows.extract: City Park is a 1934 American comedy drama film directed by Richard Thorpe and starring Sally Blane, Henry B. Walthall and Matty Kemp.

rows.title: Cleopatra
rows.cast: Claudette Colbert, Warren William, Henry Wilcoxon
rows.extract: Cleopatra is a 1934 American epic film directed by Cecil B. DeMille and distributed by Paramount Pictures. rows.title: Cockeyed Cavaliers
rows.cast: Bert Wheeler, Robert Woolsey, Thelma Todd
rows.extract: Cockeyed Cavaliers is a 1934 American pre-Code comedy film starring the comedy duo of Wheeler & Woolsey. Directed by Mark Sandrich from a screenplay by Edward Kaufman, Grant Garrett, Ralph Spence and Ben Holmes. Also featured in the cast were Dorothy Lee and Thelma Todd.

rows.title: College Rhythm
rows.cast: Jack Oakie, Joe Penner
rows.extract: College Rhythm is a 1934 American musical comedy film directed by Norman Taurog and starring Jack Oakie, Mary Brian, and Joe Penner. The budget was $537,000. Filming started August 16, 1934.

rows.title: Come On Marines!
rows.cast: Richard Arlen, Ida Lupino
rows.extract: Come On Marines! is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film directed by Henry Hathaway and starring Richard Arlen and Ida Lupino.

rows.title: Coming Out Party
rows.cast: Frances Dee, Gene Raymond, Nigel Bruce
rows.extract: Coming Out Party is a 1934 American Pre-Code drama film directed by John G. Blystone starring Frances Dee, Gene Raymond, Alison Skipworth and Nigel Bruce. It was produced and distributed by the Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
rows.cast: Robert Donat, Elissa Landi, Louis Calhern
rows.extract: The Count of Monte Cristo is a 1934 American adventure film directed by Rowland V. Lee and starring Robert Donat and Elissa Landi. rows.title: The Countess of Monte Cristo
rows.cast: Fay Wray, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: The Countess of Monte Cristo is a 1934 American comedy film directed by Karl Freund and starring Fay Wray, Paul Lukas and Reginald Owen. The film was a remake of a 1932 German film The Countess of Monte Cristo. It was remade in 1948 under the same title.

rows.title: The Crime Doctor
rows.cast: Otto Kruger, Karen Morley
rows.extract: The Crime Doctor is a 1934 American crime drama directed by John Robertson from a screenplay by Jane Murfin, adapted from the novel The Big Bow Mystery by Israel Zangwill. rows.title: The Crime of Helen Stanley
rows.cast: Ralph Bellamy, Shirley Grey, Gail Patrick
rows.extract: The Crime of Helen Stanley is a 1934 American pre-Code crime film directed by D. Ross Lederman and starring Ralph Bellamy, Shirley Grey and Gail Patrick. rows.title: Crime Without Passion
rows.cast: Claude Rains, Margo

rows.title: Crimson Romance
rows.cast: Ben Lyon, Sari Maritza, Erich von Stroheim
rows.extract: Crimson Romance is a 1934 American drama film directed by David Howard and written by Milton Krims and Doris Schroeder. rows.extract: The Crosby Case is a 1934 American pre-Code crime film directed by Edwin L. Marin and written by Warren B. Duff and Gordon Kahn. rows.cast: Lew Ayres, June Knight, Alice White
rows.extract: Cross Country Cruise is a 1934 American Pre-Code romance film directed by Edward Buzzell and written by Elmer Blaney Harris. The film stars Lew Ayres, June Knight, Alice White, Alan Dinehart, Minna Gombell, and Eugene Pallette. The film was released on January 15, 1934, by Universal Pictures.

rows.cast: Joan Blondell, Dick Powell, Ruby Keeler

rows.cast: Virginia Bruce, Conrad Nagel, Melvyn Douglas

rows.cast: Edward G. Robinson, Genevieve Tobin, Robert Barrat
rows.extract: Dark Hazard is 1934 pre-Code American drama film starring Edward G. Robinson and directed by Alfred E. Green. It is based on a novel by W. R. Burnett. It was produced by First National Pictures and released through Warner Bros.

rows.title: David Harum
rows.cast: Will Rogers, Louise Dresser
rows.extract: David Harum is a 1934 American comedy film directed by James Cruze and written by Walter Woods. The film stars Will Rogers, Louise Dresser, Evelyn Venable, Kent Taylor, Stepin Fetchit, Noah Beery, Sr. and Roger Imhof. The film was released on March 3, 1934, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Death on the Diamond
rows.cast: Robert Young, Madge Evans
rows.extract: Death on the Diamond is a 1934 comedy-mystery film starring Robert Young. It was based on the novel Death on the Diamond: A Baseball Mystery Story by Cortland Fitzsimmons, directed by Edward Sedgwick and produced and released by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.

rows.title: Death Takes a Holiday
rows.cast: Fredric March, Helen Westley, Kent Taylor
rows.extract: Death Takes a Holiday is a 1934 American pre-Code romantic drama starring Fredric March, Evelyn Venable and Guy Standing. It is based on the 1924 Italian play La morte in vacanza by Alberto Casella (1891–1957), as adapted in English for Broadway in 1929 by Walter Ferris.

rows.title: The Defense Rests
rows.cast: Jack Holt, Jean Arthur
rows.extract: The Defense Rests is a 1934 American film directed by Lambert Hillyer and starring Jack Holt, Jean Arthur, and Nat Pendleton. The movie was produced in May 1934 and released on 15 July 1934.

rows.title: Devil Tiger
rows.cast: Marion Burns, Kane Richmond
rows.extract: Devil Tiger is a 1934 American action film directed by Clyde E. Elliott and written by James O. Spearing, Russell G. Shields and Lew Lehr. The film stars Marion Burns, Kane Richmond, Harry Woods and Ah Lee. The film was released on February 8, 1934, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Double Door
rows.cast: Evelyn Venable, Anne Revere, Kent Taylor
rows.extract: Double Door is a 1934 American pre-Code thriller film directed by Charles Vidor, written by Jack Cunningham and Gladys Lehman, and starring Evelyn Venable, Mary Morris, Anne Revere, and Kent Taylor. The film follows a young bride who finds herself tormented by her wealthy husband's abusive spinster

rows.title: The Dover Road
rows.cast: Diana Wynyard, Clive Brook
rows.extract: Where Sinners Meet is a 1934 American pre-Code romantic comedy film directed by J. Walter Ruben and starring Diana Wynyard, Clive Brook and Billie Burke. rows.title: Down to Their Last Yacht
rows.cast: Mary Boland, Polly Moran, Ned Sparks
rows.extract: Down to Their Last Yacht is a 1934 comic adventure produced and distributed by RKO Pictures.

rows.title: Dr. Monica
rows.cast: Kay Francis, Warren William, Jean Muir
rows.extract: Dr. Monica is a 1934 American pre-Code melodrama film produced by Warner Bros. starring Kay Francis, Warren William, and Jean Muir. An obstetrician, who is unable to have children, discovers that the baby she is about to deliver was fathered by her husband.

rows.title: The Dude Ranger
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Irene Hervey
rows.extract: The Dude Ranger is a 1934 American Western film directed by Edward F. Cline based on the novel by Zane Grey. Parts of the film were shot in Johnson Canyon, Springdale, Zion National Park, and the Virgin River in Utah. The Grand Canyon was also a filming location.

rows.title: Easy to Love
rows.cast: Genevieve Tobin, Adolphe Menjou, Mary Astor
rows.extract: Easy to Love is a 1934 American Pre-Code romantic comedy film starring Genevieve Tobin, Adolphe Menjou, Mary Astor, and Edward Everett Horton. rows.title: Eight Girls in a Boat
rows.cast: Dorothy Wilson, Douglass Montgomery, Kay Johnson
rows.extract: Eight Girls in a Boat is a 1934 American Pre-Code drama film directed by Richard Wallace and written by Helmut Brandis, Lewis R. Foster and Casey Robinson. It is a remake of the 1932 German film Eight Girls in a Boat, which was also co-written by Brandis.

rows.title: Elinor Norton
rows.cast: Claire Trevor, Gilbert Roland
rows.extract: Elinor Norton is a 1934 American drama film directed by Hamilton MacFadden and written by Rose Franken and Philip Klein. rows.extract: Elmer and Elsie is a 1934 American comedy film directed by Gilbert Pratt and written by Humphrey Pearson. The film stars George Bancroft, Frances Fuller, Roscoe Karns, George Barbier, Nella Walker and Charles Sellon. The film was released on August 4, 1934, by Paramount Pictures.

rows.title: Embarrassing Moments
rows.cast: Chester Morris, Marian Nixon
rows.extract: Embarrassing Moments is a 1934 American comedy film directed by Edward Laemmle and written by Charles Logue, Dickson Morgan and Gladys Buchanan Unger. rows.title: Enlighten Thy Daughter
rows.cast: Herbert Rawlinson, Charles Eaton, Claire Whitney
rows.extract: Enlighten Thy Daughter is a 1934 American drama film directed by John Varley and starring Herbert Rawlinson, Charles Eaton and Claire Whitney. It was shot at the Photocolor Studios in Hastings-on-Hudson, New York. It is a remake of the 1917 silent film of the same title by Ivan Abramson.

rows.title: Evelyn Prentice
rows.cast: William Powell, Myrna Loy, Rosalind Russell
rows.extract: Evelyn Prentice is a 1934 American crime drama film starring William Powell and Myrna Loy, and featuring Una Merkel and Rosalind Russell in her film debut. rows.title: Ever Since Eve
rows.cast: George O'Brien, Mary Brian, Herbert Mundin
rows.extract: Ever Since Eve is a 1934 American drama film directed by George Marshall and written by Stuart Anthony and Henry Johnson. The film stars George O'Brien, Mary Brian, Herbert Mundin, Betty Blythe, Roger Imhof and Russell Simpson. The film was released on March 25, 1934, by Fox Film Corporation.

rows.title: Fashions of 1934
rows.cast: William Powell, Bette Davis, Frank McHugh
rows.extract: Fashions of 1934 is a 1934 American pre-Code musical comedy film directed by William Dieterle with musical numbers created and directed by Busby Berkeley. The screenplay by F. rows.title: Father Brown, Detective
rows.cast: Walter Connolly, Paul Lukas
rows.extract: Father Brown, Detective  is a 1934 American mystery film directed by Edward Sedgwick and starring Walter Connolly, Paul Lukas and Gertrude Michael. It is based on the 1910 Father Brown story "The Blue Cross" by G. K. Chesterton.

rows.title: Ferocious Pal
rows.cast: Tom London, Henry Roquemore
rows.extract: Ferocious Pal is a 1934 American adventure film directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet and written by Joseph Anthony Roach. The film stars Kazan the Wonder Dog, Ruth Sullivan, Gene Toler, Robert Seiter, Tom London and Harry Dunkinson. The film was released on February 2, 1934, by Principal Distributing.

rows.title: Fifteen Wives
rows.cast: Conway Tearle, Natalie Moorhead
rows.extract: Fifteen Wives is a 1934 American mystery film directed by Frank R. Strayer and starring Conway Tearle, Natalie Moorhead and Raymond Hatton. After arriving from South America, a man is murdered at a New York hotel. When the police investigate, they discover he has fifteen wives.

rows.title: Fighting Hero
rows.cast: Tom Tyler, Dick Botiller
rows.extract: Fighting Hero is a 1934 American Western film directed by Harry S. Webb and starring Tom Tyler, Renee Borden, and Edward Hearn.

rows.title: The Fighting Ranger
rows.cast: Buck Jones, Dorothy Revier
rows.extract: The Fighting Ranger is a 1934 American pre-Code Western film directed by George B. Seitz.

rows.title: Fighting to Live
rows.cast: Marion Shilling, Steve Pendleton
rows.extract: Fighting to Live is a 1934 American Pre-Code western film directed by Edward F. Cline.

rows.title: Fighting Through
rows.cast: Reb Russell, Lucille Lund
rows.extract: Fighting Through is a 1934 American Western film directed by Harry L. Fraser and starring Reb Russell, Lucille Lund and Yakima Canutt.

rows.title: Finishing School
rows.cast: Frances Dee, Ginger Rogers, Bruce Cabot
rows.extract: Finishing School is a 1934 pre-Code romantic drama film starring Frances Dee as a young woman who gets into trouble after being sent to a finishing school by her neglectful parents.

rows.title: Flirtation
rows.cast: Jeanette Loff, Ben Alexander, Arthur Tracy
rows.extract: Flirtation is a 1934 American drama film directed by Leo Birinsky and starring Jeanette Loff, Ben Alexander and Arthur Tracy. A young man from the country moves to the city and falls in love with a burlesque dancer.

rows.title: Flirtation Walk
rows.cast: Dick Powell, Ruby Keeler, Ross Alexander
rows.extract: Flirtation Walk is a 1934 American romantic musical film written by Delmer Daves and Lou Edelman, and directed by Frank Borzage. rows.title: Flirting with Danger
rows.cast: William Cagney, Maria Alba
rows.extract: Flirting with Danger is a 1934 American comedy adventure film directed by Vin Moore and starring Robert Armstrong, Edgar Kennedy and William Cagney. The picture was released by Monogram Pictures and has a running time of 62 minutes.

rows.title: Fog Over Frisco
rows.cast: Bette Davis, Donald Woods, Margaret Lindsay
rows.extract: Fog Over Frisco is a 1934 American Pre-Code drama film directed by William Dieterle. The screenplay by Robert N. Lee and Eugene Solow was based on the short story The Five Fragments by George Dyer.

rows.title: Forsaking All Others
rows.cast: Joan Crawford, Clark Gable, Robert Montgomery
rows.extract: Forsaking All Others is a 1934 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by W.S. Van Dyke, and starring Robert Montgomery, Joan Crawford and Clark Gable. rows.title: The Fountain

rows.title: Four Frightened People

rows.extract: Four Frightened People is a 1934 American Pre-Code adventure film directed by Cecil B. DeMille and starring Claudette Colbert, Herbert Marshall, Mary Boland, and William Gargan. It is based on the 1931 novel by E. Arnot Robertson.

rows.title: Fugitive Road

rows.title: Gallant Lady

rows.title: Gambling Lady
rows.cast: Barbara Stanwyck, Pat O'Brien, Joel McCrea
rows.extract: Gambling Lady is a 1934 American pre-Code romantic drama film directed by Archie Mayo, and starring Barbara Stanwyck, Joel McCrea and Pat O'Brien.

rows.cast: Carole Lombard, Chester Morris, Zazu Pitts
rows.extract: The Gay Bride is a 1934 black-and-white gangster screwball comedy starring Carole Lombard as a wisecracking gold-digger and Chester Morris as the poor man she despises. rows.cast: Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers, Alice Brady

rows.cast: Jean Harlow, Lionel Barrymore, Franchot Tone
rows.extract: The Girl from Missouri is a 1934 American romantic comedy-drama film starring Jean Harlow and Franchot Tone. The movie was written by Anita Loos and directed by Jack Conway.

rows.cast: Ralph Bellamy, Shirley Grey
rows.extract: Girl in Danger is a 1934 American crime film directed by D. Ross Lederman and starring Ralph Bellamy, Shirley Grey and Arthur Hohl. rows.cast: Louise Dresser, Marian Marsh

rows.title: Girl o' My Dreams

rows.title: Glamour

rows.extract: Great Expectations is a 1934 adaptation of the 1861 Charles Dickens novel of the same name. It stars Phillips Holmes as Pip, Jane Wyatt as

rows.title: The Great Flirtation

The film was released on June 15, 1934 by Paramount Pictures. It was based on an unpublished story I Love an Actress by Gregory Rato

rows.title: Green Eyes
rows.cast: Shirley Grey, Charles Starrett
rows.extract: Green Eyes is a 1934 American Pre-Code Chesterfield Pictures film directed by Richard Thorpe.

rows.title: Gridiron Flash
rows.cast: Eddie Quillan, Betty Furness
rows.extract: Gridiron Flash is a 1934 film. It made a profit of $43,000.

rows.title: Half a Sinner
rows.cast: Sally Blane, Joel McCrea
rows.extract: Half a Sinner is a 1934 American pre-Code drama film directed by Kurt Neumann and starring Sally Blane, Joel McCrea and Berton Churchill. It was based on the play Alias the Deacon, which was also the basis of 1927 and 1940 films.

rows.title: Handy Andy

rows.extract: Handy Andy is a 1934 American comedy film directed by David Butler and written by William M. rows.cast: Julie Bishop, William Farnum
rows.extract: Happy Landing is a 1934 American action film directed by Robert N. Bradbury and starring Ray Walker, Julie Bishop and William Farnum.

rows.cast: Rex Ingram, Lawrence Chenault

rows.title: Heat Lightning

rows.title: Hell Bent for Love
